gleng gzhi/de yang yul 'dzam bu gling gi yang rtse'i rgya phibs bsil ljongs chos ldan zhing khams 'di nyid kyi phyogs bzhi'i khor mo yug kun dngul gyi mchod rten lta bu'i mu khyad gangs ris yongs su bskor ba dang / dri med dwangs gtsang gi gtsang chab sngon mo ni gang sar g.yu 'brug dang 'dra bar 'khyugyangs pa'i rtswa thang g.yu yi gzhong pa ltar mdzes shing / 'ing thang gser gzhong nor bus bkang ba dang gnyis su med pa dang / mtsho dang mtshe'u dag ni rang byung gi yon chab phul ba dang yongs su mtshungs pa sogs ngo mtshar yid dbang 'phrog pa'i bod ljongs kyi ya gyal du gyur pa lho kha sa khul t+na/ yar klung gtsang po rgyug khul gyi dbus khul du gnas yod pa dang /rags par byang du lha sa dang / shar du nying khri/ nub tu gzhis ka rtse/ lho ru rgya gar sogs gnas yod cing / mtha' mtshams lam thig ring tshad m+bhi le 6 2 0 yod pa dang / spyi'i rgya khyon spyi le ngos snyoms gru ba'i ma 797 0 0 yod la/ mi 'bor khri 2 2 lhag tsam yod pa'i nang bod rigs dang rgya rigs/ mon pa rigs/ lho pa rigs sogs mi rigs — 1 —
1 4yod pa dang / bod rigs kyis brgya cha 97 2brin gyi yod/sa khul yongs la rdzong 1 2dang shang dang grong rdal 〈 2yod pa dang / sa khul yongs la cha snyoms rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad ni rmid 270 0lhag tsam dang srid 'dzin kung hru'u gnas yul rtsed thang la rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid 2 5 1 1yod/tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar lho kha ni bod mi rigs kyi 'byung gnas dang / rig gnas dang lo rgyus kyi chu 'go zhig yin pas yul gru 'di na mkhar gyi dang po yum bu brla mkhar dang / rje yi dang po gnya' khri btsan po/ dpe cha'i dang po spang skong phyag rgya/ thing gi dang po sbar ras zhing /( zo thar )lha khang gi dang po khra 'brug dgon sde'i dang po bsam yas sogs bod kyi dang po shin tu mang ba ma zad yul yar mo klung ni pur rgyal bod kyi btsan po gnya' khri btsan po nas srong btsan sgam po'i bar rgyal rabs sum cu so gsum gyi bzhugs gnas yin pas da dung sa cha 'di'i steng bod kyi dang po ji tsam yod med su yis brjod thub/deng char spyi le ngos snyoms gru bzhi ma 1 2 0yod pa dang de'i nang rim pa dang po'i grags che'i mdzes ljongs 2 5yod pa'i yar klung mdzes ljongs khul ni rang ljongs dang rgyal khab — 2 —
rim pa'i gtso srung sa khul 'ig yin pas/ yul ljongs mdzes par ma zad dmigs bsal gyi yul goms gshis lugs kya nga ldan yod/ya mtshan dpog par dka' ba'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i mdzes ljongs khul ni mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba 'ig ste/ der ri bo'i khrod du mtsho dang / mtsho'i dkyil du gling phran/ gling phran thog tu dgon sde/ phyogs mtshams kun tu rtsi shing dang / chu mig bya rigs/ srog chags sogs kyis khengs yod pas de ni sa mtho'i mtshe'u dang / gangs ri/gling phran/ 'brog ra/ chu tshan/ ri skyes srog chags/dgon sde sogs yul ljongs mang po gcig tu 'brel ba'i rang byung gi mdzes ljongs khul zhig yin la/ mthong dkon pa'i mi yul gyi grags can rjes shul 'ig kyang yin/lho kha sa khul srid 'dzin kung hru'u gnas yul gna' bo'i grong rdal rtsed thang ni/ ri bo gangs dkar ti se'i ri brgyud kyi lho 'dabs dang / yar lha sham chu yar klung gtsang por 'dres sa'i yul gzhong du gnas/ med thang 'es pa'i grong ming gi go don ni/ med thang grong rdal gyi shar ngos rbad kyi grags can ri chen ba'i'i ya gyal mgon po ri rtser ngo mtshar gdod ma'i spre'u brag phug gcig yod pa de'i nang sprel dang brag srin 'grogs pa las sprel phrug mang du 'phel te rim — 3 —
ba'in bod mi rigs byung ba'i lo rgyus pha gtam bu 'jags su/ yod pas med thang ni de dus 84 spre'us rtsed mo rtse sa'i thang yi na par grags//mdor na yar klung gi sa ga'i chen po ni lha yul sa la 'phos pa ltar mdzes shing / lo rgyus dang shes rig li ting bcud 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho 'og ste/ mdzes sdug ldan pa'i yul ljongs/ lo rgyus ring ba'i gna' shul/ rig dngos mang ba'i dgon pa/ khyad chos ldan pa'i bzo skrun/ phun sum tshogs pa'i thon rdzas/ dro grang snyoms pa'i gnam gshis/ dri mas ma sbags pa'i sa gtsang / sa rgyu gshin pa'i 'ing bzang /bod kyi lho kha/ bod kyi 'bru mdzod/ ces pa'i mtshan snyan bya 'phur ba sogs 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul skor mdzes ljongs khyad du 'phags pa 'ig yin pas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yul skor gnas mchog gi dge mtshan chen po de dag sngog 'don dang khyab bsgrags bya ched 'di lor lho kha sa khul u yon lhan khang dang / srid 'dzin kung hru'u yi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid dang yu/la skor mdzes ljongs kyi lo rgyus gnad la 'khol ba dang / tha snyad gcig gyur dgos pa'i bka' slob ltar nga tsho lho kha sa khul srid gros kyis gtso 'gan 'khur nas sa khrul/ rig dngos cus dang yul skor cus dang zung 'brel gyis lho kha'i yul skor mdzes ljongs ngo sprod ces pa'i deb 'di — 4 —
dpar skrun 'grems spel zhus te sku mgron rnams kyi lho kha shes rtogs dang rgyus mnga' sngar bas mang ba gnang thub rgyur stabs bde bskrun yod/de yang tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar lo rgyus zhes pa ni/lo mang po'i sngon gyi byung ba brjod pa'am gnas tshul zhig yin pa dang / lhag par du 'ga' zhig ni yi ge ma byung gong nas byung ba'i gnas tshul ngag nas ngag tu brgyud cing / phyis yi ger phab pa zhig yin pas de dag gi nang ma dag rgyun 'byams su song ba'ang yong srid pa dang / da dung 'di yin thag gcod dka' ba'i bzhed pa 'dra min yang mi nyung ba 'ig yod pa/ dper na/ yar klung rten gsum gnas gsum phug gsum nang gi gnas gsum ngos 'dzin gnang stangs thad la mkhas dbang phal mo ches bya sa lha khang dang / khra 'brug lha khang / btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang bcas gnas gsum du bzhed kyang 'ga' zhig gis btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang gi tshab tu yum bu brla mkhar bzhed pa dang / de bzhin rten gsum ya gyal tshe chu 'bum pa ni/ tshe yi chu 'jo ba'am stsol ba'i don yin pas tha snyad de'i dag cha tshe chu yin par bsnyon du med kyang 'ga' 'ig sis tshes bcu dang / yang la las tshe bcud ces u tshugs kyis 'bri gi yod/ da dung yul skor mdzes ljongs 'ga' zhig gi lo rgyus ni da phan yig lam du 'ib phra — 5 —
bkod pa ha lam med pa'am ha cang nyung nyung ste/ dper na/gra nang rdzong khongs kyi rnam sras gling ga'is bar lo rgyus kyi rin thang shin tu che yang 'ib phra'i lo rgyus ha cang 'tshol khrag po yod pa lta bu/der ma zad 'gro ba mis bskrun pa'i yul skor mdzes ljongs sam gnas mchog ngo mtshar can 'ga' 'ig thog mar bskrun mkhan dang / bskrun pa'i dus tshod sogs la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang du 'dug pas nga tshos dka' ngal de dag gi r+ya dun nas mgo sgur sgur ngang phyir bshol ma byas par/ rgya bod kyi yig tshang mang po phan tshun dpyad bsdur byas pa dang /lo rgyus rig pa la spyan dkyus ring ba'i mkhas dbang rnam par dogs 'dri zhu ba/ da dung sa cha de rang gi rgyus can mi la skad cha 'dri ba sogs thabs brgya jus stong gis gong rim gyi thugs re ltar dpe deb 'di'i lo rgyus kyi nyi ma ni rtog bzo'i sprin las bral ba dang / tha snyad kyi chu phran bye ba ni rgya mtsho gcig tu gcig gyur zhus yod pas/ rnam pa lhan rgyas kyis dpe deb 'dzi gzigs rjes lho kha'i lo rgyus dang / chos lugs/mdzes rtsal/ bzo skrun/ sa gshis/ ri dbyibs/ chu rgyus/dmangs srol sogs kyi shes bya gya nom pa 'ig thob nges yin par gdon mi za/des na sku mgron lhan rgyas kyis thob dka' ba'i go — 6 —
skabs bzang por nges par du gces 'dzin gnang nas ngo mtshar mi yul gyi lha gnas lho kha'i yul du yul skor spro 'phyam la phebs dang /yar lha sham chu skyes chu'i bdud rtsis lus stobs dang shes rig rgyas pa'i yar klung bu phrug khri sum cu so gsum gyis 'phyongs rgyas zla ba sgrol ma lta bu'i gshis bzang dang /gangs ri yar lha sham po 'dra ba'i lhag bsam dkar pos lhan rgyas phebs sgug zhu bzhin yod/mkhas grub kyis/

dang po/ lho kha'i yul skor phyogs ston/yul skor khral rtse gras gsum/gcig ni/ byang rgyud rtsed thang grong rdal gyis gtso bo byas pa'i yar klung gtsang po dang yar klung lo rgyus rig gnas yul skor khul/der gong dkar dang / gra nang / sne gdong /'phyongs rgyas/ zangs ri/ chu gsum/ rgya tsha bcas rdzong bdun tshud yod cing / khul de'i gtso bo ni mdzes ljongs grags can yin/ der lho kha sa khul gyi srog shing du gyur pa'i lo rgyus rig gnas yul skor thon khungs 'dus yod la/ bod mi rigs dang bod kyi rig gnas 'byung sa'i rngam mthug pa'i lo rgyus rig gnas kyi snying rdul gsog phung ldan yod/gnyis ni/ lho nub yar 'brog g.yu mtshos sne 'dren byas pa'i sa mtho'i 'brog thang gi gnas mtsho'i mdzes ljongs yul skor khul/der sna dkar rtse dang mtsho smad rdzong gnyis tshud yod cing / khul de'i yul skor thon khungs kyi srog snying ni bod kyi mtsho chen gsum gyi ya gyal du gyur pa'i yar 'brog g.yu mtshos 1
gtso bo byas pa'i gangs ljongs sa mtho'i mtsho ma/tshe'u yi tshogus yin/ de'i gras su cung che ba'i mtsho mtshe'u t+na phu ma g.yu mtsha dang gri gu mtsho yang yod/ mdzes shing brjid pa'i gangs ri ('khyags rom) dang / mtsho dang mtshe'u/ rtswa thang / ri skyes srog chags bcas ni gnas de'i snang brnyan gtso bo yin/gsum ni/ shar lho'i ngos kyi mtha' mtshams su legs pos gtso bo byas pa'i ri mtho grog rong gi 'byung khams yul skor khul/de'i khongs su lhun rtse dang / mtsho sna/ lho bras bcas mtha' mtshams kyi rdzong gsum po tshud yod cing / khul der mtha' mtshams sa khul gyi ngo mtshar mdzes pas phyug pa'i ri mtho grog rong gi yul ljongs dang gdod ma'i 'byung khams rang byung yul ljongs yod pa dang sbrags/ da dung mo na pa'i yul srol rig gnas dang lho pa'i 'tsho ba'i goms srol myang rgyu yod/ yul skor gyi gtso snying gi gdod ma'i ri mtho grog rong gi yul ljongs dang / gdod ma'i 'byung kham sa rang byung yu la ljongs/ mon pa dang lho pa'i rig gnas bcas yin༈khud ldan lam thig bzhi/1 chos lugs gnas mjal ( rkang thang ) lam thig gi 2
ya gyal dang po/ de'i khongs su sne gdong dang / zangs ri/rgya tsha/ chu gsum bcas rdzong ba'i tshud yod cing / der lo rgyus rim byung thog tā la dang paṇa chen sogs bla ma skyes chen dang yon tan can gyis sngar srol mtsho mjal byed sa'i gnas mjal lam thig gi khyad chos mnga'/gnas mjal lam thig gi ya gyal gnyis pa/ de'i khongs su sne gdong dang / gra nang / mal gro gung dkar/ lha sa bcas rdzong dang grong khyer ba'i gtogs yod cing / der lo rgyus rig gnas dang / rig dngos gna' shul/ chos lugs gnas mjal/ yar klung gtsang po'i mdzes ljongs bcas ga'i gcig tu gyur pa'i lam thig gi khyad chos mnga'/2 rkang thang myul dpyad/ de ni gtso bo zangs ri dang rgya tsha rdzong gnyis kyi yar klung gtsang po'i bar rked grog rong yi na 'ing / der yar klung gtsang po'i grog rong chen po gnyis pa'i 'byung khungs yul ljongs dang / rbab chu ( skas rim bzhur chu ) grog chu/ gangs ri bcas kyi khyad chos ldan yod/2 lta skor spro gseng / ( lho rgyud 'khor lam chung ngu )de'i khyatshob khongs ni 'phyongs rgyas dang / mtsho smad/ sne gdong bcas rdzong gsum/ yin 'ing / der thu bod kyi rgyal sa rnying pa dang / rtswa thang gi mdzes ljongs / ri skyes srog chags/3
gangs ri/ mtsho mtshe'u/ chu tshan bcas kyi khyad chos ldan yod/4 chu tshan lus gso/ zangs ri'i 'ol kha chu tshan la pags nad dang / grum bu'i nad/ pho ba'i nad/ mig nad sogs bcos thub pa'i nus pa yod cing / lo rgyus thog gi tā la rim byung dang / rje tsong kha pas der chu tshan bskyon pa'am bed spyod gnang myong yod/ der bde srung dang lus gso/nad bcos thub pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan yod/ / / /4
gnyis pa/ bod gyi lo rgyus dang po mkhyen 'dod na/sku nyid lo rgyus rdo ring lho khan phebs/bod kyi brag phug dang po/ spre'u brag phuggna' bo'i grong rdal rtsed thang gi shar ngos su gnas pa'i mgon po ri'i ri sked lhag tsam na ngo mtshar yongs su grags pa'i spre'u brag phug ces bya ba de yod cing / de yang mgon po ri ni bod kyi gnas ri grags can bzhi'i ya gyal zhig yin pa dang / der rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid4 4 0 0yod/ ri bo 'di'i bzo dbyibs brjid chags yid du 'ong ba zhig yod pa ste/ ri bo'i dbus rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa ltar brjid chags pa dang / phyogs bzhir ri lag shar na glang chen 'dra ba dang / lho ru rta mchog 'dra ba/nub na rma bya 'dra ba/ byang du seng ge 'dra ba bcas byed pos ched du bzos pa ltar rab tu mdzes shing / gzhan yang ri lag bzhi po des gtso bo byas pa'i ri nyag 1 0 〈kyis yongs su bskor yod/spre'u brag phug ni mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid 5
4 0 9 0 yi sar chags yod la/ brag phug gi kha byang shar du gtad yod cing / mtho tshad rmid 2 5dang / zheng tshad rmid6 9 5 gting tshad dam sbug thag rmid 1 5yod/ngo mtshar can gyi brag phug de ni thog mar spyan ras gzigs kyis dge bsnyen byin pa'i spre'u 'ig yod pa des kho ba can gyi yul du byang chub kyi sems bskyed sbyangs sa'am sgom sa yin zhing / phyis gnas der spre'u de dang brag srin mo 'ig las dbang drag pos ldog med bskul te mnyam du 'dus pas rigs kyi spre'u phrug drug byung ba rim gyis mang du 'phel ba dang thog mar shing 'bras dang / sngo tshal sogs bzas shing /de nas ma rmos lo tog dang / spyan ras gzigs kyis sa la sa bon gtor gnang mdzad pa'i lo tog ngo ma bzas pas rim par gdong dang gzugs kyi dbyibs 'gyur ba dang / spu phud cing mjug ma'ang med par gyur nas mi la gyur pa de ni bod mi'i mes po yin pas/ spre'u brag phug ni bod mi'i 'gro ba 'byung gnas lo rgyus thog gi brag phug dang po de yin stabs snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs bcur khyab cing / mi rnams kyis rtsa che'i gnas ri 'ig tu brtsis nas mjal bar 'gro ba dang /lo rgyus kyi rin thang shes nas yul skor spro 'cham du bskyod kyi yod/phyis bod yongs su brag phug de 'dra mang du 'phel ba'i 6
nang 'ga' zhig rang byung lhun gyis grub pa dang / 'ga' 'ig mi yis ched du bzos pa yin 'ing / brag phug de dag la btsan cha dod la 'du 'dzi bral ba/ sa gtsang rdo gtsang sogs kyi khyad chos ldan pa dang / mang che ba ri mtho dben sa 'ba' zhig tu chags yod pas skyes chen dam pa mang po'i sgom gnas su gyur te phyis dad can mchod mjal zhu sa'i gnas rtsa chen la 'gyur yod/bod kyi zhing kha dang po/ sbar ras zhing / sbar ras 'ing ( zo dang zhing) ni med thang grong rdal gyi nub byang mtsham sa su yod pa'i za ra grong tsho'i byang ngos yar klung gtsang po'i nye 'gram du gnas shing / 'ing 'di'i ming la kha rgyun du sbar ras zhing dang / zo dang zhing zhes shod srol gnyis yod pa las/ sbar ras 'ing zer don ni/ thog mar mgon po ri rtse nas 'phel ba'i spre'u mang po thang la babs nas sa der sbar ras brgyab shul du 'ing chags pas sbar ras 'ing zhes zer ba dang / yang zo dang zhing zer bon ni/ spre'u mang du 'phel bas shing 'bras sogs zas tshar te bkres ltogs kyis mnar ba na/ sprel rgan gyis ri spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba smon lam btab pas spyan ras gzigs kyis ri rab 7
ngos nas gro nas sran bra bo bcas 'bru sna lnga'i sa bon blangs nas gnas der gtor bas ma rmos lo tog thog mar smin pa spre'u phan tshun zo dang / zo dang zhes dga' spro'i ngang yang du smras pas zo dang zhing zhes zer/gang ltar 'ing 'di nyid ni 'bru sna thog mar dar sa'i zhing gi dang po de yin pas sngar nas da lta'i bar so nam pa rnams kyis zhing kha 'di byin rlabs che'am rtsa chen 'ig tu btsi ge yod la/ khyad par du rtsed thang khul gyi dpyid 'debs so nam rten 'brel de zhing kha de'i steng byas te char chu dus su babs pa dang/ sad ser med pa/ lo legs ston 'bras g.yur du za ba smin pa'i bkra shis rten 'brel gzab rgyas byed kyi yod pa ma zad sa phyogs gzhan gyi so nam pa mang pos kyang de'i nang nas sa phud 'khyer phyin te rang gi 'ing kha'i nang gtor nas bkra shis lo legs yong ba'i rten 'brel zhu ba dang smon lam rgyag gi yod/ da dung yum bu brla mkhar gyi gsham du zhal zas zhing zhes pa gcig yod pas sne shan pa la las de bod kyi zhing kha dang po de yin zhes 'grel bshad rgyag gi yod kyang de ni rgyal ba lnga pa dang zla ba lnga pa go nor thebs pa rang yin pa las/ don dngos su de ni bod kyi 'ing kha dang po de ma yin par phyis rgyal po'i zhal zas te/ rgyal po'i gsol 'ib bzo rgyu'i 'bru rigs ched du 'debs sa 'ig yin pas 'al 8
zas 'ing zhes yongs su grags/de min zhal zas zhing la ming 'grel ga'an zhig kyang yod pa ni/ zhing kha de'i bzo dbyibs zhal zas te/ gtor ma dang 'dra po yod pas zhol zas zhing zhes pa'ang ngag rgyun du 'jags so/ /bod kyi btsan po dang po/ gnya' khri btsan po/bod kyi btsan po dang po gnya' khri btsan po ni spyi lo'i sngon gyi me yos ( 1 2 6 ) lor spo bo'i yul du 'khrungs/( rang lugs) da dung bzhed pa gzhan yod la lhag par du bon lugs ltar na 'di las lo mang pos snga/ chung nas dpa' rtsal sogs gzhan gyis bsdur thabs bral bas bu spun dang khyim mtshes sogs dbar phan tshun ma 'cham par kong po dang dwags po sogs brgyud yar klung khul du phebs pa rten 'brel 'grig pa'am lam 'gro rgyugs te ( bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther mang po'i nang gnya' khri btsan po rgya gar gyi shwakya'i brgyud pa yin par bshad pa ni rang gi rje bor che bstod byas pa 'ig yin pa de la ya mtshan byed dgos don med) bon shes pa can bcu gnyis te/ btsan po lho dang gnyags/ btsun pa khyung dang bsnubs/ gnya' se dang spo zhes yang 'bangs drug dang /9
lha bo lha sras dang se bon/ rma bon/ cog la bon/ 'ang zhung bon/ mi tshe bon bcas dang mjal bas gnya' la khri byas te btegs nas btsan por bkur te srid khrir mnga' gsol bas mtshan la'ang gnya' khri btsan po zhes btags/ de yang gnya' khri'i byon lam lha ri gyang dor zhes par shod tshul mang po yod kyang don dngos su ri de ni kong ngo nying khri rdzong khongs su yod pa'i ban bon gnyis pa'i gnas ri grags can 'ig yin pa ma zad ri de brgyud nas gnya' khri'i byon pa'i lam bar gyi sa cha dmangs khrod kyi shod rgyun mang po yod/'on kyang lo rgyus ngo ma ni〈yum bu brla mkhar gyi dkar chag 'bring ba'isnya nang / spo bo'i yul na bya mo btsun bya ba'i mngal nas the'u brang spun dgu skyes pa'i chung mtha' u be ra bya ba/ ba'in gyi dkyil 'khor legs pa/ phyag sor 'dra bas 'brel ba/ shin tu mthu che bas yul mi kun gyis spyugs te bod du byon pa'i tshe/ bod rnams rje bo 'tshol ba dang byang lam g.ya' le gong du 'phrad nas/ khyod su yin/ gang nas 'ongs dris pas/ nga spo bo'i yul nas 'ong / da bod la 'gro byas pas/ 'o na khyod la nus pa ci yod zer/ de na re/ nga nus mthu che bas yul mi kun gyis spyugs pa yin zer/ 'o na khyod kyis bod kyi rje e nus byas pas/ khyed rang rmams kyis gnya' bar khri la btegs ces dang / mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul 10
gyis gdon mi za zer ba dang / der 'bangs rnams kyis ji ltar gsungs pa ba'in gnya' bar btegs nas rje ru khur bas mtshan yang gnya' khri btsan por thogs so zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bod kyi mkhar dang po/ yum bu brla mkhar/gangs ri'i ljongs su mkhar la snga ba zhes yongs su grags pa'i yum bu brla mkhar ni bod rje dang po gnya' khri btsan pos spyi lo'i sngon gyi 1 1 4lor phyag btab/ mkhar gyi ming la yum bu brla mkhar zer don ni/ mkhar 'di yar klung gi gnas ri jo mo tshe ring mched lnga'i ri rgyud sha ba yum bu'i brla 'dra ba 'ig ge steng du gnas pas ming la'ang yum bu brla mkhar zhes 'bod/ phyis chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos yum bu brla mkhar gyi nub ngos su lha khang thog brtsegs gnyis dang ldan pa 'og thog tu 'du khang dang / steng thog tu chos rgyal lha khang ( thog ma'i gnya' khri'i sku mkhar dang 'brel yod)phyag btab cing / 'du khang ka pa drug gi rgya khyon yod pa'i nang rten gtso jo bo shākya bsam 'phel dang / g.yas su lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan dang / mnga' bdag 'od srung /mnga' bdag khri ral/ blon po mgar ba stong btsan bcas 1 1
dang / g.yon du gnya' khri btsan po dang / rgyal po 'jig rten dbang phyug chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ thon mi sam bho ṭa bcas kyi sku brnyan dang /steng thog chos rgyal lha khang gi rten gtso tsan dan sprul gyi snying po las grub pa'i 'phags pa lo ki shwa ra 'bri srol mang yang don dam du 'di kho na yang dag pa red 'dug g.yas su gnas brtan bcu drug slob dpon nga 'dra ma/ mgon po mkhyen rab rdo rje bcas dang / g.yon du bka' 'gyur cha tshang bzhugs pa'i kun dga' ra ba/ ldebs ris su gnya' khri btsan po gnya' bar btegs nas gdan drangs pa'i lo rgyus sogs bkod yod/ spre'u mi la gyur tshul yang gson nyams dang ldan pa zhig bris yod/de bzhin gnya' khri btsan pos phyag btab pa'i sku mkhar gyi thog brtsegs gnyis pa'i nang du'ang srong btsan sgam pos lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan skabs nam mkha' las mchod rdzas rnams ji ltar babs tshul lha sgrung lta bu'i ldebs ris bkod yod/de rjes rim bzhin yum bu brla mkhar rgya bskyed 'phel rgyas su phyin te thog brtsegs gnyis pa 'phags pa lha khang ge nub ngos su sku mgron bzhugs khang zhig dang / de'i lho ngos su thog brtsegs gnyis ldan gyi rgyal ba'i gzim chung zhig12
de'i shar ngos nas rdo skas babs pa na thog brtsegs gnyi sa yod pa'i dkon gnyer gyi sdod khang dang / rung khang bcas bzhings yod pa dang / lhag par du tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos gnya' khri btsan pos ba'ings pa'i sku mkhar la gser zangs kyi rgya phebs spus legs rnam par bkra ba zhig phub gnang mdzad pas lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i sku mkhar la mdzes sdug 'phar ma 'ig bsnan zhing snya/na grags de bas kun du khyab/de ba'in lho kha'i lo rgyus thog gi grags can mi sna phag mo gru pas rdzong dang ga'is ka gsar du btsugs pa nas bzung yum bu brla mkhar gyi nyer 'khor du'ang ga'is ka kha shas chags pa las/ bsam grub bde chen ga'is pa'i lcam dpal ma mtsho zhes pas rang gi 'khrungs rtags su sman 'dam las ba'ings pa'i sman lha bde bshegs brgyad dang / tshe lha rnam gsum/ rgyal ba byams pa bcas kyi sku yum bu brla mkhar la phul ba ma zad lo rer dge 'dun pa rnams kyi gsol 'ib dmigs rten 'bru khal bcu gsum re 'char can phul ba dang /da dung lcam dpal ma mtsho yum bu brla mkhar gsham gyi lho ngos su 88 me tog rdzing bu ga cos pa gsar du bskrun te yum bu brla r+ya khar la yon chab phul ba dang / maṇ+ḍal gsham sa pa'i bsngo smon byas pas phyis rdzong bu de la na dpal ma rdzing nya 'is 1 3
grags shing dus da lta'ang ma nyams par mjal rgyu yod do/ /bod kyi grong tsho dang po/ yar klung sog kha/de yang yongs su grags pa'i bod kyi grong tsho dang po yar klung sog kha zhes pa ngos 'dzin byed stangs thad spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par yod de/ spyi yi dbang du byas na yul yar rma klung yongs la go dgos/ gang lags she na/ lo rgyus deb ther nang yul la snga ba yar klung sog kha zhes 'khod yod pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang bye brag gi dbang du byas na grong tsho dang po yin na yul dang po yin pas ma khyab pas grong tsho gcig la ngos 'dzin byed dgos stabs 'dir bshad pa'i bod kyi grong tsho dang po de ni yum bu brla mkhar gyi 'ol du chags shing /deng yang 'dren byed yul du rig rgyu yod pa'i mon gre shar pa zhes pa'i grong tsho de yin/bod kyi chos dpe dang po/ spang skong phyag rgya/pur rgyal bod kyi btsan po gdung rabs nyer brgyad pa lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan ( snyan shal) gyi dus su dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes zhes lo rgyus mkhan po rnams kyis mgrin gcig 14
tu smra don ni/ sngar gyi lo rgyus mang po'i nang lha sgrung lta bu'i ngo mtshar che ba'i gtam rgyud bkod yod pa mdor bsdus na/nyin 'ig btsan po pho brang yum bu brla mkhar gyi thog steng du bzhugs dus glo bur du nam mkhar 'ja' tshon rnam par bkra 'ing me tog gi char pa dang / lha mo'i rol dbyangs kyi sgra rab tu gsal ba'i nyi zer bcas dang lhan du nam mkha' nas spang skong phyag rgya dang / mdo sde za ma tog de bzhin gser gyi mchod rten sogs thog steng du babs pa ma zad nam mkha' nas mi rabs lnga song ba na 'dzi'i don shes mkhan 'ig 'byung ngo 'es grags pas btsan pos de dag gi go don mi rtogs kyang gnyan po gsang ba zhes pa'i mtshan gsol te phyag bskor bkur sti rgya cher byas pas/ de'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal po dgung grangs drug cu nas byis pa lta bur gyur te slar dgung grangs drug cu sku bsrings thub pa byung zhes so / / don dngos su spang skong phyag rgya sogs ni paṇ+ḍi ta blo sems mtsho dang lo tsā ba li thi gnyis kyis rgya gar nas bsnams phebs pa 'ig red/15
rbad ljo ngas lho kha'i yu 'a smo ra gronas m+tha ngas ngo spro da wawabod kyi lha khang dang po/ khra 'brug lha sprung /sri 'bru ga lha khang ni spyi 'o 'i dus rabs ba dun pa'i dus dkyil du chos rgyal sro nga btsan sgam pos phyag bta ba pa'i bod kyi ma/tha' 'dul yang 'dul ga tsug lag khang ba cu gnyi sa nang gi thog ma de yin pas bod kyi lha khang dang po de yi na 'ing /da pha na mi 'o chig stong sum brgya lhag tsam/ gyi lo rgyus ldan yo/da la / lha khang 'di ni ya ra klung rte na ga su ma gan sa ga su ma gyi ya gyal 'ig kyang yi na/de ya nga skabs de ra chos rgyal sro/nga btsan sga ma pos ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang bcong sa rgyu'i dgongs bcos yod sta bas btsan po'i bka' lta ra rgya ba za' kong jos sa da pyad ma/dzad cing / spo ra tha nga rtsis brtsis pas rbad kyi yu la ('de srin ro/ gan rkyal du nyal ba'i ga zug sa kyi steng gan sa shi nga / ga tsug 'a ga bang leg sa grub yo nga ba'i rkyen ljog tu srin mo'i tshig sa chen brgyad da nga / mthil ba'i po gnon phyir lha khang bcu gnyi sa bcong sa dgos pa rtsis su babs pa ñca ra btsan pos thog ma ra yar klung du byon te da lta sri 'brus ga nas sa de ra mtsho chung ba 'is yod pa de bsru ba na sa de'i 1 6
steng du lha khang 'ig ba'engs dgos snyam yang mtsho de'i nang klu ga dug pa can 'ig yod pa mkhyen nas mgon po ri rtse'i hro/nga btsan brag phug nang rta mgrin bsgrub par grub rta gas khyad par can thon pas khyung 'ig nga sprul nas mkha' dbyi ngas su 'phur dus skad 'brug lta ra ldi ra bas/ sa ga'i yo r+ya yom du 'gul 'ing tha mas cad rab tu skrag nas a ma ma de ring sngar med bya khra 'dra ba 'ig gis skad 'brug ltar grags byung tshes khug khus gang sar yibs / de nas bya de'i gshog pa lpu gri ngar ma lta bu des klu ngan de'i sbrul mgo bcad pa dang dus mtshung sa ma/tsho yang rang ba'in gyis skam pas de'i steng du lha khang bzhengs pas lha khang gri ming la khra 'brug ces zer ba ma zad phyis grong ming la'ang sri 'brug ces thogs / lha khang 'dzi'i nang srong btsan po sgam po da nga rgya bza' kong jos yun ring tsam bzhugs myong yod pa sa khong rnam gnyi sa po'i gzim khang dang / rgya bza'i gsol tha ba so gas dus da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod pa dang / khong rnam gnyi sa dbyar kha yu ma bu brla mkhar du bzhugs pa dang / dgun kha khra 'brug lha khang du bzhugs kyi yo da pas ngag rgyun du pho brang dbyar sa dgun sa sanyi sa ze ra gyi yod/spri 'brus lha lang gi stan grortsa rdo sku rang byon rgyal ba rig sa lnga ni ma bo na po ri na sa gad na drangs pa dang / da dung 1 7
srid na grags pa'i mu tig 'ang thang dang / sku rgyu dzhai k+ṣim 'a sa grub pa'i slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas/ rin thang bral ba'i thang ga 'tshem drub ma rnying pa sogs deng yang skye bo'i bsod nams 'ing du bzhugs pa lags so/ /bod kyi rdo bgos sku brnyan dang po/rgyal ba rigs lnga/khra 'brug lha khang gi rten gtso rdo sku rang byon rgyal ba rigs lnga de dag ni mgon po ri nas gdan drangs pa 'ig yin la de ni bod kyi rdo brkos sku brnyan dang po de yin/ de yang shod rgyun du srong btsan sgam po'i bka' bkod 'og mi ha cang mang pos ri rtse nas rdo sku rnams 'gyogs khri'i steng gdan drangs nas ri sked tsam la slebs dus tshang ma/ dka' bas mnar te ri sul 'ig nang ngal gso ba'i tshe srong btsan sku ngo mas phyag tu gro so phye mar bsnams nas sa cha der rten gtso'i phebs bsur byon pas/ phyis sa cha der dgon pa 'ig btab pa'i ming la'ang gro so dgon pa zer 'ing / da cha dgon pa bsdad med kyang gyang ro der gro so dgon pa zhes brjod mus yin/de nas mi rnams kyis sa cha de nas rten gtso mu mthud 18
gdan 'dren zhu rtsis byed skabs glo bur du gsung byon te da 'khur mi dgos/ nga tshos 'phur nas phyin chog ces gsungs pa dang gnam mkha' la 'phur te yar klung la bskor ba zhig bkyon nas khra 'brug phyogs su byon skabs bud med dar ma gcig gis mthong bas rdo chen gnam la 'phur ba ya mtshan la tshes smras pa rdo sku gcig gnas de rang la 'khar bas phyis grong tsho de'i ming la'ang lha'i gdong bkag pas 'khar ba ste/gdong 'khar zhes zer gyi yod/de yang rdo sku rnams rang byon yin pas bsnyon du med kyang thog mar da lta'i byon legs po de 'dra med na'ang slar bzo bos brkos pas bzo bo'i lag rtsal las 'das pa 'ig chags zhes grags so/ /bod kyi lo rgyus nang rgyas par grosal ba'i bang so dang po/ 'phrongs rgyas bod rje'i bang so/rtsed thang nas 'phyongs rgyas rdzong khongs su spyi le 2 〈 phyin na 'phyongs rgyas bod rje'i bang sor slebs shing / mi tshos ngag rgyun du 'phyongs rgyas srong btsan bang so zhes zer ba dang/ ma tho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmod 2 76 0 yod/19
de yang 'phyongs rgyas kyi don mkhar mda' dang / smras ( mu) ri'i ri gsham/ 'phyong po'i mda' bcas su yod pa'i 'phyongs rgyas bod rje'i bang so ni bod yongs la snyan grags che shos kyi btsan po'i bang so 'ig yin la rgya khyon yang shin tu che 'ing / der btsan po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan nas glang dar ma bar rgyal ( gdung ) rabs bco lnga dang / de min rgyal btsun dang rgyal blon sogs brgyad bcas kyon mi nyer gsum gyi bang so yod/de dag las yongs su grags pa'i bang so gtso rba srong btsan gyi bang so che shos yin pas der mda' rgyang gang gi rgya khyon yod thog bang so'i sgo gtso bo nub la gtad cing / nang du lha khang chung ba lnga yod pa rgyal ba rigs lnga mtshon byed yin cing / lha khang de dag gi nang du byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba'i sku gsung thugs rten dang / 'dzam gling na mthong bar dkon pa'i nor bu'i rigs/ rin thang dpog par dka' ba'i rgyan gos/ ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i bza' btung rigs sogs grangs kyis mi lang ba yo da pa ma zad khyad par du thun min sa mtho'i khyad chos 'bum gyis phyug pa'i sman snga'i rigs dang / sangs rgyas dngos kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam rdzas sogs mang po yod pas dus da lta'ang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po mchog sku 'tsho dus ba'in nyams med zil pa 20
khrum mer bzhugs yod pa gdon mi za/ zhib phra bang so re re ba'in ngos 'dzin dang / de dag gi dbyibs dang ming sogs lo rgyus thog gsal bar bkod yod pas su zhig gnas der dngos su phebs ma thag lam seng 'grel bshad zhu rgyu yod do/ /bod kyi gzhis ka dang po'i gras/rnam sras gling /rtsed thang nas gra nang rdzong khongs su spyi le 2 〈 tsam bskyod na rnam sras gling gzhis srir slebs shing / ga'is ka de ni gra phyi mon mkhar rong 'os pa'i grong tsho dang nye bar gnas yod pas thog ma'i ming la mon mkhar bkra shis gdong ngam bkra shis rab brtan zhes zer gyi yod kyang phyis rim par ga'is ka rgya bskyed dang nyams gso legs par byas te ga'is ka de rgya khyon che la thog dpang mtho zhing bzo bkod legs pa rnam sras kyi pho brang lta bu zhig tu gyur pas ming la'ang rnam sras gling gzhis ka zhes zer/de yang spyi 'o 'i dus rabs bcu gsum skabs/ sa skya pas yo na rgyal rabs krung dbyang srid gzhung gi rogs skyor la brten nas bod du khri skor bcu gsum btsugs te bod kyi 21
dbang bsgyur go gnas bzung /de'i skabs khri skor phyag mo gru pas rang gi mnga' 'bas su hur brtson dang yar thon gī bya thabs bzang po sna tshogs spyad de dbang cha sra brtan du btang ba dang / stobs shugs je che je cher btang zhing / phyis dpon rdo je dpal gyis phag mo gru pa'i khri dpon byed skabs pho brang sgang dang / tshong 'dus brag kha/ sne gdong / sna mo/ ha lo sgang / thang po che gling smad/ 'phyos gzhis ga mon mkhar bkra shis gdong /rgya thang / lcags rtse gri gu mchod rten gling / 'chad dkar la sogs pa'i gzhis ka mang po 'og brtsigs pa'i nang ge mon mkhar bkra shis gdong zhes pa de ni rnam sras gling gzhis ka yin par bsnyon du med/mdor na gzhis ka de ni rgya khyon che zhing bzo dbyibs mdzes la thog dpang mtho ba/ ga'is pa'i nang gzim chung sogs che chung mang po yod pa smos ci/ bka' 'gyur lha khang dang / mgon khang sogs kyang yod pa ma zad/ khyad par du lcags ri phyi nang gnyis yod pa'i bar la zheng tshad kung khre lnga dang gting tshad kung khre gsum tsam yod pa'i 'obs te chu bskyil sa yod pa sogs sngar yod ji ma ji bzhin bsdad yod pa'i bod kyi ga'is ka dang po'i gras shig yin/22
bod kyi rdzong dang po/ sne gdong rdzong /de yang sne gdong ni thog mar 'bri gung pa rdo rje dpal gyis khri dpon byed skabs brtsigs pa'i gzhis ka 'ig yin na'ang / phyis tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis drag shugs dang thabs la brten nas g.ya' bzang khri skor sogs dbang du bsdus shing / de mur sa skya pa'i srid dbang mgo rting slog ste bod la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dbang cha bzung / sne gdong lte gnas su bzung ste stobs dang ldan pa'i phag gru'i rgyal rabs btsugs te tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan rang ngo mas phag gru'i sde srid dang po byas/ de snga'i sne gdong gzhis ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog kun bzang rtse pho brang bzhengs/ lo rgyus thog phag gru rgyal rabs la sne gdong rgyal srid ces kyang zer ba dang de min shod srol gzhan yang yod/sne gdong rdzong zhes pa'i go don ni/ tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis sne gdong dang / gong dkar/ 'ol kha/stag rtse/ bsam grub rtse sogs rdzong chen bcu gsum btsugs pa'i nang nas thog ma ste/ sne'am sngon shos su btsubs pa'i rdzong yin pas sne gdong zhes zer ba dang de min shol srol 23
ga'an yang yod/phag gru'i sde srid dang po byang chub rgyal mtshan mi kun spyod bzang la / dpa' stobs ldan pa/ ga'an phan gyi bya bar dgyes pa'i sde srid 'i drag gnyi sa la r+ya khas pa 'ig yin pas yon gong mas tā 'i si tu zhes pa'i mtshan snyan dang cho lo'ang gnang /khong gis sa skya'i srid dbang skabs kyi khri skor dang sto nga skor lam lugs med pa bzos te/ rdzong dang ga'is pa'i 'a ma lugs la ga bstar byed skabs sne gdong rdzong ni bod yo ngas su grags pa'i rdzong dang po de yin pas skabs de dus kyi sne gdong rdzong gi lug tshang la deng yang khyim ming lug tshang zer ba dang / rdzong gi mgar tshang la deng yang khyim ming mgar tshang zer ba ma zad/ de dus yongs su grags pa'i gling kha'i ming nor bu gling kha dang zam pa'i ming sne gdong zam pa so gas sngar ba'in yongs grags/ kyis 'bod ba'in yo da do/ /bod kyi dgon pa dang po/ bsam yas/bsam/ ya/sa mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes 'dzam gling yul gru kun tu snyan pa'i 24
grags pa 'brug ltar ldir ba de ni gra nang rdzong khongs yar klung gtsang po'i byang ngos su gnas yod cing / med thang nas lam thag le dbar 4 5 yod pa dang / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad ni med thang dang mtshungs/ de yang bas ma yas gtsug lag khang ni spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus dkyil du btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis snga rjes su sba gsal snang sogs pho nyar mngags te za hor ( bhang ga la) nas mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang / yo rgyan yul ( atru han ) nas slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas gdan drangs te 'dul ba'i lugs su gtsug lag khang dang / mdo sde'i lugs su dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul/ mngon pa'i lugs su ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa dang bcas legs par bzhengs pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus thog sangs rgyas dang / chos/ dge bdun bcas ma tshang ba med pa'i bod kyi dgon pa dang po de yin/lte bar gnas pa'i btsug lag khang ge dbu rtse rigs gsum las/ 'og khang bod lugs kyi khyad chos ldan pa la rten gyi gtso bo jo bo byang chub chen mo rdo sku rang byon/ bar khang rgya nag gi khyad chos ldan pa la rten gyi gtso bo gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ steng khang rgya gar gyi khyad chos lda na pa la rtsen gyi satso bo sa ngas rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bcas rang rang 'khor dang bcas pas yo ngas su bskor ba dang / de'i 25
steng tsan dan lha khang nang bstan pa'i srog shing ste/ tsa ri ma mkha' 'gros gdan drangs pa'i tsan dan gyi ka ba sogs byin rlabs kyis tshan kha 'bar zhing / ngo mtshar sgyu rtsal gyis phyug pa'i rtse mor sa le sbram gyi rgya phebs kyi 'od mdangs phyogs bcur 'phro ba zangs mdog dpal gyi ri dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po de'i khor mo yug tu gling bzhi dang gling phran brgyad kyis legs par brgyan pa'i gling chen bzhi las/shar sgo 'jam dpal gling ni chos bshad khrid byed sa'i gling yin pa dang lho sgo rta mgrin gling ni sdig pa bshags par byed sa'i gling / nub sgo byams pa gling ni gang zag khyad 'phags can la lung ston pa'i gling / byang sgo sems bskyed gling ni byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gling yin pa dang / gling phran brgyad las/ dang po rnam dag khrims khang gling ni sad mi bdun thog mar rab tu byung ba'i gnas/gang zag 'dul khrims sdom pa len sa'i gnas yin pa dang /gnyis pa brda sbyor tshang mang gling ni dge 'dun zas kyis 'tsho bar byed pa'i gling / gsum pa bdud 'dul sngags pa gling ni 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs rnam dkar gyi bya ba bsgrub par bar chad srung ba'i gling / bzhi pa sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling ni sam skri ta'i skad sogs bod yig la bsgyur sa'i gling / lnga 26
pa lung bstan be tsa gling ni chos rnams theg pa rim par 'byed pa'i gling / drug pa mi g.yo bsam gtan gling ni ting 'dzin bsam gtan sgom sgrub byed pa'i gling / bdun pa rin chen sna tshogs gling ni byang chub smon pa sems bskyed byed pa'i gling / brgyad pa pe har dkor mdzod gling ni rgya bod hor sogs kyi dpe cha grangs med kyi gling bcas yin pa/ga'an yang gtsug lag khang gi g.yas g.yon na nyi ma lha khang dang / zla ba lta khang / de bzhin gtsug lag khang gi phyogs bzhir ngo mtshar mchod rten ba'i ste/ ngo mtshar mchod rten dkar po nyan thos kyi lugs su bzhings pa dang / ngo r+ya/tshar mchod rten dmar po chos kyi 'khor lo byang chub sems pa'i lugs su bzhengs pa/ ngo mtshar mchod rten nag po myang 'das mchod rten sangs rgyas kyi lugs su bzhings pa/ ngo mtshar mchod rten sngon po bkra shis sgo mang lha las babs pa de ba'in gshegs pa'i lugs su babs pa bcas phyogs ba'i'i mchod rten bzhi po ni rgyal chen rigs ba'i mtshon pa'ang yin par grags pa sogs de dag thams cad lcags ri rdo rje 'gros kyis bskor ba'i mu khyud lcags ri'i steng du mchod rten chung chung brgya dang nyer brgyad bzhugs pa de dag re re'i gzungs su sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel re re bzhugs pa dang /lcags ri'i phyi rol du'ang 'bro bza' byang chub sgron gyis 27
ba'engs pa'i dge rgyas bye ma'i gling /( li ma'i gling ) dang / tshe g.yang bza' me tog spro na gyis bzhengs pa'i khams gsum zangs khang gling / pho brang bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis bzhengs pa'i bu tshal( dbu tshal) gser khang gling bcas btsun mo gling gsu ma/da dung gtsug lag khang gi shar lho'i mtshams su bod kyi re chen ba'i'i ya rgyal has po ri dang / de'i rgyab ngos su mkhan chen 'i ba 'tsho'i sku gdung mchod rten dang skar chung lha khang / gtsug lag khang gi byang ngos su tshe yi sgrub gnas g.ya' ma lung / byang shar mtshams su dben pa'i ri khrod mchims phu/ lho nub tu mtsho mo mgul dang zung mkhar rdo'i mchod rten/ gtsug lag khang gi g.yas g.yon du gling ba'i gling phran nang ma tshud pa'i rdzogs chen lha khang dang / ngo mtshar thub chen gling / rdzogs chen 'khor chen ma ṇi lha khang /mi pham chos 'dzin gling / chos lung sprul gsum gyi ma ṇi lha khang sogs mdor na bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di'i chags yul gyi mdzes ljongs dang / phyi ngos kyi bkod pa/ nang ngos kyi rig dngos/ lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs sogs yod do cog gzhon gyis bskrun par mi nus pa 'ig yod pas gtsug lag khang 'di ni 'dzam gling yang rtse'i mdzes rgyan gser gyi rgya phebs shig dang gnyis su ma 28
mchis 'es mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas smra bar bya'o/ /bod kyi rab byung ngam dge 'dun dang po/sad mi bdun/bsam ya sa gtsug lag khang bzhings grub rjes chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis sangs rgyas bstan pa gtan gnas dang dar rgyas yong ched mkhan chen 'i ba 'tsho dang slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang bka' gros legs par gnang ste bod yul gyi rje 'bangs khrod nas blo rig gsal la spyang grung ldan pa'i bu slob bdun te/ sba gsal snang dang / rbardar/pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs / lha lung rab 'byor dbyangs/ rma ban rin chen mchog lha srung byang chub rgyal ba bcas bdams nas mkhan chen 'i ba 'tshos mkhan po dang / e rgyan pad ma/ 'byung gnas kyis slob dpon mdzad de bar khang g.yu shal ( 'al ) mthil du thog mar rab tu byung bas khong rnams ni bod kyi rab byung ba'am dge 'dun dang po yin pas kun gyis sad mi bdun ches bsngags brjod kyi me tog dang / dad pa'i me tog dus da lta 'ang gtor bzhin mchis/29
de yang sad mi bdun ni rbad kyi rab tu byung ba dang po yin pa ma zad phul du byung ba'i lo tsā ba bdun yang yin pas skabs de dus khong rnam pas rgya gar gyi bi ma la mi tra sogs dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ga'an dang mnyam du sangs rgyas kyi chos gzhung mang po bsgyur te nang bstan dar rgyas yong rgyur bla na med pa'i legs skyes phul yod/bod kyi dkar yol dang po/ dar tsho/bod rje 'dus srong mang po je thengs shig snyun ga'i drag pos gtses kyang skabs de dus bod na sman dpyad kyis bcos thabs gzhung lugs dang lag rtsal med pas sku ngal gsos nas bzhugs bzhin pa'i skabs/ pho brang gi pu shu'i zur na bya yid du 'ong ba sngar mthong myong med pa 'ig gis kha na shing phra lo 'dab dang bcas pa 'khyer nas skad snyan sgrog cing shing lo sa la g.yugs/ rgyal pos shing lo de'i ro bcud myangs pas snyun las grol bar brten blon 'bangs rnams la de lta'i shing lo zhig 'tshol dgos pa'i bka' phab 'bras su rgyal por snying nye ba'i blon po zhig gis bod kyi sa cha brgal nas rgya nag gi sa cha nas ja shing ngam ja lo drangs pas rgyal po'i thugs shin tu dgyes te/ kho la bya dga' chen po gnang ba dang dus 30
mtshungs btsan po'i 'al nas 'di ni btung ba'i mchog gyur cig yin pas nga tshor yod pa'i gzi dang / mchong / gser/dngul sogs kyi 'thung snod 'al skyogs ma yin par sngar med pa'i snod chas shig nges par du 'tshol dgos/ de'ang go thos su rgya nag rgyal po la dkar yol zer ba 'ig yod pa red zer gyi 'dug pas de bzo ba'i lag rtsal nges par du slob dgos zhis gser yig pa 'ig btang bas rgya nag rgyal pos da phan bod la sman rtsis dang bzo gnas/ rol dbyangs sogs slob mkhan rim par btang zin/ da res ngas bsam na bod yul du dkar yol bzo ba'i rgyu cha yod srid pas nga tshos lag rtsal byang chub pa'i bzo bo kha shas btang chog ces gsungs pa ltar/dkar yol bzo mkhan lag rtsal pa zhig gtong gnang mdzad pa bod du 'byor rjes bod kyi btsan pos dkar yol bzo bar rgyu cha ji 'dra dgos sam/ zhes bka' 'dri gnang bar lag rtsal pa des rgyu cha rab ni rin po che'i 'ching bu dang / 'bring ni 'dzeng / tha ma rdo dkar pos kyang rung ngo zhes bshad pa ltar rgyu cha sna kha gsum gra sgrig byas te lag rtsal par sprad/ de nas lag rtsal pa des dkar yol gyi bzo lta dang ri mo sogs ji 'dra thig bzo dgos sam zhes zer bar btsan pos nges par du rgya nag tu'ang med pa'i dkar yol bod kyi khyad chos ldan pa cig bzo dgos te/ bzo lta ni kha g.yer ba/ srab pa/31
mdog dkar la 'jam pa/ sngo 'ing dwangs pa 'ig dgos pa dang / de ni bod du sngar med pa thig dar bas dar thes dang /snod de las tshe dang dpal 'byor 'phel bar byed pas na tshe zhes yig 'bru gnyis zung 'brel gyis dar tshe zhes ming du brjod/ gzhon yang dkar yol gyi ri mo ni/ bod kyi dkar yol de thog mar 'dab chags kyis shing lo 'khyer yong ba rkyen byas pa yin pas/ dkar yol rab de'i nang du kha la shing lo 'khyer ba'i bya re dang / 'bring la chu nang nya rtsen pa re/ tha ma la spang ri dang sha ba re 'bri dgos la/ da dung dkar yol dkyus ma rnams la lag rtsal pa'i 'dod mos ltar ri mo bris na 'grig gsungs pa ltar lag rtsal pas rgyu cha bzang ngan dang dwangs snyigs phye nas/ dar tshe rigs mi 'dra ba drug bzos pa'i nang gi btsan pos bka' gnang ba gsum po la/ yab tshe/ lan tshe/ shang tshe zhes ming btags pa dang / de min dkyus ma gsum po la/ theg tshe/ des tshe/ rdo tshe zhes ming btags/dkar yol de rigs ni grangs 'bor nyung 'ing / rgyu cha legs la bzo spus gtsang bas rgya nag tu med pa'i dkar yol rtsa chen 'ig yin la/ dkar yol bzo sa ni 'phyongs rgyas sol nag thang po cher yin zhing / yul de'i ming la sol nag thang po che zer don yang dkar yol bzo dus bsregs rdzas kyi 32
sol nag phung po gang sar spungs bzhag yod stabs sngar gyi yul ming thang po che zhes pa'i thog mar sol nag ces bsnan pa pha gtam bu 'jags su gyur ro/ /bod kyi lha mo dang po/ spun bdun 'bag dkar po/lha mo ni 'dzam bu'i gling la gcig kho na las med pa'i bod sa mtho'i khyad chos 'bur du thon 'ing / ngo mtshar yid dbang 'phrog pa'i 'khyab ston sgyu rtsal 'ig yin/ de ni thog mar bod kyi gna' bo'i 'grim 'grul bya gzhag la mdzad rjes shin tu che ba'i grub chen thang stong rgyal pos spyi lo'i dus rabs bco brgyad par bod kyi srol rgyun dmangs khrod gzhas ma gtam 'bras dkar gyi rmang gzhi'i thog gsar gtod mdzad pa zhig red/skabs de dus thang stong rgyal pos lcags zam bskrun phyir gang sar slong mor byon nas 'phyongs rgyas khul du phebs skabs khong gis thugs la da lta'i slong mo bya thabs 'dis lcags zam skrun thabs bral bas da ko dmangs khrod zlos gar tshogs chung zhig sgrig 'dzugs kyis 'khyab ston byas te 'al 'debs slo nga na legs snya ma pa'i dgongs ga'i khyad par can 33
'igro 'khrungs pas thog mar 'phyongs rgyas yul nas skye 'bras mtshar zhing gzugs dpyad legs pa'i bu mo bdun 'dems rjes de dag la khong rang nyid kyis dmangs sgrung rmang gzhir byas pa'i 'khrab gzhung dang / 'bras dkar rmang ga'ir byas pa'i 'bag dang kha bshad/ mda' 'phen pa dang / spun 'khel ba/ ma ṇi bskor ba bcas rmang gzhir byas pa'i stangs stabs gas ra rtsom gnang ba dang dus mtshungs nang sbyong gzab nan gyis 'khyab ston thengs dang po gnang dus mi tshang ma hang sang nas a tsi/ nam mkha'i lha mo sa gzhir byon pa min nam zhes smras pas 'khrab ston sgyu rtsal 'di'i ming la'ang lha mo zhes pha gtam bu 'jags su gyur/de rjes 'khrab ston gyi dgos mkhor ga'igs nas mi sna gsar pa rngon pa dang rgya lu kha snon mdzad pas mi sna'i thad khyim tshang zhig gi pa pha dang / a ma/ bu bcas 'dzoms pa dang / sgyu rtsal thad ches phul du byung zhing thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i lha mo zhig grub cing / de nas rim bzhin 'bag dkar po'i lha mo bod kyi sa phyogs gzhan du'ang dar ba de dag spyi ming bkra shis zhol pa lha mo zhes 'bod pa ma zad lha mo'i grub mtha' 'dra yang 'bag gi tshon mdog bsgyur ba'i 'bag ser po'i lha mo thig kyang dar/dus mtshungs shangs pa dang / rgyal mkhar ba/ phyis kyi 34
skyor mo lung pa sogs 'bag sngon po'i lha mo de bas bod ljongs yongs su sa khyab rdo khyab tu dar ba de dag gi rnam thar snyan zhing / stangs stabs 'gying 'ing 'khrug la sna kha mang ba zhig yod/de bzhin lha mo'i 'khyab gzhung thad la'ang de sngon dmangs sgrung nas gom gang mdun spos kyis〈chos rgyal nor bzang〉dang〈pad ma 'od 'bar〉〈dri med kun ldan〉 〈'gro ba bzang mo〉〈gcen gcung don yod don grub〉〈gzugs kyi nyi ma〉〈rgya bza' bal bza'〉〈sna nga sa 'od 'bum〉bcas lha mo'i 'khyab gzhung chen po brgyad 'khyab ston byed pa ma zad〈rgyal po sprin gzhon gyi rtogs brjod〉sogs 'khyab ston byed mkhan lha mo tshogs pa'ang re gnyis yod/mdor na spun bdun 'bag dkar po ni bod kyi lha mo'i dang po yin par bsnyon du med la/ spun bdun zhes pa ni thog mar bu mo spun bdun gyis 'khyab ston byas pas ming de ltar thogs pa ma zad kho tshos lha mo sbyangs sa'i grong tsho der yang sngar nas da bar spun bdun grong zhes 'bod ba'in lags/'on kyang 'ga' 'ig gis rgyal mchog lnga pa'i skabs su spun bdun 'bag dkar po byung zhes brjod kyi 'dug pa de ni go nor shor ba zhig te/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rgyal mchog lnga 35
pas khong rang nyid kyi pha yu la gyi lha mo spun bdun la rgyab skyor dang legs sgrig mdzad pa ma zad lha mo de ni ches bkra shis pa 'ig la brtsi gnang mdzad de lha sa'i zho ston tshugs khar rtse po ta lar lha mo gzigs phud 'bul skabs sogs spun bdun lha mo thengs dang po 'khya ba bcug gnang mdzad pas de dus spun bdun lha mo dar rgyas su phyin pa las thog ma'i 'byung khungs ni grub chen thang stong rgyal pos gsar gtod mdzad pa de rang yin/ / / /
gsum pa/ yan klung rten gsum gnas gsum mjal 'dod na/ sku nyid bstan pa'i gnas phyogs lho khar phebs/yar klung gnas gsum/bya sa lha khang kebya sa lha khang ni sngar lho gnas la phebs mkhan tshos thog mar mjal dgos pa'i gnas kyi dang po de yin pas 'di la yar klung gnas sgo zhes kyang zer/lha khang 'di dus rabs bcu pa'i nang ma nga' bdag 'od srung gis rgyu sbyor mdzad de btab pa dang / de rjes khong gis 'gro song phon chen btang nas bzhengs pa'i lha khang gi rten gtso rgyu li las grub pa'i rnam par snang mdzad de ni da bar bod kyi sgra ma'i sku'i nang nas che shos de yin par mkhas pa rnam/sa bcod pa mthun/lha khang 'dir ga'an dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos shig 37
yod pa ni/ khang pa'i rtsa ba phra 'ing rtse mo sbom pa de yin/ de la 'grel bshad sgrung thung snyan po zhig shod rgyu yo da pa ste/sngar lha khang 'di bzhings skabs shing bzo ba dang rdo bzo ba 'cham mthun de tsam ma byung bar brten rdo bzo bas ched du rtsig nga phyi ngos la rgya che ru che ru btang nas shing bzo bas tshad brgyab ste bzos zin pa'i gdung mas mi snyobs pa bzos/'on kyang shing bzo ba de'ang spyang grung ldan pa zhig yin pas khos lam seng rtsig pa'i nang ngos phyogs gnyis nas gdung tshab re re btang bar brten rdo bzo ba las rnam par rgyal ba dang lha khang de ya nga ga'an dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan pa 'ig tu gyur/sa cha 'di'i ming la bya sa zer don ni gna' snga mo'i sngon dus bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin zhig bya sa lha khang gi nye 'gram du yod pa'i gling kha de'i nang sngar mthong myong med pa'i bya gzugs mdzes shing skad snyan pa 'ig babs pas yul mi tshang ma der 'dzoms nas bya 'di'i ming la ci 'ig zer gyi yod dam zhes phan tshun gleng ba'in pa'i tshe/ mi tshogs kyi dkyil nas ri mo ba 'ig gis 'dzi ni ri mo'i nang mthong rgyu yod pa'i bya rgyal khu byug ces pa de red ces bshad/de ni khu byug mon yul nas lho khar phebs pa thengs dang po yin stabs dus de nas bzung lo ltar bod zla ba'i pa'i 38
tshes bco lnga nyin bya sa rban pos 'gan 'khur nas gling kha de'i nang gdan lcog dang gro so phye mar/ ja chang 'al tog sogs phebs sgrig 'thus tshang zhu dgos pa dang / khu byug phebs bsu zhu ba'i mdzad sgo gzab rgyas de'i thog lho kha spyi khyab dang / da dung sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus tshab ser skya dpon rigs gnyis kyang lo ltar phebs kyi yod/ha cang ya mtshan che ba zhig la de nyin tag tag khu byug kyang gling kha de'i nang phebs nas shing sdong ring shos shig gi steng babs kyi yod pas sa cha'am grong tsho de'i ming la bya sa dang / lha khang gi ming la bya sa lha khang 'es 'bod/khra 'brug lha khang /khra 'brug lha khang gi lo rgyus gong gas la le'u gnyi sa pa 〈bod kyi dang po 'ga' 'ig〉 ces pa'i nang bkod yo/da pas der gzigs gnang yo/da pa zhu/btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang /btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang t+na spyi 'o 'i dus rabs brgyad par bod rgyal khri ral pa can gyi btsun mo dpal gyi ngang tshul 39
gyis phyag btab pa dang phyis rim ba'in rgya bskyed byung yo da/lha khang 'di'i mtshan la g.yu yi lha khang 'es ze ra bar rgyu mtshan gsum yod pa ste/ sngar g.yu yi rgya phibs yid du 'ong ba 'ig yod pa dang gcig lha khang sga mtha' skor ne'u gsing gis bskor yod pa dang gnyis/ ji skad du ser po'i gser la rin thang yod/ sngon po'i g.yu la rin thang med zer ba ltar bsngags pa brjod pa'am rin thang gi sgo nas btags pa dang gsum bcas so/ /lha khang 'di'i rten gtso sangs rgyas snang mdzad dang da dung mkhan slob chos gsum sogs mang du yod pa dang /yar klung gnas gsum gyi rten gtso sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad yin pa 'dra na'ang/ mi 'dra sa ni/ bya sa lha khang gi rten gco sangs rgyas rnam par m+pi nga mdzad ni li ma'i sku yin pa dang / khra 'brug lha khang gi rten gtso rnam par snang mdzad ni rdo sku yin pa/ btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang gi rten gtso rnam par snang mdzad ni 'jim sku yin no/ / g.yon yang btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang gi mtshan gzhon la sgo ba'i lha khang yang zer 'ing / de'i don ni lha khang gi phyogs ba'ir sgo ba'i yo da pas yin/ da dung lha khang gi rgyab phyogs lha tho gyang ri'i rtse nas bod rgyal dang po gnya' khri byon pa'i shod srol dang gnya' khri'i byon lam rang byung gi rdo skas kyang yod pas btsan thang 40
g.yu yi lha khang dang / btsan thang grong chos bod kyi lo rgyus thog gnas bab gal chen bzung yod/yar klung rten gsum/rten mchog rtag spyan 'bum pa/rtag spyan 'bum pa t+na nad rigs spyi dang khyad par du mig nad la shin tu phan pa'i 'bum pa 'ig yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'bum pa de'i gzungs kyi gtso bor byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i spyan gcig yo/da pas yin/de yang byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu zhes pas ga dus yin na yang 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal la dgongs pa dang / 'khor bar sems gting nas nges 'byung skyes te spyan chab shor gyi yod pas khong gi mtshan la'ang rtag tu ngu cos thogs pa dang / khong gis rtag tu ngus kyang bden pa chen po'i mthus spyan la skyon shor ba'am spyan shed nyams rgyu med pas de'i byin rlabs kyis mig nad can mtha' dag la shin tu phan pa gyur/da dung 'bum pa'i ngos su spyan ya gcig bris yod pa de gi gnas ma jal ba tshos spyan de byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu 41
ngu'i spyan dngos 'a brtsis nas dad pa byas na spyan dngos dang 'dra ba'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i ched du yin/gzhan yang sbrum ma tshos yar klung rten gsum gang la bskor ba mang du bsags na ma bu bde grol yong rgyu phan thogs shin tu che bar grags/rten mchog che chu 'bum pa/'bum pa 'di'i mtshan la tshe chu 'bum pa dang / tshe bcud 'bum pa sogs bris yod kyang don dngos thog tshe chu 'bum pa zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'bum pa 'di'i ngos thun mong ma yin pa'i ( g.yon mi 'dra ba) rdo sgor mo rab tu 'jam pa 'ig yod pa de ni slob dpon pad mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa zhig yin pas sngar rdo de'i ngos nas tshe ring du bsrings pa'i chu ste/ tshe chu chad med du babs kyi yod pa kun gyi mthong chos su gyur ba rang yin/ de yang rang re'i bod kyi gnas mchog mang po chu mig nas skyes pa'am/ yang na brag gseb nas babs pa'i tshe chu sogs sna tshogs yod kyang rdo sgor mo 'ig gi ngos nas chu rtsa gang yang med par tshe chu 'khrungs pa ni bod kho nar 'di gcig pu las med pas tshang ma ngo mtshar 'ing hang sang nas dad pa rtse gcig gis tshe chu 42
'thung gi yod/dus phyis tshe chu 'bum par gtor skyon phog skabs grong mi gcig gis rdo de khyim la 'khyer nas sna tha dbur rgyu'i dbur ga'ong byas pas rdo ngos nas chu skyes te sna tha 'dam bag chags pa ni nye dus kyi lo rgyus dngos yin/da cha rdo de rang gnas su bskyal yang skabs 'gar ma gtogs tshe chu babs kyi med kyang gang ltar tshe chu 'bum par bskor ba bsags na mi tshe ring du 'gro nges red ces gang sar rlung ltar grags pas rgyun du bskor ba bsags mkhan sa phyogs ga sa gang nas yong dang yong ba'in yod/rten mchog dgon thang 'bum pa/dgon thang 'bum pa'i snga ming la sgrib sel 'bum pa zer zhing / 'bum pa 'di gnas sa'i sa char byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel gyi phyag gnas phog yod pas 'bum pa 'dir bskor ba bsags na las kyi sgrib pa dang /shes bya'i sgrib pa/ nyon mongs kyi sgrib pa ma lus sel bar grags pas byin rlabs che ba'i tshad du 'jog da dung rgya che'i dad ldan mang tshogs tshos rang la nad sgrib byung dus 'bum pa 'dir bskor ba bsags na bla ma rtsa chen 'ig la byabs khrus 43
zhus pa dang khyad par mi 'dug ces gleng mkhan mang /da dung sbrum mas bskor ba bsags na ma bu bde grol yong ba dang rgan rgon tshos bskor ba bsags na gzhon bzo dod du 'gro ba/ pho gzhon tshos bskor ba bsags na dpa' stobs che tu 'gro ba/ mo gzhon tshos bskor ba bsags na rnam pa mdzes su 'gro ba sogs shod srol mang po yod pa de dag thams cad sgrib pa sel ba'i nus pa las byung ba sha sta pa/] lags/yang dgon thang 'bum pa'i mtshan 'bri srol ga'an 'ig yod pa ni/ rgod thang 'bum pa zhis pa de yin/ rgod thang 'bum pa zhes pa'i mtshan 'grel ni/ rgod thang zhes pa ni sngon tshong dpon nor bu bzang po sa 'dir phebs nas chibs rta chad de ngal gso bzhin bzhugs pa'i skabs chibs rta'i steng na rgod gcig babs par tshong dpon rnam rtog 'khrungs nas de mar mda' 'ig 'phangs pas rgod la phogrgod kyis mda' 'khur nas shel brag rgod tshang du song yang mda' 'khar nas rgod tshang nang 'dzul ma thub par bsdad yod pa shel brag dkon gnyer gyis gzigs nas mda' tshur 'then gnang mdzad pas rgod nang du thar/ dkon gnyer gyi mda' de shel brag phug gi sgo steng du gzer nas ba'agdus nam zhig song rjes tshong dpon nor bu bzang po 44
shel brag tu phebs skabs rang nyid kyi mda' de gzigs pas nges 'byung drag po skyes te sdig bshags kyi ched du rbod thang 'bum pa ba'engs/ tshong dpon gyi bla g.yu shin tu che ba bya ne tso'i gzugs phung tsam yod pa de'ang 'bum pa'i gzungs su phul bas de nas bzung rgod thang 'bum pa zhes zer/ mdor na rtag spyan 'bum pas mig la phan pa dang / tshe chu 'bum pas tshe tshad 'phel ba/ dgon thang 'bum pas sgrib pa sel ba bcas 'bum pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal gyi phan yon nam khyad chos re yod pas 'bum pa de gsum la yar klung rten gsum zhes grags so/ /yar klung phug gsum/ras chung phugbrag phug 'di'i nang spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang mi la ras pa'i slob ma ras chung gis sgom sgrub gnang myong ba dang / mi la zhes pa ni rus ming dang ras pa zhes pa mtshan dngos te/ sku la ras gos rkyang pa gsol mkhan bka' brgyud pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'ig la zer/ ras chung zhes pa ni ras pa chung ba'i don yin te/ mi la ras pa'i 45
slob ma yin pas de ltar 'bod/de yang sngar brag phug 'di'i nang ras chung sgom sgrub gnang skabs lha mo dbyangs can ma dngos su zhol gzigs nas sku yi dngos grub thob par brten sku gzugs shin tu mdzes par gyur/de dzes khong gis phyag tu ḍa ma ru bsnams shing / 'al nas snyan po'i gsung mgur len bzhin du sa cha ga sa gang du gnas mjal dang bsod snyoms la phebs/ thengs shig khong rtsed thang grong la phebs dus khyim tshang phyug po'i bu mo 'ig 'o ma bzho ba'in yod pa dang / khong gis de dang nye sar ḍa ma ru dkrol bas ba 'drogs te 'o ma sa la 'bo bas bu mos khong khro'i ngang ras chung brdung bar yong dus khong sku lus rab tu mtshar bas yid dbang 'phrog nas nang du phebs rogs zhes re ba nan po zhus par ras chung gis nga'i bla ma mi la ras pa'i mdun du ngas khyim tshang gi them pa mi 'gam pa'i mna' bskyal tshar zhes gsu ngas kyang bu mo des mi gzhan gyi rogs ram 'og khang pa'i rgyab nas skas 'dzegs btsugs te a na u tshugs kyis thog khar gdan drangs/de nas mo dga' spro'i ngang thab tshang du song nas gsol ja dang gsol chas gra sgrig byed bzhin pa'i skabs der ras chung gis gnas tshul mi legs par gzigs nas rgyab kyi skas 46
'dzegs las babs te nya mgo gru kha'i phyogs su bros/ ras chung gru sar phebs pa dang / gru dpon bsod nams bag gro sogs gru pa tshos khyed rang mgur glu mkhas pa 'ig yin tshod 'dug pas nga tshos khyed la gru gtong dgos na khyed kyis nga tsho'i gru 'dir bstod pa zhig phul dang zhes zer ma thag ras chung gis de ring ras chung nya mgo gru khar slebs/ / gru dpon bka' bzhin bstod pa tshig gsum 'bul/ / nya mgo gru de bla ma'i chos ra 'dra/ / bsod nams bag gro rtsa ba'i bla ma 'dra/ / 'grul pa tsho ni bka' chos zhu mkhan 'dra/ / zhes mgur blangs pas tshang ma dga' thag chod/ yang bsod nams bag gros da 'o na khyed kyis nga tsho'i gru 'dir smad pa'i mgur glu zhig len dang zer bas ras chung gis gre ba sangs tsam gnang nas de ring ras chung nya mgo gru khar slebs/ / gru dpon bka' bzhin smad pa tshig gsum 'bul/ / nya mgo gru de bshas pa'i bshas ra 'dra/ / bsod nams bag gro bshan pa lag dmar 'dra/ / 'grul pa tsho ni sha lug tshe zad 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pas gru pa tsho khong khro bzas te gru ma btang /de'i tshe rtsed thang gi bu mo de'ang ras chung rjes 'ded byed par yong nas nye sar slebs zin pas ras chung gis rang gi rdzu 'phrul la brten nas/ ko gdan gru bzhi ko ba'i tshul du byas/ 'khar rgyug dkar po skya ba'i tshul du byas/ ras chung 47
rang nyid gru pa'i tshul du byas nas gtsang po bde blag ngang bcad de chu pha rir phebs pa dang ko gangan gru ba'i de brdab brdab lan gsum gnang bas sa cha der chu shing 'om bu ha cang mang po skyes pa de ni/ dus deng sang yang 'on gyi mda' na gzhan gang du'ang med pa'i chu shing 'om bu'i gling kha zhig yod pa de yin no/ /be+e ro phugbe+e ro phug ni bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po be+e ro tsa nas ( rnam par snang mdzad) sgom sgrub gnang myong ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can thig yod pas de nas bzung khong gi mtshan brag phug la thogs nas bai ro phug ces brjod/de yang khong 'di gar sgom sgrub gnang nas bzhugs pa slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis mkhyen nas tshod lta'i tshul du brag phug nang gi brag thams cad mar 'bebs gnang bas/ be+e ros phyag g.yas pa dang 'bas g.yon mas phar phud cing / dbus yar skyor gnang ba bcas kyi rang byon yod cing / slob dpon rin po che'ang be+e ro'i mthu rtsal la yid 'phrog nas be+e ro tsa na o rgyan dngos dang mnyam zhes gsungs/48
da dung khong 'di gar sgom sgrub gnang skabs rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos su zhal gzigs pas ngag dang rig pa'i dngos grub thob nas bsam yas su lo tsā ba gnang skabs sus kyang 'gran mi thub pa rig pa'i klong rdol 'ig tu gyur/des na dus phyis brag phug 'di'i nang sgom sgrub byed pa'am/ yang na mchod mjal du rtag tu bskyod nang ngag dang rig pa'i dngos grub thob kyi red ces grags/der ma zad phug 'di'i nang be+e ro tsa nar rgyu pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len la brten nas grub rtags mngon sum du thon te rtsa rlung thig le rang dbang du 'dus/phyis blon chen ngan pa tshos rgyal por phra ma gsol bas rgyal po dbu 'thoms te be+e ro tsa na rgyal mo tsha ba rong du rgyang 'bud du btang ba'i skabs lo brgyad cur slebs pa'i spang rgyan sangs rgyas mgon por be+e ro tsa nas gdams ngag bstan gnang mdzad pa ba'in nyams su blangs pas dngos grub brnyes nas lo brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis son thub pa byung ba ma zad de lor 'ja' lus su'ang gshegs/ga'an yang bai ro phug nang bka' 'gyur gyi cha shas rang byon dang / dam can gyi 'al 'bag rang byon sogs kyang mjal rgyu yod/49
de yang ma ga'i yar klung khul du brag phug ha cang mang po yod kyang ras chung phug dang / bai ro phug shel brag phug bcas la yar klung phug gsum zhes zer don ni/ ras chung phug nang rnal 'byor pa ras chung la sku yi dngos grub thob pa dang / bai ro phug nang lo chen bai ro tsa nar ngag gi dngos grub thob pa/ shel brag phug nang slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas la yid kyi dngos grub thob pa bcas mdor na gong gsal phug gsum nang skyes chen dam pa gsum la lus ngag yid gsum gyi dngos grub thob pas phug de gsum la yar klung phug gsum zhes mtshan gso la lo/ /shel brag phyagshel brag ces pa'i gnas ri khyad par can de ni yar klung ge rgyal sgo nub ma srung ba'i gyad mi stobs chen 'ig dang 'dra la rgyal sgo shar ma srung mkhan ni mgon po ri yin zhis grags/de yang shel brag phug ni shel brag ri bo'i rtse mor ma slebs tsam du yod cing / brag phug 'di'i nang spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad par slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyi sgom sgrub yun ring gnang myong yod pas byin rlabs shin tu che/50
slob dpon chen pos 'di gar sgrub pa gnang dus phyi la mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin ltar 'thibs pa dang / nang du bka' srung dam can bran ltar bkol zhing / gnas 'dir yid kyi dngos grub thob pas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med par gyur/shel brag phug gi rten gtso gu ru'i sku mthong grol rin po che 'dzi nyid ni rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang tshan g.yu sgra snying po'i sku skye chos rje dur khrod ras chen nam/ 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje nas shel brag gi 'dab zhol btsan thang nyang stod sgang du lha mi'i rin chen sna tshogs bzhu btul gyis sku smad lugs su blugs par mdzad pa na/ sku sto da rang byung mkha' spyod nas phebs par grags pa der ( da lta khra 'brug gtsug lag khang gi yang steng du bzhugs) mi lo bdun brgya lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus yod/g.yon yang shel brag grwa tshang ni thog mar chos rje dur khrod ras chen nas phyag btab cing / sngar gling ras bka' brgyud sngags dgon yin pa la/ rgyal mchog lnga pa'i dus rdo rje brag gi dgon lag tu gyur rjes de bas rgya bskyed dang ma dzad 'phri na rgyas ngo byung /nang rten gtso bo gu ru'i chos gos nyi zer mar grags pa dang / za hor rgyal pos phul ba'i gu ru'i dbu zhwa dang /51
'bas lham/ bram ze skye bdun/ dung rna can gyi phyag ngar/slob dpon chen pos chang khal lnga brgya gsol ba'i ka pā la yin par grags pa'i a yig rang byon/ u rgyan gyis gzhong pa lha chur ngan 'gro'i rgyu bzang bton pa'i phyag 'khar sogs rin thang bral ba mang du mchis/da dung shel brag phug gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon dang steng 'og tu ngo mtshar can gyi brag phug mang po yod pa de dag nang du'ang sngon byon skyes bu dam pa mang pos sgom sgrub gnang myong yod pa dang / lhag par du yar klung shel brag gi dur khrod de ni slob dpon chen pos dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa zhig yin pas der phung po bskyal na ngan song las thar te mtho ris gnas su 'phos pa ni lo rgyus las bsam yas mchims phu yar klung shel gyi brag yer pa zla ba phug bcas dur khrod gsum/ rgya gar bsil ba tshal dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ phung po bor na mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs/ zhes gsal ba ltar ro/ / / /52
bzhi pa/ dang byung yid 'phrog ri chud gzigs 'dong na/ sku nyid ngo mtshan mjes ljongs lho khar phebs/gar 'brog g.yu mcho/brjid chags hi ma la ya'i mu khyad lhun po'i khrod na ngo mtshar dpog dka' ba'i gnas shig tu/ mdzes sdug yid dbang 'phrog pa'i lha mtsho zhig yod pa de ni snyan grags kun tu khyab pa'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho zhes pa de yin/de yang yar 'brog g.yu mtsho ni bod ljongs lho kha sa khul gyi sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs su gnas shing / bzo dbyibs ni 'jigs su rung ba'i 'bu srin sdig pa ra tsa dang 'dra la/ lho zheng che la byang ngos gu dog pa dang mtsho brgyud du mcho log sdom gyi lug lag brkyangs pa ltar chags/ mtsho'i dkyil lam nang du gling phran 2 1 yod pa'i nang gling phran gsum gyi steng —— dgon pa yodatshogadangan gling5gyod gnyi ngaljokhathadaso sor yul mi dud tshang bcu grangs re gnas shing / de min gyi gling 53
phran ni mi med bya yi gling phran yin pa dang / gling phran de tsho'i thog bya rigs sna kha 'dzoms shing / bya grangs ha las dgos pa mang po yod stabs dpyid ka gling phran thog bskyod tshe bya yis nam mkha' bsgribs pa dang / sgo ngas rkang pa 'dzugs sa med pas der bya yi 'jig rten dang / sgo nga'i rgya mtsho zhes zer ba dang / da dung gling phran de dag gi thog rang byung nyi gdugs lta bu'i shug pa sogs shing rigs dang sgyu rtsal mkhas pas ched du bzos pa lta bu'i pha bong ngo mtshar can mang po yod/mtsho 'di'i ming la yar 'brog g.yu mtsho zhes zer ba'i yar 'brog ni mtsho gnas yul sa cha'i ming yin pa dang /g.yu mtsho ni mtsho mdangs rin chen g.yu ltar sngo bas sam yang na mtsho 'di rin chen g.yu ltar rin thang bral ba'i gnas mtsho rtsa chen 'ig yin pas de ltar brjod/mtsho 'di'i nang nya rigs ha cang mang bas gal te mtsho chu gtsang 'then byas na nya yis mtsho mthil mthug tshad spyi khre 2 tsam zin thub la/ mtsho lag nang du sbar nyul byas na'ang nya 'dzin thub pa ni khyed kyis dngos su gzigs na gzhi nas yid ches thub/da dung mtsho 'di'i nang la 'gron bu'i rigs dang /sbal pa'i rigs/ gzhan yang ming mi shes pa'i srog chags 54
chung 'bring mang po yod pa ma zad ya mtshan can gyi gcan gzan dang / mtsho rta mtsho glang sogs yod pa'i shod srol kun tu khyab/de bzhin yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i nye 'khor du cung che ba'i mtsho'am mtshe'u lnga yod pa'i nang nas che shos phu ma g.yu mtsho la rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 2 2 4yod pa dang chung shos grems mtsho la rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 2 rolas med cing / da dung mtsho'i g.yas g.yon du skar ma gling ( dkar mo) rtswa thang dang / sba chod rtswa thang / gnam rgya rtswa thang sogs mu'u khri brgal ba'i grags can rtswa thang gcig las gcig che ba dang /gcig las gcig mdzes pa yod pa de dag gi thog phyugs rigs nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar mang zhing / me tog mig gi bdud rtsi ltar mdzes pa/ da dung rtsa che'i srog chags rkyang dang / gnyan/ gzig sogs dang / de min chung gras g.yi dang / spyang ki/ gla ba/ dgo ba/ 'phyi ba/ khrung khrung /ngang pa sogs rang byung srog chags kyi ra ba 'ig lhun gyis grub yod/gzhan yang yar 'brog g.yu laṃ tsho'i mdzes ljongs khul du gangs ri ha cang mang po yod pa de dag ni g.yu mtsho'i chu'i 'byung khungs gtso bo yi na zhing / de min dbyar dus lung shur ga sa ga nas rgyug chu g.yu mtsho'i nang babs kyi yod/55
gangs ri de dag nang nas grags che shos gnod sbyin gang bzang yin 'ing / der mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre7 2 0 6yod pa dang / la rtser lo hril po gangs mi bzhur ba dang / la skyed du mtshe'u gnyis yod thog rbab chu 'ga' zhig yod pa gang spug lung shur brgyud nas babs shing /rbab chu che shos shig yod pa der mtho tshad spyi khre 6 4dang / chu che shos kyi skabs kha zheng spyi khre 1 0 zin gyi yod pas rbab chu thur du rgyugs skabs 'brug ltar bsgrags shing / blta ba'i tshe mdzes sdug ngoms pa med pa 'ig yod/da dung yar 'brog mdzes ljongs khul du dgon pa cung mang po yod pa dang / mang che ba rgyab ri la bsnyes shing mdun mtsho dang thag nye sar yod/ dgon pa de dag nang nas grags che shos ni bsam sding dgon pa yin pa dang / bsam sding dgon pa ni sna dkar rtse rdzong nas lam thag spyi le lnga tsam gyi sar gnas shing / spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi'i dkyil du bskrun pa 'ig red/ dgon pa der spyir na bud med bla mas bdag skyong gnang gi yod pa dang / da bar sku phreng bcu gnyis byung yod pa mtha' dag bud med bla ma yin pas de 'dra bod kyi chos lugs grub mtha' khag nang 'di kho na las med/ da lta'i dgon bdag bla ma ni bsam sding rdo rje phag mo yin pa dang / khong gis de snga rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 56
'thus tshogs kyi kru'u ren sku gzhon dang / srid gros kyi kru'u 'i sku gzhon sogs gnang myong yod/mdor na yar 'brog g.yu mtsho ni bod kyi grags can mtsho ba'i'i ya gyal zhig yin pa dang / yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i mdzes ljongs khul ni ches ngo mtshar ldan zhing / ya mtshan dpog dka' ba 'ig ste/ der ri bo'i khrod du mtsho dang / mtsho'i dkyil du gling phran/ gling phran thog tu dgon sde/ phyogs mtshams kun tu rtswa thang dang me tog chu migbya rigs/ ri dwags sogs kyis khengs yod pas de ni sa mtho'i mtshe'u dang / gangs ri/ gling phran/ 'brog ra/ chu tshan/ ri skyes srog chags/ dgon sde sogs yul ljongs mang po gcig tu 'brel ba'i rang byung gi mdzes ljongs khyad par can zhig yin/lha mo'i bla mcho/lha mo'i bla mtsho bod ljongs lho kha sa khul rgya tsha rdzong khongs su gnas shing / skad grags yod pa'i sa mtho'i mtshe'u de'i rgya kyon la spyi le ngos snyoms gru bzhi ma 2 dang / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad spyi khre 5 2 0 0 yod cing / mtsho dbyibs ni mi'i ka li dang 'dra la mtsho 'di'i nang nas mtsho mjal sna 57
tshogs bstan gyi yod par brten bod yongs su snyan grags shin tu che/ rtsed thang nas spyi le 2 0 9yod/sngar tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon sogs yang srid ngos 'dzin skabs lha mo'i bla mtsho'i mtsho mjal gzigs nas brtag dpyad gnang srol yod/de yang mtsho 'dir lha mo'i bla mtsho zhes zer don ni/dpal ldan lha mo'i bla mtsho yin pas de ltar brjod/mtsho 'di pur rgyal btsan po'i dus nas yod kyang thog mar gnas sgo 'byed mkhan ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya ma/tsho yin pa dang / khong gis gnas sgo phye ba nas bzung mtsho mjal bstan 'go tshugs/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni spyi lo1 47 5lor sku 'khrungs pa dang /1 5 4 2 lor sku gshegs pas gnas sgo 'bye ba'i dus tshod ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga'i dus 'gor yin nges/ mtsho 'di shin tu gnyan pas 'gram du skad che tsam brgyab kyang ser ba'am gangs babs pa dang / yang na rlung 'tshub drag po langs kyi yod ces kun la grags/mtsho 'di'i mtsho bdag dpal ldan lha mo'i mgon khang 'ig yod pa nam rgyun dam sbyar yin rung tā la'i sku phreng rim byon lo rer thengs re phebs kyi yod pas de dus sgo thengs re 'byed kyi yod/ da dung mtsho 'di dang nye ba'i sar rje dge 58
'dun grub pas 1 5 0 9lor phyag btab pa'i chos 'khor rgyal legs bshad sgrog pa'i dga' tshal bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i dgon yod cing / phyis bsdus ming la chos 'khor rgyal zer/sngar dgon pa 'di'i gtsug lag khang dngos gzhi ka ring bdun cu tham pa/ gtsang khang ka ring brgyad/ sgo 'phyor ka ba ba'i bcas ka ring brgyad cu gya gnyis yod thog dge 'dun zhal grangs mang thing / sngags mtshan nyid kyi phyag len rnamyo/ par dag pas mnga' dwags rgyal gsum 'es pa 'on mnga' ris grwa tshang dang rgya tsha dwags po grwa tshang / chos 'khor rgyal ches bod ljongs yongs su rlung ltar grags so/ /lho brag mkhar chu/lho brag mkhar chu ni lho kha sa khul lho brag rdzong khongs su yod cing / rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le 4 1 0 yod pa dang /mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid 2 2 5 1yod cing sngar shing nags kyis yongs su bstums pa'i mdzes ljongs blta na sdug pa 'ig yod pa la/ phyis slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas yul der byon te sgom sgrub yun ring gnang bas slob dpon pad ma 'i thugs kyi gnas mchog rtsa chen 'ig tu gyur/ gnas 59
'di'i phu na 'od gsal chos rdzong gi lhun po rdo rje phag mo'i rnam pa brjid chags pa dang / bar na gnas mchog khyung chen nam mkha'i rdzong chen zhes pa'i brag ri bya khyung bar snang lding ba dang 'dra ba/ mda' na mnyam med seng ge rdzong chen zhes pa zhabs nas 'gyur med ka ba btsugs pa lta bu bcas ngo mtshar gyi rdzong gsum dang / phyogs ba'ir ring ba'i gnas bzhi/ nye ba'i gnas bzhi sogs kyis khor yug mdzes par bskor ba'i ri dung dkar zhal bug lta bu'i steng du kun mkhyen pad ma dkar pos dus rabs1 6pa'i nang ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i lho brag mkhar chu zhes pa'i dgon pa 'di nyid phyag btab cing / dgon pa'i mtshan la mkhar chu zhes zhu don ni/ gnas mchog tsa ri gnyis pa lha mo yi mkhar chen brag mkhar ba bde mchog rang byon nam mkha' la bsnyegs 'dra'i mdun nas byin can gyi phu chu rgyugs pas mtshan mkhar chu zhes gsol/ dgon pa 'di'i rten gtso o rgyan za hor gyi cha byad sku tshad thog sa gsum pa de nyid kyi gzungs su mtsho nang gu ru khri phrag bcu gnyis tsam yod pas gtsos rin thang bral ba'i sku gsung thugs rten grangs las 'das/ da dung gnas mchog 'di na rang byon gyi sgrol ma nyer gcig dang /de'i mdun du rang byung g.yu'i rdo bcal dang 'dra ba'i g.yu sgrol gyi bla mtsho/ dngul gzhong ja khus ba dang 'dra ba'i 'ing 60
skyong gi bla mtsho/ 'jigs rung mtsho nag gter bdag dge bsnyen smyon kha'i bla mtsho la sogs pa dang / de ba'in mkha' 'gro'i bro rwa/ nam mkha'i snying po'i 'bas rjes/ zab gter gyis yongs su bkang ba'i gter khung sogs mtha' yas pa yod/de dag dang mi ring ba'i sa na gter ston gu ru chos dbang gis gnam lcags phur pa khru gang brag nas gter du bzhes shul yod pas mtshan la'ang lcags phur can zhes gsol ba'i dgon pa khyad par can dngos byon skyes mchog dam pa'i phyag bzo dngos yin pa'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po yod cing / khyad par du gter ston nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi phyag bzo/ zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo sku mdog dmar smug 'al mdangs sna tshogs ston pa des mtshan mo mi bzhin du mngon par rgyu ba dang / dung dkar gshog steng gi dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba khrag dang zhag gis sa rdo snum por byas shing / shi skra ring thung sna tshogs bal 'dab ltar g.yo ba sogs mthong ba tsam gyis sgyi g.ya' ba/ mdor na lho brag mkhar chu zhes pa'i gnas mchog 'di nyid ni gcig nas dad lda na skye bo chos r+ya jal zhu ba'i gnas khyad par can/ sngon byon dam pa mang pos zhabs kyis bcags shing / rang byung sku gsum nor med thugs rten gyis yongs su gang ba/ gnyis 61
nas ljongs rgyu ba'am gzigs skor ba'i mdzes ljongs khyad par can/ khor mo yug sngo ljang nags dang dri com me tog sogs kyis khengs shing / gang sar dwangs chu lhung lhung rgyu ba/gsum nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sprel zla sprel lo'i dus ston chen mo/ sprel gyi lo gtso bor byas pa'i lo ltar bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu nas bzung lho brag mkhar chu'i tshes bcu ches chos lugs kyi byed sgo spyi dang / lhag par du dgon pa'i gar 'cham ngo mtshar yid dbang 'phrog pa la rang ljongs dang nang sa'i skye bo mang po 'ig ngang pa pad mtshor 'du ba ba'in 'du ba ma zad khyim mtshes 'brug pa sogs kyi sku mgron yang lo ltar yong gi yod/yar klung grags can mdzes ljongs khral/yar klung grags can mdzes ljongs khul ni rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 199〈 yig ang 5 1gis yongs bsgrags byas pa'i mig sngar bod kyi rgyal khab rim pa'i gtso gnad grags can mdzes ljongs khul gcig pu de yin zhing / lha sa'i shar phyogs kyi lho kha'i khul du gnas yod/ mdzes ljongs sa khul der phun sum tshogs pa'i mdzes ljongs thon khungs dang de bas mang ba'i gna' shul grags can gyi snyan pa gang sar khyab 62
nas bod lho'i mu tig ces 'bod kyi yod/ yar klung grags can mdzes ljongs sa khul ni rtsed thang grong rdal gyis lte ba byas pa'i sne gdong dang / 'phyongs rgyas/ zangs ri/ chu gsum/ rgya tsha/ gra nang / yong dkar bcas rdzong bdun la khyab yod cing / khyon mdzes ljongs sa khul che grasakhyadang gnas ljongs 5 rol dbye yod / de'i nang rim pa dang po'i gnas ljongs 2 5yod/ mdzes ljongs khul nang mis bzos yul ljongs dang rang byung yul ljongs kyi rigs cha tshang 'ing /de dag gtso bor chu tshan dang / rbab chu/ rdo'i mchod rten/gangs ri/ chus drus brag khung / srog chags/ skye dngos/gtsang po dang mtsho/ spyi tshogs rig gnas kyi snang tshul/yul srol goms gshis/ zhing thang gi mdzes ljongs sogs rigs chen po bcu gcig yod/ gnas 'di ni bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig gi 'byung gnas dang bod mi rigs dar sa yin pa ma zad/ phag gru'i rgyal rabs kyis rdzong ga'is do dam lam lugs thog mar gtod sa 'ig kyang yin/ bod kyi rgyal rabs dang po gnya' khri btsan po nas bstan pa phyi dar bar gsu/ma dang / de nas da lta'i bar gna' bo'i bod kyi dgon sde thog ma bsam ya sa gtsug lag khang dang / thu bod dus kyi btsan po rim byon gyi bang so ste bod rgyal bang so/ bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas byung tshul la 'ib 'jug byed par shugs 63
rkyen dang rin thang gal chen lda na pa'i 'dzugs skrun ke ru lha khang / bod kyi spyi tshogs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs la slebs pa'i bsdus brnyan rnam sras gling ga'is ga bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi mtho rim slob grwa 'ig dang mtshungs pa'i smin grol gling dgon pa sogs tshang ma mdzes ljongs khul nang gnas yod/ bod kyi rig gnas kyi nying khu nyams su myong mkhan gyi yul skor pas gnas 'di ni spro gseng dang / lta skor/ 'ib 'jug bcas byed skabs thog mar gdam bya'i gnas shig yin/ mdzes ljongs khul nang rang byung mdzes ljongs brjid cing yid du 'ong ba de dag ni gcig las gcig mdzes pa ltar du snang zhing / bod kyi gtsang po che thos yin pa'i yar klung gtsang po'i kha rgya che shos de yang mdzes ljongs khul gyi dkyil snying du gnas pa ma zad mdzes ljongs sa khul khyon yongs dang 'brel yod/ lo hril por gangs gsog mi bzhu ba'i yar lha sham po dang 'o de gung rgyal gyis thun min gyi sgeg nyams ngoms shing /sham chu sngon mo shang shang gi glu dbyangs len gyin gna' mo nas da lta'i bar lhung lhung du bzhur gyin yod/ yar klung gtsang po'i rgyud kyi star du chags pa'i nags gling dang 'ing thang mdzes ljongs kyis yar klung gi gna' bo'i sa gzhir na bza' ljang khu 'ig bklubs pas gna' bo'i yul ljongs rnal 64
ma dang rang byung khams chen po'i phang du log 'dod kyi spro gseng par mtshon na/ dgos nges kyi spro gseng dang / myul dpyad/ lta skor bcas byed sa zhig yin/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad ldan gyi skye dngos ha lam sne rigs 4 0 0 0 cha lhag yod cing / grags can gyi sman rgyur rung ba'i skye dngos dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu dang / a bi ṣa/ tang kun/ 'dre tsher ma/ lcum/ gangs lha me tog sogs yod/ mdzes ljongs sa khul nang du rgyal cikhrab rim pa'i srung skyong srog chags khrung khrung ske nag dang / gnyan/ rkyang / gtsod sogs rtsa che'i srog chags mang po yod/yar klung mdzes ljongs khul gyi gnas ljongs mang che ba bod kyi gtsang po'i lho rgyud kyi dkyil snying du gnas shing /gso rlung 'dang nges yod pa dang gnam gshis mi'i lus khams dang 'phrong po yod pas/ krung go dang phyi rgyal gyi yul skor ba'i yul skor bya yul legs shos kyi gnas shig yin pa dang mdzes ljongs khul gyi nang logs su khyad 'phags kyi 'grim 'grul cha rkyen ldan pa dang / 'phrin gtong dang sa bab kyi khyad 'phags ldan pa ma zad/ bod kyi yul skor mchog gyur gyi gras shig yin la/ bod kyi lte gnas lha sa dang mdzes ljongs sa khul gyi lte ba rtsed thang grong rdal dbar spyi le 2 9rolas med cing / bod kyi mkha' 'grul lte gnas che 65
shos yin pa'i gong dkar gnam gru'i 'bab thang yang mdzes ljongs khul du gnas yod/ rtsed thang nas gong dkar bar gyi snum nag gzhung lam de yang mdzes ljongs khul gyi cha shas su khyab yod cing / mdzes ljongs khul gtso bo'i bgrod lam shar bgrod yin la/ mdzes ljongs kyi 'phrin gtong bde po yod pa ma zad/ mdzes ljongs sa khul nang logs kyi rdzong bdun la 'od skud 'phrin gtong shar bgrod thub pa dang sbrags rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi rang mthud kha par yang thogs med bde bgrod thub kyin yod/yar klung grags can mdzes ljongs khul gyi yun ring ba'i lo rgyus dang / 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas/grangs mang ba'i gna' shul/ brjid cing mdzes nyams ldan pa'i sa mtho'i rang byung mdzes ljongs bcas kyis rgyal khab phyi nang gi yul skor ba rnams phebs sgug zhu bzhin yod pas gnas 'dir spro gseng dang lta skor la phebs par dga' bsu 9nu/gnas mchog tsa ri/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas chen tsa ri rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal zhig yin 'ing /66
rtsed thang nas lam thag le dbar 2 0 5 bskyod na chos zam du 'byor bas de ni tsa ri'i gnas mjal 'go tshugs sa yin pa dang / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid 2 2 1 4yod/(gzhan de las mtho ba smos ci) de yang stod grags che ba gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti se/ bar du khungs btsun pa la phyi gangs ra/ smad ru 'gran zla bral ba lho gnas mchog tsa ri bcas bde mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas te/ gangs ti se sku yi gnas/ la phyi gsung gi gnas/ tsa ri thugs kyi gnas yin 'ing / de'ang tsa ri'i gnas la phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa ni/ tsa ri gsar ma tshe ring ljongs zhes pas gcig tsa ri mtsho dkar zhes pas gnyis/ dag pa shel ri zhes pa gsum bcas yod pa de dag gis rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum dang / phyi nang gsang gsum/ sku gsung thugs gsum bcas mtshon yod la khyad par du tsa ri dkyil 'khor re/dag pa shel ri ni tsa ri'i gnas kyi gtso bo/ bde mchog gi sprul pa'i pho brang / byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba 'ig yin pas/ gnas 'di thog mar rgyal ba'i lung gis zin/ bar du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sogs kyi gzigs snang sna tshogs byung / de rjes mnyam med dwags po lha rjer tsa ri'i gnas kyi gzigs snang sna tshogs byung bas gnas sgo 'bye ba'i dus su babs pa mkhyen te 67
