khong gi slob ma'i mchog gyur skyes bu ye shes rdo rjes thog mar gnas sgo phye/de nas rim bzhin 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po dang / 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras/ garma pa sku phreng bzhi pa/ kun mkhyen pad ma dkar po sogs skyes chen dam pa du mas gnas mchog tsa rir 'bas bcags nas gnas sgo gsar pa phye ba dang / dgon pa 'debs pa/ sgrub pa bskyon pa sogs bstan pa spel 'ing 'gro 'don ches cher bskyangs pas da lta'i gnas mchog tsa ri zhes pa'i gnas ngo mtshar can rgya che ba cha tshang bar grub/tsa ri'i gnas 'dir ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i thabs mchog rdo rje'i ri bo gdugs dang nya 'dra ba/ shes rab dril bu'i ri bo bum pa dang pad ma 'dra ba/ zung 'jug dbu ma'i ri bo dung dang pa ṭa 'dra ba/ mkha' spyod ngo mtshar ri bo rgyal mtshan dang 'khor lo 'dra ba sogs bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad kyi sa 'dzin mu khyud du bskor ba dang / de ba'in sgrol ma'i bla mtsho dang / 'od 'bar g.yu mtsho/ bde mchog bla mtsho/ pho brang g.yu mtsho sogs mtsho dang mtshe'u grangs las 'das pa yon chab kyi tshul du dwangs shing sngo thing nger 'khyil ba/ e rgyan phug dang / 'od 'bar mig ra phugskyob chen phug byin rlabs phug sogs rang byung brag phug 68
gnas ri'i gzungs kyi dod du lhun gyis grub pa/ gzhan yang garma pa sku phreng bzhi pas phyag btab pa'i mtsho dkar dgon pa dang / 'brug pa kun mkhyen pad ma dkar pos phyag btab pa'i cig car dgon pa/ da dung rang byung gi mchod rten dang skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi 'bas rjes dang phyag rjes sogs grangs kyis mi lang ba yod pa ma zad ri mo'i lam dang dmangs khrod du sa khyab rdo khyab kyis grags pa'i rtswa klu bdud rdo rje dang / chu 'gro ba 'dren pa gnyis kyi dri tsam tshor yang sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas thar pa'i lam sne zin pa 'di nyid gnas mchog tsa ri kho nar ma gtogs med par 'khums/de yang rtswa klu bdud rdo rje zhes rtswa rigs sna kha gcig kho na min par rtswa dang / me tog bsangs shing sogs tshang ma'i khrod du klu bdud rdo rje yod pas tsa ri'i bsangs sna ni ches rtsa che 'ig tu brtsi ba dang / de bzhin chu 'gro ba 'dren pa'ang chu rgyud gangs sar 'dres yod pa dang / khyad par du r+ya tsho dkar gyi mtsho gong 'og dang / e rgyan brag phug spug gi mtsho/de bzhin cig car dgon pa dang nyo ba'i dwangs bsil chu mig sogros la chu 'gro ba 'dren pa yod thag chod yin pa'i grags pas tshang mas de dag nas chu'i byin rlabs zhus te bod gangs can ljongs kyi sa cha ga sa gar 'khyer 'gro gi yod/ de lta bu'i gnas mchog tsa ri 'di nyid dus nges med du bskor chog 69
cing / khyad par du rta'i lo la gangs ti se bskor/ lug gi lo la mtsho gnam mtsho bskor/(lañcha gangs bskore 'e sa kyang zer)sprel gyi lo la tsa ri gnas bzang bskor/ zhes spre lor tsa ri skor na phan yon shin tu che/ de'ang tsa rir rtse skor dang /bar skor/ rong skor zhes bskor ba che 'bring chung gsum yod kyang mig sngar rong skor ni mtha' mtshams yin pas thad sa med( thad mi chog) rtse skor dang bar skor la phebs pa'i dus tshod ni bod zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga nas bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga bar gnas sgo phye ba zhes dus tshod yag shos yin/mdor na tsa ri'i gnas la stabs bde'i ngang phebs 'dod mkhan nam yang na yul skor spro 'cham la phebs mkhan yin na rtsed thang nas rlangs 'khor chung ba'i nang snga tsam thon na dbong mo tsa ri lho mi khyim bdun nam tsa ri skyes dkar thang( da lta tsa ri shang gnas sa) du 'byor/ nyin gnyis par snga dro o rgyan brag phug mjal nas dgong dro cig car dgon du 'byor/ nyin gsum par snga dro cig car dgon dang chu mig sogs mjal ba dang / phyi dro phebs lam du gsang sngags chos gling dgon sogs mjal nas dgong mo lhun rtser 'byor/nyin ba'i par cung dal po'i ngang med thang du slebs thub pa de ni rkang thang du bskyod pa'i dus tshod med pa'am 70
bskyod mi thub pa rnams la bltos nas bshad pa thig yin/gal srid tsa ri'i gnas mjal cha tshang gnang 'dod na/nyin dang po rtsed thang nas rlangs 'khor chung ba'i nang snga tsam thon na dgong mo tsa ri shang du slebs pa gong dang 'dra ba dang /nyin gnyis par rkang thang du mtsho dkar phyogs su bskyod de nyin bzhi par tsa ri shang du log thub/ nyin lnga par snga dro o rgyan sgrub phug mjal nas dgong dro cig char dgon du slebs/nyin drug par cig char nas tsa ri dkyil 'khor ram dag pa shel ri'i phyogs su bskyod nas nyin bdun la dag pa shel ri 'khor gyi yod na'ang / bud med rnams tsa ri sgrol ma la nas 'gro mi chog pas cig char phyogs su rang 'jags log dgos/de ltar gnas mjal cha tshang la snyan 1 4 nas 1 5 bar 'gor gyi yod pa de'ang rlangs 'khor 'gro sa yod sar rlangs 'khor nang bskyod pa'i dus tshod yin pas gal srid rtsed thang nas rkang thang mar tsa rir bskyod na zla gcig dang phyed ka nas zla gnyis bar 'gor zhes rgad po bskyod myong ba tshos gleng /de ltar tsa ri'i gnas ni lam thig ring 'ing / lam yang bde po med thog dpyid mgo nas ston mjug bar char pa'ang chad rgyu med pas gnas der bskyod par dka' tshegs che tsam yod rung tsa ri'i gnas skor la thengs gcig bskyod 71
thub kyang mi lus shig thob par gdon mi za zhes sngar nas da bar grags pas gnas mjal lam yul skor du bskyod mkhan ha cang mang po yod/sgrags yang rdzong /lho kha gra nang rdzong khongs sgrags shang gi lung phu'i nub ngos ri ldebs su gnas pa'i sgrags yang rdzong ni ches ngo mtshar che ba'i rang byung gi brag phug cig yin/ gnas 'di'i ming cha tshang la sgrags yang rdzong gshin rje rol ba'i pho brang zhes zhu zhing / slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs skyes chen du mas 'bas kyis bcags shing / yun ring sgrub pa gnang myong ba'i gnas 'di nyid ri glang chen 'gying ba'i rnam pa dang mtshungs pa'i ngogs na 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed ma he'i gdong can zhal lhor gzigs pa'i mkhur tshos g.yas su a dang / g.yon du hum gyi rang byon lha shing shug pas mtshon pa/ pad ma dra ba gling gi bkod pa dang mthun pa steng shod bar gsum mchis pa las/stod khang rig 'dzin phug g.yang gzar ngos bgrod skas gdang bu sum cu lhag tsam 'dzegs te ma he gdong can gyi shangs spug nas o rgyan rin po ches kha 〈ma rtse gsum gyis 72
gnas sgo 'bye gnang mdzad pa de nas zhugs pa na/ o rgyan chen po phyag dpung gi rjes dang / 'dre srin gyi gnod pa bzlog ched bzhag pa'i phyag sen gyi rjes/ sdig sgrib dag byed yi ge drug ma'i rang byon/ ma rig mun pa sel ba'i nyi zla rang byon/ mkha' 'gro mnyes nas me tog gi char babs pa'i rang byon/ srin po dom tshang du dam la btags pa'i phur pa rang byon/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gnas pa'i tsan dan dkar dmar gyi skas ka gdang bu nyer gcig pa/ grub thob me long rdo jes gter nas bzhes pa'i gter khung / lo chen be+e ro tsa na'i gzim phug mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gzim phug nang shel gyi ka ba bzhi dang / mkha' 'gro bro rnga rang byon de bzhin ting shags dang / cang ti'u/ mda' mo/ rnga zlum sogs kyi rang byon/ yar thog gi ngos su dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i ma ṇi rang byon/ o rgyan chen pos lo gsum bzhugs pa'i gzim phug mkha' 'gro'i nu ma las babs pa'i tshe chu/ o rgyan chen po'i gsol zhib rang byon/ gzim phug gi nang rten gtso bya ma a krong las grub pa'i slob dpon gyi sku 'dra dang / rgya gar shar li las grub pa'i o rgyan byin can/ o rgyan chen pos sgrub pa mthar so na nas bdud dang dam srin btul ba'i don lnga snod drug gi rang byon/ phyi rol du mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gzhong / mkha' 'gro'i bro rar bal yul mchod rten rnam 73
gsum gyi rang byon/ — mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bro gar sna tshogs rtsed pa'i phyag mdzub kyi rang byung sogs yod/drag sngags phug 'di ni gshin rje'i 'al nang du chags par grags shing / 'du khang gi nang rten gtso bo gter ston rat+na gling pa'i phyag bzo che mchog he ru ka mthing nag 'ag gsum phyag drug g.yas g.yon du gu ru mtshan brgyad dang /rig 'dzin pad ma 'phrin las sogs bzhugs shing / da dung bod khams bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo/ byang gnam mtsho phyug mor gnas kyang / sgrub gnas 'di nyid kyi srung ma gnas bdag tu khas blangs pa'i lha mo rdo rje kun grags ma yi sku gsob sogs yod/zil gnon phug 'di ni da lta brag phug gi gnas sgo 'bye rgyu yin pas ser ga zhig mthong rgyu yod pa las gnas ngo ma re zhig mjal rgyu med kyang phyi nas mjal yang byin rlabs shin tu che/ de yang rdo brag rig 'dzin lnga pa skal bzang pad ma dbang phyug gis zil gnon phug ge gnas sgo 'byed pa'i tshe brag ri sgra chen po dang bcas rab tu 'gul zhing srubs ku'i nang khong gshegs par brtsams pa na gsol dpon gyis bla ma dam pa de na mi gshegs par 'tshal zhes zhus par rten 'brel 'phyug nas sgo ma bye bar ser ga slar yang sngar ltar zum pa dang bla ma'i mthang gos kyi sne mo zhig ser ga'i bar du lus 74
pas phyis su'ang mthang gos tshal pa re gnyis byung bar grags/da dung yang rdzong gnas sgo gsar pa zhes pa'i brag phug ngo mtshar can ga'an zhig yod pa de ni/ rdo brag rig 'dzin bzhi pa blo bzang pad ma 'phrin las kyis gnas g.ya' rig pad ma mtho lcog ces pa nas thang dkar rgod po zhig la sprul nas gnas sgo phye gnang mdzad cing / brag ngos rgod po'i gzugs dbyibs rang byon yod sa'i gnas sgo nas zhugs na g.yas phyogs su lcags kyi shal ma ri dang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil rang byon/ g.yon phyogs su bka' bstan 'gyur gyi kun dga' ra ba rang byon/ de nas rim ba'in song ba na/bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi rang byon dang / dgra bcom lnga brgya'i lhung bzed dang nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad kyi lhung bzed rang byon/ rig 'dzin pad ma 'phrin las kyi 'al dkar dang gter srung g.yu sgron ma'i mchod pa rang byon/ klu bdud nag pos dug sprul du sprul nas gnod byed du 'ongs pas/ slob dpon chen pos mi 'jigs sprul pa'i rdo bsnun te dum bu gsum la gyur pa'i dug sprul gyi khog stod bskal pa'i mar me mchod kong gi rang byon/ gza' bdud khyab 'jug gi rang byon/ shel gyi ka ba stag seng kha sprod kyi rang byon/dpagabasam shing gi 'bras bu rang byon/ dug sprul sked par rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa'i rang byon/ mtsho 'gram du dug 75
sprul gyi mjug ma'i rang byon/ de nas sngags srung e ka dza ti'i bla mtsho glang chen mche ba'i rnam pa can/ steng gri brag ngos su lha mo nyid kyi zhal 'bag la klu rgyal 'jog pos phul ba'i dar dkar rang byon sogs gnas mchog sgrags yang rdzong gi brag phug chen po gnyis kyi nang la ngo mtshar bsam yul las 'das pa'i rang byon gyis yongs su bkang ba dang /phyi la blta bas ngoms pa med pa'i rang byung mdzes ljongs kyis yongs su bskor nas yod do/ /rdzong sku 'bum/rdzong sku 'bum ni lho kha grwa nang rdzong sgrags shang gi shar ngos brag ri'i dbus su yod cing / brag phug khag nang sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi sku brnyan rang byon 'bum gcig yod pas brag phug de'i ming la'ang sku 'bum zhes zer/gnas 'di ni gu ru 'i ba pad+ma sam bha wa'i gsang gnas yin zhing / phyi ngos kyi brag ri'i dbyibs ni dung dkar kha spubs pa dang shin tu 'dra/de yang rdzong sku 'bum du nang gses brag phug ba'i yod pa'i nang nas brag phug 'og ma shar brgyud brag phug dang /nub brgyud brag phug gnyis bzo dbyibs rang byung seng ge'i 76
kha nang du chags pa dang / brag phug gnyis po'i rang byung phyi sgo chen po gcig yin/ brag phug gong ma gnyis las bde chen gsang ba'i phug dma' sar yod pa dang / rdzong pad+ma rtse mtho sar yod/ma gzhi slob dpon pad+mas sa 'dir gnas sgo brgyad 'bye rtsis gnang yang rten 'brel ma grub pa'i dbang gis sgo mo dad log chu srin gyis bkag ste gnas sgo ba'i las phye ma thub pas steng shod gnyis kyi gnas bzhi la bstan pa'i gnas bzhi dang brag khog stong brdungs na rnga ltar grags pa zhig yod pa de la sbas pa'i gnas ba'i zer/brag phug 'o ma shar brgyud brag phug la sgo srung gsum yod pa ni ( 1 ) rdo pha bong stag nyal ba 'dra ba dang /( 2 ) glang chen 'gying ba rang byon/( 2 ) mgon po bya rog gi rang byon bcas yin pa de dag ni slob dpon pad+mas ched du bsko ba'ag mdzad pa zhig yin/brag phug 'di'i nang slob dpon pad ma'i gzim spug byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba dang / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs kyi mdzad shul mang po yod pa ma zad/ khyad par du ngo mtshar bsam yul 'a sa 'das pa'i rang byung ha cang mang po yod pa ni/ shar brgyud brag phug nang g.yas brag dkar po lha tshangs pa brgya byin gyi rang byon dang / g.yon 77
brag dmar po btsan gyi rang byon/ dbus slob dpon rin po ches gnas sgo phye dus dug sbrul tshar bcad pa'i rang byon/me tog pad ma zhal khra pye ba'i rang byon/ dung dkar rang byon/ mu tig dra ba'i rang byon/ mchod pa'i lha mo bco brgyad kyi rang byon/ i a hūm̐ gī rang byon/ mar me rang byon/de ba'in slob dpon pad ma'i gzim phug dang / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gzim phug srin po pho mo'i tshang dus da lta'ang drod rta tsam yod ces grags pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi rang byon mang po yod/nub brgyud brag phug nang / dge 'dun tshogs ra tshugs sa'i chos sgra dang / rnga sgra/ dung sgra bcas nyan sa dang /slob dpon pad ma lha yul du phebs sa'i gsang lam/ mkha' 'gro'i chu skor gyi skad thos pa dang rtsam dri tshor sa/ de ba'in slob dpon pad mas srin po pho mo dam la btags nas gnam lcags phur pa bskyon sa'i rang byon dang / sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rang byon sogs rang byon mang po dang / khyad par du brag phug gi spug tu dmag zor rgyal mo'i bla mtsho dang rnam sras kyi bla mtsho yod pa'i rtsa ba yar klung gtsang po dang 'brel bas gtsang po rba rlabs 'phyur dus kyi bye ma dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa dang / mtsho bdag ni ma bza' rdo gsum yin la skal ldan las 'phro can la mtsho mjal 'al gzigs yong gi 78
yod/bde chen gsang ba'i phug gi brag phug gi nang slob dpon pad mas 'i rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin bsregs mdzad pa dang / sbyin bsregs legs grub byung ba'i rten 'brel la mkha' 'gro pho mos gar 'khrab pa'i sgra snyan dang pi wang gi sgra skabs 'gar glo bur du grags pa dang / 'di na gnas mjal ba tshos kyang glu len gar 'khra ba byed kyi yod/ de ba'in skabs 'gar gnas 'og ma'i mtsho gnyis 'khol ba'i rlangs pa'ang mjal rgyu yod pa dang / mkha' 'gros mche med tshe yi sgrub pa bskyon sa dang / tshogs sha sna kha brgya dang brgyad klu yul nas gter du bzhes pa'i rus pa chung chung deng sus bsngogs kyang sa 'og nas don gyi yod/rdzong pad ma rtse'i brag phug ni mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi 'phyi ba sgom chen la sprul nas gnas sgo phye ba dang /gnas sgo 'di bar do 'grims sa yin zhes pas 'gro khrag po yod/ brag phug 'di'i nang mkha' 'gro'i dbu skra rang byon dang / 'i khro'i lha tshogs 'i ba ba'i bcu zhe gnyi sa/ khra ga 'thung lnga bcu nga brgyad kyi rang byon sogs rang byon mang po dang / zam pa dang rus sbal rang byon gyi 'og tu phyin pa tsam gyis sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa mi yong ba/ mthong grol mtshad rten mjal ba tsam gyis ngan song las grol ba/ byang 79
chub mtshad rten bya rung kha shor smon 'a ma btab tshad 'grub pa sogs gnas byin can mang po dang / da dung gnas 'di spug thag shin tu ring la shar rgyag 'on khyi ra brag phug nang nas don thub pa'i shod srol ngo mtshar can yod pa dang /deng dus brag phug nang khyi dang ra gnyis kyi rang byon mjal rgyu yod/ mdor na rdzong sku 'bum gyi brag phug gi nang du ngo mtshar gyi rang byon grangs las 'das pa dang rtsa che'i gzim spug sogs shin tu mang ba dang / phyi la ri bo lhun grub rtse dang pad ma rtse la sogs pa sngo ljang nags kyis yongs su brgyan pa dang / ri dwags dang gcan gzan sna tshogs ci gar rgyu 'ing ༈'dab chags sna brgyas snyan pa'i gre 'gyur glu dbyangs len pa/brag phug ge sgo 'gram nas dwangs gtsang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun shang shang du babs pa sogs skye bo kun gyi yid brtan dbang med 'phrog pa dang / yid ngal gso ba'i yul skor mdzes ljongs khyad par can 'ig yin no/ /mon yul gyi mdzes ljongs/mtsho sna rdzong khongs su yod pa'i mon yul ni mon pa mi rigs bca' sdod byed sa'i mtha' mtshams kyi mdzes ljongs shig yin zhing / rtsed thang nas lam thag le dbar 2 2 2 yod 80
pa dang / cha snyoms rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid 2 4 0 0 tsam yin/mon yul ni sa bab dma' la char chu 'dzoms pa thon khungs phun sum tshogs shing / ri klung nags tshal dang rtswa ljang me tog gis khengs pa'i mdzes ljongs lta na sdug pa zhig yin pas yul skor spro 'cham gnang yul khyad par can zhig yin/ rags par bshad na mon gyi yul de shar nub gnyis su phye ba dang / de yang rta dbang gi nub ngos skyems stong la rtse ni shar nub 'byed mtshams yin pa de nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud dwags po dang / spang chen/ legs po bcas yod pa de rnams la mon nub ma zer ba dang / shar rgyud du nyi mtsho gsum dang / hro dang byang dwags/ seng ge rdzong dang /gnyug ma gdong sbrang ma chu rgyud/ rong nang bcas yod pa de rnams la mon shar ma zer/ mon yul gyi sa dbyibs zheng tshad chung 'ing ring tshad ches ring ba'i thog byang nas lhor rgyug pa'i nya bshang chu dang / shar nas nub tu rgyug pa'i sbrang ma chu'am rta dbang chu/ nub nas shar lhor rgyug pa'i sbrang nang chu/ byang nas lhor rgyug pa'i rong nang chu bcas yod la nam dus ba'i kur dbye ba chen po med par gnam gshis dro zhing /thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod/ ngo mtshar yid dbang 'phrog pa dang thun min gyi khyad chos 'bum gyis phyug pa'i mon 81
yul 'di ba'in gna' snga mo nas krung go'i bod ljo ngas kyi mnga' khongs bsnyon du med pa 'ig dang kha bral du rtsa ba nas mi rung ba'i cha shas mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin par brten srong btsan sgam pos bod kyi sa bkra srin mo gan rkyal gyi nang du mon yul bkod yod la mon yul du mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang yang bzhengs yod cing / lhag par du twā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i dus nas bzung bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mon yul yongs su srid 'dzin sgrig ga'i dngos su btsugs thog srid 'dzin do dam nus pa thon pa byas dang byed bzhin pa yin la da lta legs po khul la mi rigs shang bzhi dang / don gcod khang gcig yod pa'i sa khongs me tog gi skyed tshal ltar rab tu mdzes pa ma zad lo rgyus dang shod srol ngo mtshar ldan pa'i srin mo brag sogs dgon pa dang / rang byung brag phug dang mtsho dang rgyug chu sogs shin tu mang ba ma zad legs po don gcod khang dang slad shang bar gyi grog shur nang gi brag ngos su rgya nag gi grags can rtsom rigaphunub phyogs su gnas skor bskyod pa'i〉 nang gi mi sna gtso bo/ thang sen bla ma dang /spre'u/ phag pa/ hra shang / rta bcas kyi brag brkos ri mo zhig yod pa de ni ha lam bod yongs su med pa'i rdo brkos sgyu rtsal 'ig yin pa ma zad ri mo de'i 'grel bshad la/ thang sen bla ma 'phags yul nas chos blangs te bod yul brgyud nas phyir 82
log gnang ba'i shod srol zhig kyang yod pas der 'ib 'jug gi rin thang ha cang chen po yod pa sogs mon yul gyi legs po mi rigs shang bzhi dang / legs po don gcod khang khor yug gi mdzes ljongs ni ri mor bris pa ltar mdzes shing yid du 'ong la ngo mtshar che ba'i lo rgyus dang shod srol khyad chos ldan pa'i yul skor spro 'cham gnang yul thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin no/ /gnas chen mkha' reggnas chen mkha' reg gtsang rin spungs rdzong khongs bar thang shang gi shar ngos/ lho kha sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs mkha' reg yul gru'i nub ngos su yod/ gnas 'di ni slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis yun ring sgrub pa gnang zhing /sa gzhi gang sar byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas laṃ chog khyad par can 'ig yin/'di ni slob dpon pad ma'i sgrub phug dang / zhabs rjes/ mtsho spug ces ri bo'i steng du yod pa'i ngo mtshar gyi mtsho/ mtshan rtags zhes pa'i ri bo'i steng du se ba'i sdong po la me tog dmar po shar gyi yod pa de rje btsun sgrol ma'i zla mtshan gyi rtags yin zhes grags pa/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 83
khang zhes ya ngas shing rgya che ba'i brag phug de bzhin gna' bo'i dgon rnying sgrub bde dang / mun dkar mchod rten la sogs pa gnas ngo mtshar can ha cang mang po mjal rgyu yod/khyad par yongs su grags pa'i mkha' reg jo pho jo mo zhes par chos lugs thad gnas 'di mjal na ngan song gi gnas las grol ba dang / sdig sgrib dag pa sogs 'grel bshad shin tu mang ba ma zad/ dmangs khrod ngag rgyun gyi srol yang mang po yod/ de'ang mkha' reg ri bo'i rtse mo'i gtso bo'i ri rtse khag gnyis su gyes yod pa'i jo pho ri bor bde mchog yab kyi pho brang dang / jo mo ri bor bde mchog yum gyi pho brang zhes shod srol mchis/ de yang dmangs khrod ngag rgyun du/ sngar jo pho dang jo mos 'jig rten bza' 'tsho'i 'tsho ba skyel skabs lo gcig gi dgun khar jo mo'i ri rtser kha ba cung zad che ba babs te mgo 'phang mtho tsam chags pas jo phos mig gzer brgyab nas jo mo khyed sngon chad bdag la brtse ba che bas mig gnyis nyin ltar bdag la 'phangs pa las skad cig tsam yang gzhan du g.yo ba ma mchis kyang da lta khyed ske krong krong byas nas ga par blta gi yod dam/ gtan gtan gnod sbyin gangs ba bzang mor sems shor ba thag chod ces jo mor gram lcag me 'bar ba zhig gzhus/ jo mo ngo pho'i ma nyes kha g.yog dang nyes rdung la rab tu khros te jo phor blta mi 'dod par 84
rgyab phyogs te bar thang yul la bltas/ bar thang gi bu rnams byad bzhin mdzes po yod pa ni jo mo'i zhal gyi byin rlabs yin zer/ jo pho sngar bzhin reg yul la zhal phyogs pas mkha' reg gi pho gzhon tsho dpa' nyams ldan la mi spus dag ces grags/da dung jo pho jo mo byang du brag re mthon po rtse mo rab tu rno ba zhig steng brag sho don pa( brag kha sho) ni mda' mo'i ltong ka dang shin tu 'dra ba zhig yod pa de ltar chags don ni/gna' snga mo gling ge sar rgyal pos bdud rgyal khyung chen gang ri ger 'ded pa dang / bdud rgyal khyung chen g.yas bros g.yon bros mang du byas mthar ri bo de'i steng babs pas ge sar gyi mda' mo 'ig drag tu 'phangs ma thag brag ri de kha sho chags pa red ces zer ba la sogs pa'i shod rgyun mang du yod pas/gnas mchog mkha' reg ni gcig nas chos lugs kyi gdan sa rtsa chen dang gnyis nas dmangs sho[ da shod srol gyi deb ther chen po zhig dang 'dra ba'o/ /mtsho rgyal bla mcho/rtsed thang nas spyi le 4 2 bskyod na gra nang mda'i yang kha gru khar slebs shing / de nas glog gru'i nang chu tshod gnyis 85
tsam bskyod na chu phar phyogs kyi sgrags gru sar 'byor/ de na 'khor lam brgyud spyi le lnga dang phyed ka bskyod na mtsho rgyal grong tsho'i dbus su yod pa'i mtsho rgyal bla mtsho mjal thub/mtho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid 2 6 0 0 tsam yod/de yang mtsho rgyal bla mtsho zhes pa ni thog mar gnas der chu mig cig yod cing / spyi lo'i dus rabs brgya/da par grong tsho de na mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal 'khrungs pa dang dus mtshungs chu mig de mtsho ltar rgyas skabs mtsho rgyal bla mtsho 'es pa'i mtshan de ltar byung / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi 'khrungs khang yang de dang nye bar yod/mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yum gza' dge bya ba'i lhums su bzhugs skabs yum la gser gyi bung ba gsung skad snyan pa zhig yab kyi spyi bor thims pa'i gzigs snang byung ba dang / yab mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gi gzigs snang la yum la spyan gsum mnga' ba sogs snga ltas khyad par can mang du byung ba dang bya lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs a li ka sgra'i rang sgra rang byung lhun gyis gsal bar sgrog bzhin du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang /'brug ldir ba/ me tog gi char ga babs pa sogros kun gyis mthong / yab de'ang skyes bu dam pa'i rang gshis tshang ba zhig yin pas brtag pa mdzad mthar rab tu mnyes te nga 86
gnyis kyi bu mo/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags du ma dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pas nar son rjes grags pa 'dzam gling la khyab cing / nyam thag 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon zhig tu 'gyur bar gedon mi za/ bu mo skyes pa dang nged tsho'i chu de yang mtsho ru rgyas 'dug pas bu mo'i ming la'ang yang yis shes mtsho rgyal zhes 'dogs dgos gsungs/de nas bu mo nar son rjes rab tu mtshar 'ing byams sems ldan pas slong mi dpon chen mang du byung ba phan tshun 'khrug rtsod kyi nyen kha chen po byung ste yab yum bya dka' byed gtad du gyur pa'i tshe chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi snyan pa mkhyen te btsun mor bsus /de nas mi ring bar chos rgyal gyis slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs pa dang / btsun mo ye shes mtsho rgyal slob dpon la phul bas slob dpon gyi jo mor mnga' gsol/ de nas slob dpon yab yum gnyis mchims phur byon nas slob dpon gyi drung nas rab tu byung ste sde snod gsum gyi chos mtha' yas pa gas na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i 'al gzigs/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob/ mngon par shes pa mnga' brnyes shing rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med par ston nus par 'gyur pas kun gyis rab tu dad de mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhes grags/ mtsho rgyal bla mtsho'i 'gram gyi mtsho 87
rgyal lha khang nang mtsho rgyal gyi sku 'dra dang / mtsho rgyal 'khrungs rdzes lte khrag 'pho sar tsan dan dkar dmar gnyis 'khrungs pa las 'o ma bzhes pa'i tsan dan dum bu sogs rtsa chen khag mjal rgyu yod/rtswa thang dkar mo gling /bod sa khul yongs su skad grags yod pa'i rtswa thang dkar mo gling ni lho kha sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i nye 'gram du yod cing / mtsho mo'i khor yug tu chags pa'i ri rnams bzo bo mkhas pas ched du bcos pa lta bu'i ri dpyad legs shing / sa mtho'i khyad ldan gyi rtsi shing spa ma rum 'thag mkhas pas sa gdan ched du btags pa ba'in ring thung spu tsam med par mgo gra snyoms pa'i rang byung lhun gyis 'grub pa'i mdzes chos lta bas mi ngoms pas brgyan pa'i ri chung gnyis yod pa gcig gi ming la sdig nag zer ba dang /cig shos de'i ming 'a/ sde rgya ze ba zer ba'i ri gsham du dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu mig cig yod pa de'i lho ngos dkar gling gzhung chu zhes pa'i chu mdog gzhan dang mi 'dra ba chu mo zhig lhung lhung rgyu ba'i nang sna rigs mi gcig pa'i nya mo mang po yar rgyugs mar rgyugs byed pa'i ngo mtshar ltad mo skye bo'i mig 88
lam du 'char ba dang / chu 'gram du bsangs shing 'khan dkar mi tshad lon pa mthug por skye ba'i khrod sems can spu nag g.yag rgan yang gzhan gyis mthong bar dka' ba de lta bu ni bod yongs su ha lam med ces bshad choggzhan yang rtswa thang de ni sa rgya yangs shing khod snyoms la rtswa bcud rab tu che ba ma zad rtswa'i skye kha bzang ba ha las dgos pa zhig yod pa ste/ dgong mo rtswa thang steng ja phor kha sbubs slog nas ba'ag na zhogs pa ja phor rtswa yis bkyag nas gan rgyal log nas sdod kyi yod pas rtswa thang skye kha bzang ba de 'dra bod ljongs yongs su med stabs sngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung rta ched du rtswa thang de'i steng 'jog gi yod pa las/ sems can gzhan dag phar bzhag bya dang byi'u'ang babs mi chog ces pa'i bka' rgya nan po btang yod/da dung rtswa thang de'i mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba'i me tog sna tshogs dang / bya byi'u sna tshogs/ ri dwags dang gcan gzan sna tshogs sogs yod pas rtswa thang de ni ma bcos rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i yul skor mdzes ljongs ches phul du byung ba zhig yin no/ /89
ngo mtshar yid du 'ong ba'i gri gu rtswa thang /bod mi'i 'byung gnas su grags pa'i rtsed thang grong rdal nas lhung lhung 'bab pa'i dwangs gtsang sham chu brgyud lho phyogs su chas tshe srid pa'i la dgu'i ya gyal gangs ri chen po yar lha sham po'i nye 'dabs su 'byor 'ing / de nas nub phyogs su kha gtad de phyin na mtsho smad rdzong gi mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i 'khar zhes pa'i grong tshor slebs/ grong tsho de'i phur bye la zhes pa'i la 'ig yod cing / dmangs khrod kyi shod rgyun du/ sngon la mo de nyid ha cang mtho bas yul de'i mi rnams la mo de bcol nas yul gzhan du 'gro 4'ong byed tshad dka' tshegs shin tu che ba'i gnas tshul de rgya bza' kong jos mkhyen rjes ri bo der gseng kha ( phug lam ) gtod dgongs kyang phyis su rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas gse nga kha gtod rgyu ma byung bar grags shing la de'i rtse mor slebs tshe/ da gzod gri gu rtswa thang de nyid mig lam du khra lam mer mngon thub/rgyang ring nas bltas tshe/ gri gu rtswa thang de nyid rbi rab dkar dar gyi thor lco ga bcings shing sngo ljang na bza' kun nas bklubs pa'i yid du 'ong ba'i lha yi bu ro/ 'ig gis 90
dwangs shing gas la/ ba'i me tog cig phyag tu bsnams nas mi yul du ltad mor phebs pa dang gnyi sa su med/ rtswa thang de'i phyogs ba'i na sheg gyi ma tshad rten bzhengs 'dra'i gangs ri dkar po dang / rtse mo gnam la zug 'dra'i rdza ri smug po/g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal spungs 'dra'i spang ri sngon po sogs tshar du dngar ba'i ri tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / de dag gi bar bar na/ dwangs bsil brgyad lda na gtsang chab kyis bkang ba'i mtshe'u du ma sngo lhem mer 'khyil/ rtswa thang de'i steng na lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i chu phran dwangs mo'i 'gram gyi sngo ljang ne'u gsing thog dkar ser dmar sngo'i me tog khra chil ler ba'ad cing bung ba gcon nus dar dir gyi gshog glu snyan mo len pa dang phye leb bu mos lhab lheb kyi bro gar mtshar po 'khra ba nas skye bo rnams kyi yid kyi brta na pa cig car 'phrog par byed kyin yod/ skar tshog sa sa 'a babs 'dra'i g.yang dkar gyi khyu tshog sa dang/ bre se ra 'brong sto bas la 'khu ba'i 'bri g.yag gri khyu tshogs ni rtswa thang gi rgyan cha dang 'brog pa'i 'tsho brten la gas shing / da dung rgyal khab kyi rim pa da nga po'i sru/nga skyob kyi sros chags su gtogs pa'i kha dkar rkyang gi khyu tshogs dang / ga'an yang gna' ba dang / gnyan/ dgo ba so gas kyi ri skyes hro ga chags rnam/sa ci 'aridod rtswa chur rol 'ing bas phebs dal gyi rgyu ba ni rang byung khams chen po bde 9 1
ba'i chang gis myos pa min na ci 'ig yin/ yang bros su dang ra g.yu mtsho de nyid ni gri gu'i rtswa thang 'di ko yul ga'an las khyad du 'phags pa'i mtshon rtags su 'khums shing / g.yu mtsho'i gting na lto dkar nya mo'i tshogs kyis 'khyug 'khyug gar la rol cing / g.yu mtsho'i kha nang ngang pa dang / ngur pa/khrung khrung sogs chu bya sna tshogs kyis mgrin pa'i rdza rnga bar med du 'khrol ba ni snyan zhing 'jibs pa'i mnyam sgrog rol dbyangs sheg dkrol ba dang kun nas mtshungs/ sngo ljang rtswa thang de'i bar bar na 'brog pa'i sbra gur tshom bu tshom bur phub pa de dag gi nang du dkar po 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil 'ing /ser po mar gyi tsig pa brtsigs pa dang / nag po spu yi sprin nag g.yo zhing dkar po bal gyi sprin dkar lang long du 'phyur/da dung gri gu'i 'brog dmangs gtan sdod bya yul gyi shar lho'i mtshams na ri chung zhig yod pa de'i steng gi byang shar na mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi nor bu yid ba'in du 'jo ba'i jo bo bsam 'phel nor bu bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang de nyid brjid chags ger 'gying 'ing / ri chu'i de'i steng gi nub byang ngos ni mdo mkhar 'bas drung tshe ring dbang rgyal mchog gis rbad kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog brtsams sgrung ring gras ang dang po yin pa'i grags rtsom〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉 dbu rtsom sa'i byin che'i gnas mchog lcags 92
rtse gri gu'i rdzong shul yin/gri gu grong tsho'e byang ngos nas lhog lhog tu 'khol ba'i rang byung chu tshan zhig yod cing / mi tshos chu tshan der khrus la zhugs na grum bu sogs kyi nad bcos thub par grags/ga'an yang / 'o re'i spyi zla dgu pa'i zla stod du yul de'i 'brog pa rnams kyis nyin gsum nas lnga bar dbyar skyid gtong zhing / dbyar skyed de ni yul der mtshon na lo re'i bod kyi lo gsar phud pa'i dus chen rgyas shos shig yin/de'i tshe de'i dus na 'brog pa rnams kyis lus la gzab mchor gyis spud de rta rgyugs dang / sbag sbag dang rkang 'khor mgyogs los/ thag pa 'then pa/ sgor gzhas rgyag rgyu/ bye ba 'gyogs pa sogs kyi 'gran bsdur byed cing / pho gzhon rnams la mtshon na dus de ni rang gi dpa' rtsal ngom pa'i dus skabs legs shos shig dang / mo gzhon rnams la mtshon na dus de ni rang gi lang tsho'i dpal yon dang snyan 'jibs mgrin glu ngoms pa'i dus skabs legs shos shig yin/ de'i tshe sku nyid gri gur phebs na sbag btsog gi g.ya' dang bral ba'i zas rigs te/ shar mar thud gsum dang / zho dang /'o ma/ mar zan sogs ci 'dod longs su spyod rgyu yod cing /de'i tshe de'i dus na sku blud kyis da gzod rang byung khams chen po'i bde ba longs su spyad chog la/ ngo mtshar yid du 93
'ong ba'i rtswa tha nga gi ma/dzes ljong sa 'a 'dren byed dbang pos ci 'dod tshim par rol chog pa ma zad/ 'brog pa'i snga ra gyi yul srol dang deng ge dar srol gnyi sa par long sa su spyad choglcags zam chu bo ri dang che chu sgrub sde/lcags zam chu bo ri mi bod kyi ri chen bco'i ya gyal zhig yin 'ing / de yang ri chen ba'i zhes pa dri gnas ri rtsa chen yin pa las ri che shos sa ma mtho shos la zer ba min/ de yang ze ra srol la ri 'di'i ngogs dang ldebs la dgon pa brgya dang brgyad/ dur khrod brgya dang brgyad / chu mig brgya dang brgyad bcas yod par grags shi nga / de nga sang chu bo ri'i byang ngos lha chu zhis pa'i chu mi ga gi chus khrus byas na nad rigs kun 'angoms zhes snyan grags che bas phyogs kun nas skye bo bung ba pad mtshor 'khor ba ba'in shin tu mang po slebs kyi yo da/tshe chu sgrub sde dgon ni sngon slob dpon pad mas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan la tshe sgrub gnang skabs thog kha nas tshe bum pho rog gcig gis khur nas sa der sbas pas phyis de nas babs pa'i chu btungs na tshe 'phel bas dgon ming la'ang tshe chu sgrub sde ches thogs/ thos ma ra dgom pa 'dzi 94
smin grol gling gi khongs yin pas de ra bzhugs dge 'dun brgyad grwa gcig gi 'tsho gos smin grol gling nas 'gan len zhu ṅga yod kya nga / phyis lams kyi bla ma tshe dbang bsam grub dang /blo bzang bsam grub ces pa gnyi sa ri ldebs kyi bsam gta na gling du bzhugs pa dgon de'i bla r+ya ra gdan drangs pas rim ba'in chos lugs dge lugs par 'gyur/de rjes ra sgreng rgyal thog skabs 'du khang gsar bzhengs gnang / dgon pa'i g.yas ngos su chu bo ri'i gnas sgo yod par/ sngon ra rdzi 'ig gi ra dkar po gcig rtag par mthong sar sdod kyi med pas nyi na 'ig ra rdzis ra'i mjug tu phyin pas yul skyed po pad ma bkod ces bya ba lha yul dang 'dra ba'i skyed po 'ig la slebs pas ra dzi'i sems la rang gi pha ma gnyi sa kyang 'dir bsu dgos snyam nas khyim du pha ma 'bod par phyin te kho tsho mnyam du sa der slebs dus gnas sgo zum zin pa dang / de nas bzung chu bo ri'i gnas sgo sus kyang phye ma thub par gyur ces ze ra/g.yon yang chu bo rir ming 'bod tshul kha sha sa yod kyang ri 'di'i 'gram gyi yar klung gtsang por grub chen thang stong rgyal pos lcags zam bskrun pa nas bzung ri bo'i ming la ñca gas zam/ chu bo ri 'es brjod pa t+na yo/ngas su grag sa pa 'ig yi na no/95
gangs ri yar lha sham po/bod yongs su rlung ltar grags pa'i gangs ri yar lha sham po ni/ yar mo klung gi phu la gnas yod cing / rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le 5 2 yod pa dang / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos nas spyi khre 6 0 0 0 tsam yod/gangs ri 'di ni bod mi dmangs kyi gus bkur zhu sa'i srid pa'i lha dgu'i gras shig yin pa ma zad/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong lde btsan sogs kyis bsten pa'i srung ma rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum zhes pa'i gras shig kyang yin/ gangs ri'i bzo dbyibs ni thog mar mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang dang 'dra ba 'ig yod kyang sa mtho'i nyi 'od kyis rim bzhin bzhur bas bzo lta 'gyur zhing cung tsam dma' ru song yod thog ri sked kyi dbyibs la mtho zhing gzar ba dang / la la skas rim ltar chags pa sogs ngo mtshar ldan pa zhig yod pa de'i mdun phyogs nas chu bo yar lha sham chu shang shang du 'bab kyi yod/ chu 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi yar klung zhing thang ni gser gyi ga'ong pa dang 'dra ba'i 'bru risas kyi bang mdzod cig yin pas yar klung la bod kyi 'bru mdzod 96
ces pa'i mtshan snyan thob yod pa dang / sngo ljang lcang ma'i rigs dang / khra tshig me tog ge rigs ni yar klung lcang gseb gling kha zhes lha yul gyi skyed tshal dang gnyis su med pa lta bur snang / da dung gangs ri 'di'i rgyab phyogs kyi chu ni e chu mdo gyang lung shur du 'bab kyi yod pas de'i rgyud du rtswa chu phun sum tshogs pa phyugs rigs dkar nag spro skyed gtong sa'i mdzes ljongs chen po zhig lhun gyis grub yod/yang gangs ri 'dir sngon lo rgyus thog ngo mtshar can gyi lha sgrung yang mang po shod rgyu yod pa dper na/ bod rgyal brgyad pa gri gum btsan po blon po lo ngam gyis bkrongs rjes rgyal po'i btsun mo gangs ri yar lha sham po dang nye sar bros phebs pa'i mtshan mo zhig ( 'ga' zhig gi rta 'tsho bar phebs zhes kyang zer) yang lha sham po'i sprul pa lha g.yag dkar po zhig dang 'grogs pa rmis pas sku lus sbrum mar gyur ba dang /zla dgu ngo bcu song rjes khye'u zhig btsas pa'i ming la ru las skyes zhes btags/ khye'u de cher longs nas dgra sha blangs pa dang / rgyal srid skyong rogs byed mkhan gyi blon po mchog tu gyur pa mdzangs mi bdun gyi dang po ru las skyes zhes bod yongs la grags pa sogs shod rgyun shin tu mang /9gzhan yang sngar nas da bar yar klung gi rgya che'i chos dad pa ser skya mang tshogs tshos yul yar klung la bsdad na lha 97
yar lha sham po gsol dgos ces gangs ri yar lha sham po 'di nyid mchog tu gyur pa'i yul lha 'ig tu brtsis nas dad gus tshad med zhus te yar lha sham po dgyes na rang snyad tshe ring nad med dang / bya ba lam 'gro yong ba dang / yar lha sham po khros na gegs dbang bar chad yong ba'i ngos /'dzin byed kyi yo da pa ma/ zad bod yul gyi sa cha gzhon dag nas kyang ched mngags yar lha sham po mjal bar phebs r+ya khan mang po yo da pa dang / da dung gangs bskor thengs lnga dang / bcu/sum cu sogs rgyag mkhan yang mang po yo/da/zangs ri 'ol kha chu tshan/rtsed thang nas byang shar zangs ri rdzong khongs la lam thag spyi le7 2 phyin na 'ol kha chu tshan zhes yongs su grags pa der slebs shing / deng rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid 4 2 0 0 tsam yo da/'og kha'i chu tshan la khrag mi 'dra ba lnga yod pa nī/ sman chu chu tshan dang/ 'phags pa chu tshan/ spang kha chu tshan/skyogs ga cus cu tshan/ gro lo kha'i chu tshan bcas yin 'ing /de dag las grags che shos gro lo kha'i chu tshan ni na thang rkya zhing mdzes pa 'ig gi dbus su gnas yod pa dang / na thang 98
'dres mtshams kyi rdo hrug bar nas chu me btang nas bskol ba ltar lhog lhog tu 'khol ba'in yod/ chu tshan de ni lo rgyus thog tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon gyi khrus gsol chu rdzong yin pas sngar skye bo gzhan sus kyang der chu tshan brgyab chog gi med/chu tshan 'di'i khyad chos ni na tsha khyon yongs la phan pa las gang la'ang mi gnod cing / thengs mang po brgyab na de bas phan pa dang / thengs gcig las ma brgyab kyang chu lan slog pa zhes nges/ par du thengs gnyi sa pa rgyag par 'gro dgos kyi med/chu tshan gyi rgya khyon m+pi spyi le gru ba'i ma nyi shu ma zim tsam gyi dkyil du sngar gyi rdo ring gru ba'i ma ring tshad skar ma bzhi bcu yod pa 'gying nger btsugs yod pa dang / chu'i gting tshad spyi khri gnyis ma zin tsam yod la bshal chu phyir 'gro sogs gtsang 'ing khams dwangs pa 'ig yod/ gzhan yang chu tshan 'di'i gnas yul ngo mtshar yid du 'ong ba'i ne'u gseng spang gathongs yangs shing rgya che'i lho phyogs su srid pa'i gangs ri mtho po 'o de gung rgyal dang / byang du chos lung dgon gī rgyab ri rtse rmo rdza ri dang / bar du nags ri/ ri gsham spang ri bcas byed pos ched du bskrun pa lta bu/ nub tu rdzong phyi'i phu chu dwangs thing gtsang ba lhu nga lhu nga rgyu ba/ shar phyogs mu khyud 99
kyi ri bo maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu lta bus mdzes par bskor yod/de ba'in chu tshan ga'an ba'i por yang rang rang gi khyad chos re yod pa ste/ sman chu chu tshan gyis gtso bo ya mar shin tu phan pa dang / 'phags pa chu tshan gyis gtso bo 'bam grum dang pags nad la phan pa/ spang kha chu tshan gyis gtso bo chu ser dang grang nad la phan pa/ skyogs gcus chu tshan gyis gtso bo pho smug dang tshad rnying la phan pa sogs khyad chos gtso bo'i dbang gis bshad pa las phan yon gzhan shig tu mang /gzhan yang 'ol kha ni yul ljongs mdzes shing skyed la/thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa/ khyad par du 'ol khar chu rigs gsum mgon po rang byung lhun grub kyis zhal 'dzoms byung yod pa ste/ shar phyogs 'o de gung rgyal gangs ri las 'bab pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi chu bo dkar po 'o ma'i mdog dang / byang phyogs rdzong phyi'i lung chu ngo mtshar spang ri las 'bab pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi chu bor ser skya gur gum mdog nub phyogs sle lung phu chu brjid chags rdza ri las 'bab pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i chu bo sngo nag mchin pa'i mdog sogs ngo mtshar gtam rgyud snyan pos mi sems yid dbang cig car 'gug pa'i rang byung mdzes ljongs mang po yod do/ /100

pa'i sdig pa dag pa'i ched du mi gcig lag gcig gis bzhengs pa zhig yin pas khong gis snying rus la ha mi las pa dang / dad gus mi byed mkhan su'ang med/de rjes lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang 'ig gso dang rgya bskyed byas pa brgyud dbu rtse'i gser skyibs thog rim dgu dang ldan pa'i btsan mkhar gzugs can gyi gtsang khang gru ba'i ma bkod pa'i gtso bor ba'ag pa'i bod lugs kyi dbyibs bzo thun mong ma yin pa'i dgon pa thig tu gyur/dgon pa 'di ni bka' brgyud bstan pa'i 'byung khungs kyi chu 'go cig yin pas byin rlabs dang snyan grags gnyis ka che/dgon pa'i rten gtso byang chub chen po ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i sku 'dra sku tshad bcu drug pas gtsos rin thang bral ba'i sku gsung thugs rten bgrang gis mi lang pa da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ shin tu dkon pa'i dpe rnying bris ma de dag ni dgon pa de rang gi btab lo dang mnyam pa'am yang na de las lo sum brgya bzhi brgyas snga ba'i lo rgyus yod pas rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos gtsigs cher 'dzin dang 'dzin ba'in pa yin/ga'an yang gdan sa 'di'i yang dben gnas stag nye zhes par rje btsun mi lar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang 102
lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun ri ga dngos/bskur zhing / gdams ngag rdzogs par rngananang zhing / mi la ras pas bla ma'i bka' ba'in zla ba bcu gcig ring mar me mgo thog tu ba'ag pas tshe gcig lus gre/cig la sangs rgyas pa'i lo rgyus yod pa dang / mar pas deng sa ri bod du brgyud pa chad pa'i pho ba grong 'jug ces pa ste/ kli dang sems can sogs shi ba'i ro la rang gi rnam shes sbyo/sa/sa te slar gson par byed pa'i gdams ngag khyad par ca( ra/ de'ang gnas 'di na mdzad/ des na gnas 'dir sleb zlas tsam gyis rig pa dwangs/ dge sbyor 'phel/ der bzhu/ gas bsam gtan pa rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams :rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas dang ldan no/ /o rgyan smin grong / 〉sbeng /smin grol gling dgon pa /ne lho kha gra nang rdzong gra phyi shang khongs su gnas shing / dgon pa 'a di ni dbus kyi rnying ma'i dgon pa gtso gras shig yin pas nga ga rgyun du dbus na rdor smin dpal gsum zhes dbus kyitsho rnying dgon gtso bo rdo rje brag dang / smin grol gling/ 'amyorngazas rgyas dpal ri bcas kyi gras shig kyang yin/dgon pa 'di phyag 'de bas pa po ni chos rgyal gter 103
bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/bdag gling pa yin ci nga / khong 1 6 4 6lor yul gra nang rig pa'i 'byung gnas /kyo dar rgyas gling du 'khrungs pa dang /khong 1 676lo nas (tshen grol gling gtsug lag khang rgya khyon ka ba brgyad cu gya ba'i/ thog rim gsum pa/ rtse mor gser zangs kyi gañji ra jidang li ma lha khang gi rten du gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis/ phyi rol du 'khor sa brang khang dang bcas pa legs par bskrucad/ 1 62 4chos ra lhun po lte ba rgya khyon ka ba lnga bcu/ thog rim gsum pa/ dbu rtser gser zangs kyi rgya phebs dang bcaca sa pa/ mdun gyi lan gan la gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan /gnyis/ phyi rol du khang bran du mas mdzes pa gsar ba'engarngeg dang / yang 1 69 1lor sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo/ rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i chos 'khor bcu gsum gyi bar dpang thog tshad bcu gcig phyogs mtshams gzhan rnams su byang chub mchod rten lhag ma bdun dang /de'i phyi rol du chos bzang bde yangs dang bcas par gsar bzhings mdzad pa dang / 1 696lor bla brang chos 'khor lhun po'i yang thog ar las dbu btsugs/ de rjes 17 0 0lor sgrub mtshad gsang sngags pho brang rgya khyon ka ba ba'i bcu zhi brgyad rten dang brten pa bcas pa legs par bzhengs pa sogs mdzad 'phrin bla na med pa bskyangs/gzhan yang smin grol gling dgo/na pa ni chos lugs tsam du ma 104
lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/zad bod kyi rig pa'i gnas kun sbyong brdar byed sa'i slob grwa chen mo zhig dang mtshungs pas sngar dgon pa 'di nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la byang chub pa'i mkhas dbang mang du byon pa dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtse slob grwa'i dge rgan gcig kyang dgon pa 'di nas gtong dgos kyi yod/gra nang byams pa gling gi mchod rten/mchod rten 'di ni lho kha sa khul gra nang rdzong nas bar thag spyi le gnyis lhag tsam gyi ri ldebs shig la yod pa'i dpal byams ngas gling dgon pa'i nang du yod/mchod rten gyi mtshan la mchod rten chen mo mthong bas rnam par grol ba zhes zhu ba 'di ni blo bzang grags pa'am tsong khra pa'i thugs sras par+ṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis( thu mi/ lhun bkras) rab byung brgyad pa'i chu 'brug ( 1 67 2 )lor phyag btab cing / mchod rten der ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i gzugs dbyibs dang mtho tshad thog brtsegs bcu bdun lhag tsam yod pa dang / mchod rten gyi rtsa bar sbom tshad lag 'dom nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod/mchod rten gyi rten gtso sku rgyu gser zangs gas grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa dgung lo brgyad pa longs sku'i cha byad 105
can/ rigs lnga gser zangs kyis brgyan zhing gzungs gzhug la rdo rje pha lam dang / gzi/ g.yu byur sogs pa rin po che du mas bkang ba bzhugs/de bzhin mchod rten gyi chos 'khor bcu gsum yang gser zangs spus legs las grub cing / mchod rten gyi bre la thog brtsegs gcig dang / bum pa'i rgya khyon ni dge 'dun pa lnga brgya lhag tsam la mnyam du 'tshogs thub cing bum pa'i phyogs bzhir lha khang re yod pa'i nang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba dang / rin bral gyi sku gsung thugs rten mang po yod/ da dung mchod rten dang nye ba'i lho ngos na ka thung nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang ka ring bzhi can gī thog brtsegs khang chen gsum ldan byams khang zhig yod pa de'i nang sku rgyu gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan thog brtsegs gnyis can dang / sku rgyu dngul las grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang thog tshad gcig can de'i dbu rgyan dang mgul rgyan phyag gdub/zhabs gdub bcas ni gser btso sbyangs las grub pa zhig yin/ gzhan yang mchod rten chen mo 'di'i bum ldir nang du sangs rgyas stong sku dang li sku mang po/ khyad par du sangs rgyas 'od srung sogs kyi 'phel gdung dam rdzas ring bsrel mang po bzhugs yod pas mchod rten chen mo 'di mjal ba tsam gyis skye 'gro kun ngan song gi gnas las grol te thar 106
pa'i go 'phang thob par grags/mchod rten chen mo 'di bzhings par lo ha cang mang po 'gor yod pa ni dmangs khrod kyi shod srol du thog mar mchod rten bzhengs pa'i lo pho mo phan tshun bza' tshang du gyur pa'i phru gus mchod rten bzhengs ma tshar gong las par zhugs thub kyi yod ces ngag nas ngag brgyud de gleng /mchod rten bzhengs tshar rjes rab gnas rten 'brel mdzad sgo gra ha cang rgyas po zhig gnang ba ste/ thog mar bod zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin rgyal gling tshogs pa dang /tshong 'dus tshogs pa/ snye mdo dgon/ ri bo rnam rgya'// gra thang dgon sogs lhan du rang rang gi chos lugs byed sgo ltar rab gnas cho ga rgyas par gnang ba dang tshes nyer gsum nas gnam gang bar dgon pa so so'i ser sbreng / gtor rgyag'cham/ go pa dang gzhas chen/ bro/ lha mo sogs ston mo gzab rgyas/ gnam gang nyin byams pa gdan 'dren/ tshes gcig nas dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ kha bal kong 'brug mdo smad sgang drug rgya bod hor gsum sogs bung ba pad mtshor 'du ba bzhin mchod rten legs grub kyi mdzad sgo'i rten 'brel thog rang rang gi yul zog 'khyer nas tshong gnyer byed par yong / dus de nas bzung lo ltar bod zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung sa phyogs gang sa gang nas rang rang so so'i 107
bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gcades ljongs ngo sprod/thon rdzas 'khyer nas 'char can lho kha gra nang rdzong byams pa gling la tshong rgyag par yong gi yod pas rim ba'in gra nang byams pa gling tshong 'dus zhes ljongs phyi nang gang sar skad grags yod pa'i tshong 'dus chem mo zhig tu 'gyur/ bal po'i tshong pa sogs kyis mchod rten gyi rtse nas dar dpyang ka shi dkar po gtong gi yod pas phyis mi tshos ka shi ring thung la bltas nas snam bu'i gong che chung tshod dpag thub kyi yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni bal po sogs kyi tshang pa mang ba yod pa ka shi ring ba yod pa dang snam bu nyo mkhan mang ba yod pas snam gong 'phar ba dang / ka shri thung ba yod na snam bu nyo mkhan nyung bar brten snam gong chag ge yod/byams pa gling dgon pa'i lo ltar 'char can gyis dus ston der chos phyogs nas byams pa gling smon lam zhes zer ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i phyogs nas byams pa gling tshong 'dus 'es zer gyi yod la 'brug yul sogs nas kyang byams pa gling dgon par phyag mchod dang / dge 'dun par mang ja dang sku 'gyed sogs 'bul srol yod/byams pa gling dgon pa'i bla brgyud sku phreng dang po blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / de nas dpon char rwa dga'/rnam grol rin po che/ blo bzang bu chung / blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs rgyun mi chad par byung yod/108
rdzing phyi dgon/mtshan cha tshang la rdzong phyi dga' ldan byams gling zhes zhu 'ing rtsed thang nas spyi le2 0 tsam song na rdzong phyi dgon par slebs/ rdzong phyi zhes pa ni grong ming yin pa dang thog mar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi bka' ltar khams nas phebs pa'i sgar mi yon tan g.yung drung gis phyag btab/ dgon pa'i rten gtso dzi k+ṣim las grub pa'i sku gdung dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad kyi thugs kur tsan dan de ba'i nags khrod nas 'khrungs pa'i tsan dan gyi byams pa khru gang bzhugs pa byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba 'ig yod/ thog mar dgon pa de dar rgyas che ba'i skabs dge 'dun 'al grangs lnga brgya skor zin na'ang rim bzhin nyams rgud du song bas rje tsong kha pa la rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis lung bstan pa ltar gnas der phebs skabs der rten gtso byams pa'i dbu la bya brun dang / thal rdul gyis khengs shing / gtsug lag khang yang gog por gyur yod pa gzigs rjes thugs skyo nas rang dbang med par spyan chab kyang shor/ de nas 'ol kha stag rtse rdzong gis tsong kha pa'i thugs re ltar sbyin bdag zhus nas nyams gso legs par mdzad/ rje rang nyid kyi gtor chas 109
btsongs pas dngul phran bu byung ba spyad de rgyal chen rnam thos sras la smon skul zhus pas ltung bshags lha sum cu so lnga 'bri mi dgos par rang byung lhun gyis grub ste gyang ldebs su gsal ba da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod pa ni ches ngo mtshar che ba dang ches byin rlabs che ba zhig yod pa smos ci/rdzong phyi dgon dang byams par nyams gso gnang ba de ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher shin tu sman pa'i mdzad pa zhig yin pas rje rin chen po che'i mdzad chen bzhi'i ya gyal zhig yin/gzhan yang rdzing phyi dgon par ma slebs gong gi spyi le bcu tsam gyi sar 'ol dga' rdzong yod cing / yul der 'ol dga' zer don ni/ lho ngos su srid pa'i lha chen 'o de gung rgyal zhes pa'i gangs ri ltar chags su yod pa las rtse mo mtho zhing phra bas kha sprod du gnas yod pa ni yab yum gnyis dang /gnyan chen thang lha dang / kong btsun de mo/ mon yul de mo/lho brag sku lha mkha'i ri/ yar lha sham bu/ jo mo mkha' regbdud rtsi sman mo/ stag stod shing bya sogs 'o lde gung rgyal gyi sras sros yin par grags pas lung pa'i ming la'ang 'o lde gung rgyal gyi sgra'i dod las 'ol kha zhes zer/110
lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/rdo rje brag dgon pa/mtshan cha tshang la thub bstan rdo rje brag e wam lcog sgar zhes zhu/dgon de'i mchan 'grel rni rgyab rir g.yu yi rdo rje'i rang byon yod pas rdo rje brag dang / e wam lcog sgar zhes pa t+na thog mar lcog gur phub pa'i 'dus sde yin pas mtshan de ltar thogs/de yang thog mar mnga' ris paṇ+ḍi ta pad ma dbang gi rgyal pos gyur bskyon pa'i gsang chen gyi 'dus sde chung ngu zhig 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa dang / de rjes sku phreng gsum pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang pos phyag btab/rig 'dzin sku phreng ba'i pa kun bzang pad ma 'phrin las khrir 'khod rjes rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po dang chos yon gyi thugs rje'i bdag rkyen dang bcas stobs rgyas par gyur/bde yangs shar nub gnyis zhes mdo sngags grwa tshang shar nub gnyis yod/ de snga dge 'dun 'ag grangs lnga stong tsam byung myong yod pas snga 'gyur rnying ma'i byang gter gī gdan sa chen por grags/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus 'gor jun 1 1 1
gar dmag gis dgon de rmeg med du bzo ba'i skabs mgon khang srid gsum rnam rgyal bsheg par brtsam pa'i dus jun gar ba'i dmag dpon khra ga skyugs te shi bas skrag ste mgon khang de gcig pu ma bshig par ba'ag gser zangs las grub pa'i sku brnyan chu la bskyur ba dang / gser bris kyi bka' 'gyur so/gas nang rten mang po 'khyer 'ing dgung grangs bdun cu don bdun la phebs pa'i rig 'dzin pad r+ya/ 'phrin las kyang bkrongs pa sogs bar chad shugs/ chen byung yang rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa'i skabs dgon pa'i bdas dbang mtha' dag slar gso gnang ba dang / de nas bzung phyi'i bkod pa dang nang gi thugs rten rim ba'in nya mas gso dang gsar bskrun byas pas sngar dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i grags can gyi rnying dgon 'ig tu 'gyur/rdo rje brag dgon pa'i mdun du ya ra klung gtsang po rgyu ba dang / rgyab tu ba gam brag ris mdzes par brgyan yo/da pas bod kyi dmangs khrod glu ga'as nang du'ang rdo rje brag bi rgyab ri/ / rgyab ri brag la bcol yod/ / bras 'a/ 'gyur ba ma gtong / / thang dkar snang bzod bde ba/ / ( snang bzod bde ba dang gnas bzod bde ba 'es 'bri stangs gnyis yod kyang 'dir gong ma der go dgos) rdo rje brag gi r+ya dun phyogs/ / mdun phyogs mtsho la bcol yo da/ / mtsho la 1 12
'gyur ba ma gtong / / gser nya sna nga bzod bde ba/ / zhes gtong dang gtong ba'in yod do/ /e lha rgya ri pho brang /rtsed thang nas shar lho'i phyogs su spyi le 5 0 tsam phyin na chu gsum rdzong khongs su yin pa'i e lha rgya ri pho brang du slebs shing / pho brang de ni thog mar spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyi sa par phur btsan po'i gdung rgyud las mched pa'i sa gnas srid dbang 'dzin mkhan gyi khyim rgyud chen po sde pa rgya ri ba'i rgyud rabs kyis gsar du bskrun pa zhig red/ de yang lha zhes pa ni lha sras btsan po'i gdung rgyud las mched pa yin pas lha 'es dang / rgya bo zhes pa ni bod kyi btsan po'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa yar klung jo bo'i brgyud du rgya ri khri chen khri thog dang po lha dgra las rnam rgyal gyis e stod si'u chu tshan khar slebs te de gar bzhugs gnas chung ngu zhig brtsigs nas bzhugs dus nyin zhig nye 'dabs kyi ri la me 'bar ba gzigs pas ya mtshan du dgongs nas dpyad pa mdzad skabs rtswa rgya bo rang byung gi me 'bar ba de ni bkra shes pa'i snga ltas shig yin pa mkhyen nas gnas der dgon pa dang ga'is ka sogs brtsigs pas rgya ri dgon zhes ming du chags/ de 1 1 3
nas rim par rgya ri sku thog rim byung gis pho brang rgya bskyed nyams gso mdzad pas e lha rgya ri'i pho brang zhes gangs ljongs yongs la rlung ltar grags pa de byung /de yang lha rgya ri'i pho brang ni gad pa thog brtsegs nyi shu tsam yod pa'i sa bab ngo mtshar can zhig gi steng du chags shing / pho brang lte ba'i bzo skrun zheng tshad rmid 2 1dang ring tshad rmod 2 2 mtho tshad thog brtsegs lnga yod pa'i mdun ngos su dkar gzhal zhes pa 'khyams shin tu che ba zhig yod pa de'i mtha' skor du rdo tshos gzhi 'dra min sna tshogs bsgrigs pa'i mdzes ris bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga sogs kyis phyugs pa rgya khyon yangs shing mdzes sdug lta bas mi ngoms pa zhig yod/ da dung rdzong zur zhes pa thog brtsegs bzhi ldan gyi khang pa dmar po zhig yod pa de ni ring lha rgyal mtshan gyi mgon khang yin pa dang /gzhan yang pho brang gi byang ngos grog shur nang du lha rgya ri khri thog mjug ma rnam rgyal rgya mtshos 19 42lor bzhengs pa'i dbyar skyed spro khang rgya bzo'i lugs bzo dbyibs legs la sge'u khung dang bcad khra sogs la shing brkos bya 'brug dang /tsi shing me tog gi ri mo mdzes par brgyan pa'i khang bzang gi khor mo yug spang ljongs dang / me tog sna tshogs/ 'bras ldan ljon shing sogs kyis yongs su bskor ba de ni lha sa'i 114
nor bu gling kha gnyis pa yin zhes yongs su grags pa don dang mthun/des na lha rgya ri pho brang gi lo rgyus rin thang dang / bzo skrun sgyu rtsal/ gnas yul khyad chos sogs bod yul na mthong bar dkon pa zhig yin pas rgya ri pho brang 'di nyid lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin par bsnyon du med do/ /'on ke ru lha khang /rtsed thang nas nya mgo zam chen brgal te byang ngos 'on yul gyi phu la spyi le bdun tsam bskyod na ke ru lha khang du slebs shing / lha khang de ni thog mar chos rgyal khri gtsug brtan gyis bzhengs gnang mdzad pa dang / de rjes bla ma skyes chen du mas zhabs kyis bcags shing / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lho kha'i yar klung gtsang po'i byang ngos kyi byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba'i lha khang rnying pa zhig yin pa dang / lhag par du jo bo rje gnas der phebs nas yun ring tsam bzhugs shing /de nas slar yang byon par nye ba'i skabs skye bo skya ser kun gyis mgrin gcig tu jo bo ma phebs rogs gnang / jo rba ma phebs rogs gnang zhes yang nas yang du zhus pas jo bos nga 1 15
ma phyin na mi 'grig pas nga'i tshab tu 'di nyar tshags byos 'es gsu ngas nas shangs khrag gis 'dra sku 'ig bzhengs gnang mdzad pa dang / jo bos nyin lta ra sgom nas bzhugs sar 'bas dang / phyag dbu sogs kyi rjes yod pas mchod rten 'ig ba'engs pa de la mchod rten dkar chung lha khang 'es zer/lo rgyus 'ga' 'ig nang lha khang de'i mtshan la brag dmar ke ru lha khang zhes 'khod yod kyang / brag dmar zhes pa ni bas ma yas la go dgos pas bsam yas dang ke ru lha khang lo rgyus thad 'brel ba ci yang med pa ma zad lo tshigs kyang mi mthun/ 'o rgyus dngos pha gtam bu 'jags su gyur pa'i ke ru lha khang gi mtshan rnying par 'on khra sna ke ru lha khang zhes zer 'ing / de yang khra sna zhes pa ni grong tsho'i ming rnying pa yin par bsnyo na du med/da dung mkhas dbang 'ga' zhig gis ke ru lha khang ni mu ne btsan po'i dus bzhengs par yang bzhid mkhan yod/mig sngar lha khang de'i nang zhugs pa'i sman 'dam las grub pa'i snyu 'dra rnying pa de dag la thun min gna'aju bo'i bzo rtsal khyad chos ldan pa dang / bstan 'gyur bris ma pod nyis brgya lhag tsam yod pa de dag kya nga ches rnying r+ya r+sha stag yin pas lha khang der lo rgyus cib 'jug gi rin thang gzhan gyis 1 16
bsgrun du med pa 'ig mchis so/ /yar 'brog bsam ldings dgon pa/yar 'brog bsam sdings dgon pa ni bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo sku phreng dang po tshas kyi sgron mes rab byung bdun pa'i lcags sprel ( 1 4 4 0 ) lor phyag btab/ dgon pa'i mtshan cha tshang la dpal mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i bste gnas bsam grub kyis chos kyi sdings zhes zer 'ing / 'di ni bod ljongs su bud med kyi bla mas yang srid rim byon dgon bdag byed mkhan gcig rang yod pa de yin/ de yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir yul rtsa ba'i zhes grags pa'i nang tshan/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i bste gnas chen po 'di nyid bod gangs can gyi ljongs/ dbus gtsang gnyis kyi mtshams/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho phyug mo mdun du yon chab phul ba ltar 'khyil 'ing /phyogs bzhi mu khyad ri bos mdzes par bskor ba dang / khor mo yug tu mar gad zhun ma'i mdangs can rtswa ljang ne'u gseng ldem/ ldem g.yo ba'i dbus su/ ri bo glang chen mtsho chu 'thung ba'i dbyibs legs lta bu'i steng du brjid chags rnam par bkra ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid gnas/ dgon pa'i 'du khang legs bshad dga' tshal zhes bya ba'i rten gtso gser 1 17
zangs kyi thub dbang 'dul ma thog so gnyis pa/ gzungs su sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel sogs bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs tshan kha 'bar bas gtsos dgon pa 'di na/ je btsun mi pham mgon po dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du bzhugs pa'i snang brnyan phra ldan byon gtsang dang / lha babs mchod rten/ bka' gdams mchod rten/ byang chub mchod rten sogs sum brgya/ gnas bdag 'ing skyong yab yum gnyis tsā ri nas bro pa pho mor sprul nas phebs dus kyi rnga chung / grub thob thang stong rgyal pos gnang ba'i tsan dan sprul gyi snying po'i rdo rdze rnam 'byor ma/ mu tig brgyad stong sogs sku gsung thugs rten bgrang gis mi lang zhing / lhag par du nang rten la 'tshe ba'i gor dmag gi mgo lag mnan pa'i steng du bzhengs pa'i dngul gdung byang chub mchod rten 'di 'dra bod yongs su mthong ba dkon/ de bzhin bla brang gi rgyu dngos 'jog sa'i khang pa/ 'dod rgu bang mdzod bkar steng zhes pa'i nang g.yang sgam dang / za 'og gos dar/ glang chen gyi mche ba/ bse ru'i rwa co/ khyung gi sder mo/ rta'i rwa co/ g.yu byur/ gzi/ mu tig bod dngul ṭam rkyal sogs rin thang bral ba'i nor bu'i rigs dang / de min phyi nang bar gsum gyi dpal 'bar la sus kyang 'gran par dka' ba dper na/ khang pa grangs nyis brgya bdun cu don gsum la 1 18
ka ba lnga brgya sum cu so gcig dang / phyugs rigs dkar nag mgo grangs tshig khri nyis stong brgya dang bdun cu don lnga yod pa lta bu red/bsam sdings dgon par rdo rje pha mo sku phreng bcu gnyis byung ba dang / mig sngar sku phreng bcu gnyis pa bde chen chos kyi spron ma mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i ngang 'tsho 'ing bzhes so/ /gdan sa mthil dgon pa/gdan sa mthil dgon pa ni yar klung gtsang po'i byang ngos/ lho kha zangs ri rdzong khongs/ phag mo gru pa grong tsho'i ri ldebs su gnas/ de yang phag mo zhes pa ni grong tsho'i ming dang gru pa ni gru kha'i ming yin pas bsdus ming la phag mo gru pa zhes brjod/ chos lugs kyi 'grel bshad ltar na phag gru zhes pa'i go don sngar gnas der rdo rje phag mos dngos su byin ba rlabs pa'i gnas rtsa chen zhig yin/dgon pa 'di thog mar rgya sgom rmi ras kyi sbyin bdag mdzad de mnyam po dwags po lha rje'i slob ma rang nyid dang mtshungs pa phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal pos rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag ( 1 1 5 2 ) lor phyag btab cing / de nas bzung dpal phag mo gru pa bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags/1 19
gdan sa ma/thil gnas sa'i ri bo mtho 'ing / brag ri dwangs shel spungs pa lta bu'i mdun na sna mang me tog gi dri com gang sa ra thul ba dang / nags tshal stug po'i khrod du spu sdug bya rigs kyi gsung snyan lhang lhang sgrog cing / ri dwags sna tshogs 'tshe med ci gar rgyu ba sogs bas ma gtan gyi gnas bag phebs pa'i yi gar 'ong ba 'ig yin/dus rabs rim byung nang bka' brgyud kyi bsta na pa 'dzin pa phag gru dang / 'bri gung / stag lung so gas kyi skye bo dam pa rna mas kyis dgon pa nyams gso dang / rgya bskyed sogs thengs kha shas gnang ba brgyud ga'i nas rgya khyon che zhing / rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten gyis yongs su bkang ba'i dgon chen 'ig tu gyur nas mtshan snyan yul gru kun tu khyab/dgon pa 'di ni chos lugs tsam ma zad phag mo gru pas bod dbang bsgyur byed pa'i skabs su chab srid thad la'ang gal che'i gnas bab bzung yod pa'i dgon pa 'ig yi na/phag gru rdo rje rgyal po nas bzung gdan rabs kyang skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po dang / rgyal ba rin po che spyan snga sku thog bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rdze sogs mang du byon/dgon pa'i ming gdan sa mthil 'es zer ba'i nang gi mthil zhes pa rni bod kyi skad yig nang spyir btang gshong sar 1 20
go dgos pa'i skabs shig yod kyang 'dir dkyil lam lte bar dgos pa ste/ phag gru bka' rgyud kyi gdan sa'i lte ba zhes pa'i don yin/dgon pa 'di btab pa nas bzung bod kyi dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs tshos gzhon las lhag pa'i grenas rtsa chen 'ig tu brtsis nas dad sems bla med zhu gi yod cing /dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig nang du'ang gzhon pa 'di ru ma sdod chas nas 'gro/ gnas chen gdan sa mthil la chas nas 'gro/ phag mo gru pa'i byin rlabs ma zhus na/ 'di dang phyi ma'i las sgrib ga la dag ces sogs gtong bang gtong ba'in pa yin no/ /dwags lha sgam po dgon/dwags lha sgom po dgon ni gangs can bka' brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po mar mi dwags gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i ya gyal mnyam med dwags po lha rjes rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags glang ( 1 1 2 1 ) lor phyag btab/ rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le 2 8 9yod pa dang mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmod 4 4 0 0 yod/gnas de ni rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i ri brag tshang 121

khrod sogs mjal rgyu yod/yar ji o rgyan gling dgon pa/rtsed thang nas spyi lengur bskyod na gra nang yar rje yo rgyan gling dgon du slebs shing / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid 2 7 0 0 yod/ dgon pa 'debs mkhan ni yar rje o rgyan gling pa yin/dgon pa'i mtshan don ni yar zhes pa stod kyi don dang rje zhes pa rje o rgyan gling pa'i gdan sa yin pas yar rje mtshan du gsol/de yang yar rje o rgyan gling pa ni 1 2 2 2lor sngags rgyun khyad par can du sku 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas sman rtsis mthu sogs brtson pas sbyangs te mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob/:dgung lo nyer gsum par bsam yas mchod rten dmar po nas gter gyi kha byang bzhes te shel brag gi rgyab phyogs brag pad ma brtsegs pa'i shel phug nas zab gter gyi ma/dzod ba'es / gzhon yang snga phyir gnas du ma nas gter mang po bzhis shing / bka' 'dus kyi dbang sogs gnang nas 'dul bya mang du bskyangs mthar dwags po khul du phebs 167
bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/——te sku gshegs/ sku gdung dwags por spyan drangs/ phyir dwags khul sde pa la sa can 'ig gi sku gdung de skye bdun myong grol du grags pa shes nas gsang ba'i ngang sku sha cung zad zhus te zos pas sde pa nyam sa 'a bar te sa nas khru gang tsam 'phar bas snyan grags gang sar khyab te sku gdung sne gdong ban tshang dgon du gdung rten nang bzhugs pa dang / de snga lo ltar sde pa gzhung ( bod sa gnas srid gzhung) nas ched mi btang ste gdung rten dam 'byar kha phye nas sku sha lug gi mchin pa'i che chung tsam re zhus te sman rtsis khang ge sman rtsa che'i rigs la bsres sbyor byed kyi yod pa dang / zhus pa'i sku sha 'o phyi ma sngar bzhin 'khrungs pa ni mi mang pos mthong myong ba zhig yin pa dang / yar rje o rgyan gling pa'i sku sha rdul phran tsam kha la song na ngan song las thar te sangs rgyas zhing khams su bde blag tu bgrod thub ces rlung ltar grags pas phyis khong gi gdan sa gra nang yar rje yo rgyan gling la skye bo kun gyis dad sems dpag med zhu gi yod/mig sngar dgon pa de'i phyi brtsigs thog ma'i de de rang mi nyams par gnas yod pa dang / rgya khyon de tsam mi che yang bzo dbyibs zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo ltar mdzes shing skor lam phyi nang bar gsum yod/lhag par du yar rje o rgyan gling pa'i shangs khrag las 168
lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/bzhings pa'i gu ru pad ma sam bha ba dang / rta mgrin drag po tshar gcod kyi ldebs ris thun mong ma yin pa dang / gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs dkar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba gzungs ji snyed bzhugs pa sogs mjal rgyu yod/thang po che dgon/mtshan cha tshang la sol nag thang po che zhes zhu/ rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le 2 0 yod pa dang / mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las rmid 27 0 6yod/ thog mar bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'dul 'dzin dbus gtsang mi bcu'i nang tshan lam pa klu mes pa chen po'i slob ma gru mes la sogs pa mched brgyad kyis btab/ khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis dar rgyas mdzad/kha che paṇa chen gyis rab byung bzhi pa'i me yos( 1 2 0 7)lor thang po cher bstan rtsis mdzad/ skabs der sangs rgyas 'das nas lo 175 0song zhes gsungs/ jo bo rje'ang gnas der phebs nas 'ag bdun bzhugs kyang khu ston gyis jo bo'i 'bas la ma gtugs stabs jo bo rje nya mgo gru don nas rbod dkar la brgyud snye thang du phebs/ rdzes su khu ston 'gyod pa drag po skyes nas jo bo'i rjes su bsnyegs te 169
zhabs la gtugs nas gdams pa mang po gsan/ phar phyin dang gshin rje'i man ngag las rtsal thon/snga phyir thang po cher skyes chen dam pa mang pos 'bas kyis bcags shing chos 'khor bskor myong bas dgon pa 'di ni byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba 'ig yin/dre'u lhas dgon dang rwi thang dgon/rtsed thang nas lhun rtse brgyud spyi le 1 5 7tsam song na dre'u ltas dgon par slebs shing / dgon pa de ni 'brug pa sde drug gi ya gyal yin/ dgon pa de ni thog mar da lta'i dgon pa gnas yul gyi lho nub mtshams su ri 'bur 'ig yod pa der grub pa ngag dbang nor bus phyag btab gnang ba'i 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa rdo rdze gdan zhes pa gcig yod cing / de rdzes grub dbang bstan 'dzin bzang pos lha mo dud srol ma'i rten rtsa chen dre'u 'ig la bkal nas phebs te dre'u de gang 'dra nyal yang der nga'i dgon pa 'debs kyi yin zhes gsungs/ de yang thos mar da lta'i dgon pa chags yul du bka' gdams pa'i dgon zhig yod pa la gro ba lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas zhu bas blo ldan shes rab kyi sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang dgon par nyams gso 170
gnang /dus phyis bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa de rim bzhin nyams nas ltas ra 'ig tu gyur yod cing / grub dbang bstan 'dzin bzang po sa cha der phebs pa dang / dre'us ltas ra de'i nang nyal bas lhas rar dgon pa btab pa dang dgon pa'i mtshan la'ang lhas dgon pa zhes gsol/ de nas grub dbang bstan 'dzin bzang po'i mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas te dge 'dun zhal grangs rim bzhin 'phel ba dang /stod la dwags rgyal po'i dbu bla'ang gnang stabs rgyal pos gser mang po phul bas dgon de'i sku 'dra'i zhal gser dang /ldebs ris sogs skye bo kun hang sangs dgos pa zhig yod/dre'u lhas dgon nas lho brgyud spyi le bcu gcig phyin na ri thang dgon rgya mtsho rin chen steng du slebs shing / dgon pa de ni gnyal sde drug gi khongs yin/dgon pa de'i lo rgyus ches ring ba ste/ thog mar gnas der gna' bo'i bon dgon 'ig yod pa la/ de rjes bka' gdams pa'i bla ma ri bo mkhyen brtse zhu bas dgon pa zhig phyag btab/ de nas rim ba'in dge ldan pa phyag bzhes mdzad/ bla ma blo bzang ri bo mkhyen brtse'i sku gdung gi phyi ngos su slar yang mchod rten 'ig dang / 'du khang ka ba so drug can sogs ba'engs/171
da lta lha khang ka ba rang grub can de'i nang spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong thog tshad ma dang / rigs gsu spe mgon po ngo mtshar che ba'i ldebs ris rnying ma mang po sogs mjal rgyu yod/zangs ri mkhar dmar dgon/zangs ri mkhar dmar dgon ni zangs ri rdzong gi shar ngos/ rje bzhugs grong zhes pa/ sngar rje rin po che bzhugs myong ba'i grong ge ri chung steng du gnas yod/dgon pa 'di thog mar ma gcig lab sgron gyis rab byung gnyis pa'i shing glang( 1 19 5 )lor phyag btab/de yang zangs ri zhes pa ni/ sngar yul de na zangs kyi gter kha yod par grags la deng dus kyang zangs gter dngos su yod pa dang / 'khar dmar zhes pa ni skyob ston bsod nams bla mas ma cig lab sgron la brag rdo 'ig chur bskur gnang ste 'di gang du 'khyer nas gang du bsdad kyang sa de na dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos gsungs par/ brag rdo de da yod dgon pa'i mdun gyi gtsang chu'i khrod 'khar ba dang /'khar sa ni pha bong dmar po 'ig yin pas dgon ming la'ang thog mar 'khar dmar zhes dang de nas bod yig gi go don 172
ltar mkhar dmar zhes zer/dgon pa de na ma gcig lab spron gyis ro gcod kyi bstan pa ches cher spel/de yang yongs grags su nang chos thams cad rgya dkar mag sogs las dar yang / bod chos rgya gar du dar ba ni ma cig gi gcod rgyun mo gcod de kho na yin zer/des na ma cig lab sgron ni mo gcod gsar gtod pa yin pa dang / gcod dang po lho kha nas dar ba ma zad/ ma cig lab sgron 'khar dmar du ma phebs gong nas grub chen thos pa bha da dang ma/thun mjug gis sras sros gsum yang 'khrungs yod pas khong ni mi rigs gzhan dang mthun mjug gnang mkhan bod kyi rje btsun ma ang dang po de yin/dgon 'dir sngon rgya dkar nag sogs phyogs mang po nas chos zhu mkhan yong myong yod cing / thog mar mo dgon yin yang rjes su gtsang 'gram du chags pa'i dga' sgra dgon pa chus 'jig rjes gnas der spos pas pho dgon du 'gyur/dgon pa 'di ga'i khyon chen po med rung lo rgyus thog ga'an gyis tshab byed mi thub pa'i gnas bab bzung yod pas gnas skor ba dang ljongs rgyu ba tshang mas ched du yong dang yong ba'in pa yin/173
'ol kha chos lung dgon dang chos zam dgon/chos lung dgon pa ni sngar rje tsong kha pas 'khor dag pa rnam brgyud so so sgrub phug rer bzhugs skabs/ 'ol kha rdzong dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan thog skor du yong skabs chos lung nas 'od 'tsher ba mthong bas 'khor g.yog mngags te ci 'dug ltos shig gsungs par 'khor g.yog rnams der slebs skabs rnal 'byor pa rang rang gi sgrub phug tu bzhugs 'dug pa de don rdzong dpon la zhus pas rdzong dpon song ste rje tsong kha pa'i 'bas la gtugs nas zhabs tog sgrub rgyur khas blangs pas rdze tsong kha pas nged tshor ga'an gyi rgyas spros mi dgos/ khyed kyis 'grub na 'dul ba'i spyod lam ba'i bshong ba'i khang pa zhig e 'grub ces gsungs pa rdzong dpon gyis de mar khas len zhus shing lo de rang la 'grub par byas/gnas der rje tsong kha pas 'jam dbyangs kyi lung bstan ltar sku phyag 'bum so lnga gnang bar ltung bshags lha so lnga'i zhal gzigs thob/ maṇ+ḍal rdo steng kho nar phul gnang bas phyag ngar yang brdol/ rdo'ang shel lta bur gyur/ mdo 174
sde phal mo che gzigs pas thugs stobs ci che 'khrungs te spyan chab kyang shor/ lhag pa'i lha dngos dang mnal lam ci rigs la zhol gzigs yang yang byung / de nas chos ra sgang zhes da lta sku rjes rang byon yod sa'i pha bong gi steng nas dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gzigs snang du byung ste dga' ldan dgon pa phyag 'debs rgyu'i dgongs tshul lham ltam 'char/dgon pa 'di'i nang rje bzhi grags ma dang / ltung bshags so lnga'i ldebs ris/ rje rin po ches ma 'bul gnang sa'i rdo dang sku phyag 'bul gnang sa'i rdo/ rje rin po che dang 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad kyi phul ba'i rta rwa co gnyis ldan gcig kyang yod/ chos lung dgon pa nas cung tsam phyin na chos bsam dgon par slebs shing / de ni rje tsong kha pas tshe dpag med sgrub gnang sa yin/ gnas der rdze rin po ches cha dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu btab gnang ba dang / de rjes lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang rje bsod nams blo gros gnyis kyang bzhugs myong yod/dgon de'i ltag tu lha lding ri khrod ces par rje rin po cher stong nyid lta ba 'khrungs te rten 'brel bstod pa ñja gas rtsom gronang sa'i gnas khyad par can 'ig yin/yongs grags su 'ol kha chos lung chos zam zhes ming lhan du 'bod cing / dgon pa 'di gnyis gnas sa'i khor 1 75
yug yul ljongs mdzes sdug ldan pa dang / sa gtsang chu gtsang mkha' dbugs/ gtsang ba bcas yod pas gnas skor ba dang ljongs rgyu ba phebs sa'i mdzes ljongs khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin/bra 'od dgon/rtsed thang nas lhun rtse rdzong phyogs su spyi le 19 1tsam phyin na bra 'or dgon du slebs shing / dgon pa de ni gnyal sde drug gi gtso dgon yin/ thog mar dge bshes po to ba'i thugs sras smyos ston chos 'bar gis phyag btab pa dang mtha' ba'ir grwa shag dang lcags ris bskor bas dgon ming la grwa skor zhes zer ba sgra nyams nas bra 'or zhes 'bod/de yang sngon yul gnyal gzhung chus 'jig nas gnyal chu lung dkar po zhes zer 'ing / skabs der rgya gar nas grub chen la ba pa zhes pa bla gong la rtser phebs nas nye gnas la yul der chu ji tsam yod med ltos shig gsungs par nye gnas kyis yul der chu shin tu che bas phebs mi thub ces zhus/ dus yun cung song rjes nye gnas thengs gnyis pa yul de'i chu la blta bar gtong gnang mdzad pas nye gnas kyis da chu cung zad chung du phyin nas/ thang rgyal mtshan 'dra ba zhig 176
lnga pa/ khyad 'phags bzo skrun rig dngos/dang /lha gad pa glang chen 'dra ba/ de ba'in sgrub phug bcas mthong gi 'dug ces zhus par grub chen gyis da nga gnyis chu pha rir 'gro gsungs nas khyi lpags kyi bzhugs gdan ko gru'i tshul mdzad de khong bla slob gnyis gnas der phebs/ grub chen la ba pas thal mo sbyar 'ing spyan btsums nas gnas 'di ni bde mchog gi gnas khyad par can zhig yin pas byin rlabs shin tu che 'es gsungs/grub chen gnas 'dir yun ring bzhugs rjes gsang lam brgyud tsa rir phebs pa dang / mthar tsa ri la ba spug tu gshegs/de rjes nyos ston chos 'bar dang / kun mkhyen sna ba sogs skyes chen du ma gnas 'dir byon nas chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba dang / khyad par du kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba'i gdan sa lta bur gyur nas bra 'or 'du khang rten dang brten pa bcas gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / yul de'i 'on long glen lkugs sogs skye bo mang po sdug bsngal las skyob par mdzad/deng sang yang 'du khang rnying pa'i sgo 'phyor du 'khor lo bde mchog rnam sprul la ba pa/ de yi rnam spru la gnyos ston chos 'bar dang / slar yang rnam sprul kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba/mtshungs med skyabs gnas gsum la gsol ba 'debs zhes 177
gsal yod/dgon pa de'i nang dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ ldebs ris rnying pa mang po mjal rgyu yod cing / da dung dgon pa de nas phyin na mi ring ba'i sa la dgon de'i dgon lag yo rgyan gling zhes pa'i ri khrod cig kyang mjal rgyu yod/rti'u ra dgon/rtsed thang nas lam thag spyi le 1 4 1phyin na lhun rtse rti'u ra dgon par slebs shing / dgon ming la rti'u ra zhis zhu don ni/ po to ba'i slob ma skor 'dul ba chen po'i rang ga'is chags sa'i rang ra dang nye bar chos sde btab pas rti'u ra zhes thogs shing / gnyal sde drug gi ya gyal yin/ de yang dgon pa de ni thog mar da lta'i dgon de'i nye 'dabs su rti'u ra zhes bka' brgyud pa'i dgon zhig yod pa jun gar bas rmeg med me bsregs gtong skabs rten gtso jo bo byang chub sems dpa' 'ig yod pa de mes ma 'tshig par sngar ba'in bzhugs/ de'i tshe sku gnyer gyi sems la da dgon pa mes bsregs zin pas 'dir bsdad kyang dgos pa mi 'dug snyam ste 'gro bar brtsams pa na jo bos rgyang nas gsung byon 178
te khyed 'gro na nga 'khrid dgos gsungs par snyu gnyer gyis ngas khyed gdan 'dren zhu dgos bsam yang theg pa mi 'dug ces zhus par jo bos khyed kyis nga'i sku stod khyer na 'grig ces gsungs pa ltar sku gnyer gyis jo bo'i bka' bzhin sku smad gser las grub pa de bzhag sku stod dzhaik+ṣ-im las grub pa de 'khyer nas nyang dkar thang du slebs pa na sku gnyer gcin pa shor ba jo bos mkhyen nas ngas 'dir babs/ khyed gcin pa thong 'es gsungs pas sa ming la'ang babs gcin lung zhes zer/de nas sku gnyer gyis da khyed gang du phebs na legs sam zhes bka' 'dri zhus par jo bos nga gnyis shar ngos su mi ma yin gyis brtsigs pa'i mkhar zhig yod sa der 'gro gsungs nas da lta'i dgon chags yul du bzhugs/ de'i tshe dge bshes po to ba'i slob ma chag lo tsā ba yul de'i phur sgrub pa bskyon nas bzhugs yod pas gnas der jo bo'i sku stod bzhugs pa mngon shes kyis gzigs pa na nges par du dgon pa 'ig 'debs rgyu'i thugs thag bcad de las grwa 'go brtsams/ dus der rje rtsang kha pa tsa ri nas yar phebs skabs chag lo tsā bas dgon pa'i rtsig rmang bting zin pas rje tsong kha pas ngas bsam pa dang khyed kyis gleng ba mnyam 'dug ces gsungs pas bsam gleng rte'u ra dgon zhes pa'i mtshan 179
byung / dgon pa btab grub rjes chag lo tsā bas mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs shing / thengs shig khong sgrub pa bskyon nas bzhugs skabs sde brgyad garma nyi zlas bka' srung zhu rgyur khas blangs/dgon pa'i khor mo khor yug tu skye shing gang yang med pas nyin thig chag lo tsā bas nye gnas la dbu skra rkang kha shas gnang ste khyed kyis skra 'di dag rgya gang che che'i sar gtor nas shing sna tshogs skye bar shog ces shing so so'i ming nas bos shig ces gsungs pa ltar nye gnas kyis dbu skra gang sar gtor zhing / shing sna 'ga' zhig gi ming bos kyang tsan dan gyi ming 'bod rgyu ma byung bar 'gyod sems chen po skyes/'on kyang yul de'i khul du shing gtan nas med kyang dgon pa'i mtha' khor shing snas khengs par dus da lta'ang tshang ma ngo mtshar dpag med skye gi yod/dgon pa'i rten gtso jo bo byang chub sems dpa'i sku stod ni dzhai k+ṣim las grub pa'i nang rten rtsa chen zhig yin pas der gsol ba smon lam ci btab na r+ya 'grub pa med ces so/ /180
gnas gzhi dgon/mtshan cha tshang la gnas gzhi zhi khro bka' brgya lha khang zhes zer/ rtsed thang nas lam thag le dbar197yod pa dang / rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid 2 2 19yod/dgon pa de gnas ga'i grong tsho'i dbus su yod pas dgon ming la'ang gnas ga'i dgon zhes thogs/ dgon 'di thog mar gter ston 'og ma gu ru chos dbang gis phyag btab cing / yum dkar bza' mgon skyid gnyis kyi sras su 1 2 1 2 lor bltams/ rnying ma'i gter ston brgya rtsa'i nang nas nyang nyi ma 'od zer la gter sngon gong ma dang / gu ru chos dbang 'di nyid la gter ston 'og ma zer/de yang thog mar gter ston gu ru chos dbang nyid dgon pa gnas sa'i rgyab rir sgrub pa bskyon nas bzhugs yod pa na/ glo bur du sa cha der zhi khro bka' brgyad kyi lha khang zhig bzhengs dgos thugs la 'khrungs pas nyams snang ltar dgon pa de phyag 'debs gnang mdzad/ de rjes gra phyi smin grol gling gi khongs su gyur/ thog mar dbon dgon yin pa nas dzes su gtsang dgon chags/1 81
sngon dgon pa de'i nang che mchog he ru ka sogs 'i khro'i lha tshogs cha tshang yod/da lta dgon pa'i bka' brgyad lha khang che mchog he ru ka dang / sgrol ma lha khang nang ston pa'i sku brnyan dang / gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ gu ru chos dbang sogs mjal rgyu yod pa dang / dgon nas nub ngos su spyi le gsum tsam phyin na mnga' bdag nyang gi gte ra nas brag srin po sbar rjes zhes pa'i sgrub phug cig mjal rgyu yod/shing rtsa dgon/yar 'brog shing rtsa dgon ni sna dkar rtse rdzong lhun po zhol shang khongs su gnas yod cing / dgon pa de ni 'brug pa bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma grags can 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi slob ma grags pa rin chen gyis1 198lor phyag btab pa dang / da bar lo ngo ra 0 7tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan/grags pa rin chen( mtshan ga'an la grags pa ras chen yang zhu) ni rdze btsun mi la'i rnam sprul yin zer srol yod pa dang / dgon pa de ga'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs nang mi la'i rnam sprul grags pa rin chen la/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyis rlobs zhes 'khod pa deng sang yang 1 82
tshogs gzhung du 'don mus yin la dpe rnying deng sang yang mjal rgyu yod/shing rtsa zhes pa ni dgon pa chags yul gyi ri derari sa mtho'i tsi shing spa ma mang po skyes yod pa de'i rtsa ba zhis pa'i go don tsam zhig yin zhing / dgon pa'i ming rgyas par shing rtsa thub bstan lung rtogs bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling zhes par grags/grags pa rin chen thog mar tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi srol gtod pa zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa'i drung du ra ba tu byung 'ing / rdzes su 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi khyad chos nā ro chos drug dang / la snyoms skor drug sogs rtsa rlung gi nus rtsal la thugs yid gting nas dad de khong gi slob mar gyur pa ma zad/ sgrub pa skyon rgyu kho nar gzhol bas ras rkyang gtong ba sogs gtum mo'i bde drod kyi rtags mtshan khyad par thon par brten khong ge skabs slob ma ha cang mang po 'dus pa'i nang sgrub pa skyon mkhan kho na stong phrag kha shas byung bar grags shing sgrub phug ha cang mang po yod pa de das deng sang yang mjal rgyu yo da/ga'an yang shing rtsa dben pa'i ri khrod ces pa ltar grong sde so gas dang ma 'brel bar dgon pa khor gtsang yin pa dang / sgrub pa rgyag rgyu gtsor bzung thog de snga ras rkyang 183
gtong ba zhes rtsa rlung sbyong ba dang / gtum mo'i bde drod kyi sbyong brdar tshad gzhi dngos 'brel ji tsam 'og tu slebs yod med rgyugs len 'gran bsdur byed srol dang / grwa btsun rnams la shing rtsa'i sgrub pa ba bzhes spu skra ras lcog rgyag srol yod/ deng rabs spyi tshogs yar thon gyi 'phrod bsten blang bya dang mtshams phyir sgom sgrub nyams len sogs kyi thad sngar srogasru rgyun 'dzin gang thub stsod bzhin ba las dbu skra ras snyug rgyag gi med/grags pa rin chen nas da lta'i shing rtsa'i sprul ming 'dzin po bstan 'dzin chog grags ( chos ming dngos garma ye she rgya mtsho) bar bla rabs bcu ba'i byung / dgon pa de ni phag gru'i srid dbang sogs kyi skabs dar rgyas chen po 'dug kyang bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang dge lugs pas bzung rjes rim ba'in nyams rgud du gyur cing dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gong dge 'dun zhal grangs 2 0 tsam dang / shing rtsa'i dgon lag yar 'brog skar ma gling rtswa thang gi byang ngos ri bo'i thog la wa dgon zhes pa der btsun ma 'al grangs 2 5 tsam yo da/dgon pa chags yul gyi ri bo de glang chen 'grang ba lta bu'i brdzid nyams zhing mdun ngos na yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtswa thang thog rtsa che'i srog chags rkyang dang dgo ba sogs ri dwags 184
