drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos gzigs 'dod na/ sku nyid bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho khad phebs/yar klung khul gyi rlung dar 'dzugs srol skor/de yang ljongs rgyu ba thig bod du slebs skabs thog mar thag ring nas mthong ba'i mngon gsal dod shos kyi dngos po zhig yod pa ni dar lcog ces pa de lags/ dar lcog ces pa'i tshig de la thog mar chos lugs kyi nang don med cing bon ston gshen rab mi bo che'i dus su zhang zhung yul du lug bal dang g.yag gi rtsid pa rgyug pa'i rtser btags nas 'dzugs srol dar ba dang de'i don snying ni thog mar mdzes rgyan lta bu nas rim bzhin rlung rta 'phel ba'i nang don ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ de rjes g.yul du sku srog shor ba'i dpa' bo'i bang so'am sa phung steng 'dzugs kyi yod pa de ni dpa' nyams mtshon pa dang / dran gso zhu ba'i ched du yin pas gong gsal nang don tha dad yin/191
bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/——bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su bon gyi chos lugs dang goms srol 'ga' 'ig yar klung khul du dar ba dang chabs cig bal rtsid kyi dar lcog( de la yar bskyed zer)dar srol yang mnyam du dar/ de ni rbad du dar lcog 'dzugs srol thog mar dar ba 'ig yin pas rim ba'in tshang ma sa de la lad mo byas nas bod yo/ngas su dar lcog 'dzugs sro/la sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur/ dar lcog ces pa de yang kha skad yin pas yig thog phal mo cher rlung dar zhes brjod/ de'i skor ngo sprod rags tsam zhu na/1 rlung dar ni bon gyi grub ga'i sa chu me rlung mtshon pa 'ig yin te/ g.yung drung bon gyi lugs su phyi snod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul 'byung bar ba'i las grub par smra la/nang bcud lus khams kyi grub tshul yang 'byung ba bzhi las rgyas bshad byed pa yin pas 'byung ba'i khams rnyogs pa ni bde skyed kyi rtsa ba 'ig yin bsam nas rlung dar 'dzugs pa dang de ba'in lha gsol dang klu gsol/ btsan gsol sogs kyi cho ga la 'ang 'byung ba'i snyoms sgrib gi lta ba de 'khyer nas 'grel bshad byed kyi yod/2 bod rgyal dang po gnya' khri btsan po'i dus thog mar yar klung khul du bal rtsid kyi rlung dar 'dzugs srol dar ba nas rim ba'in ras snam gyi rlung dar 'dzugs srol la 192
drug pa/ sa mtho'i thun min khyad chos bod mi'i 'byung khungs lho kha/'gyur ldog byung yod kyang dus yun ring po 'ig nang rlung dar gyi tshos ma dog mi 'dra ba yod pa las/ rlung dar ngos su ri mo dang yi ge med/2 phyis rlung dar ngos su ri mo stag se nga khyung 'brug 'bri ba de'ang bon gyi gsar gtod byas pa'i 'byung bzhi mtshon byed yin te/ sa yi mtshon rtags seng ge dang / chu yi mtshon rtags 'brug me yi mtshon rtags khyung / rlung gi mtshon rtags stag yin 'ing / dbus kyi rlung rta'i mtshon ris gtso bo sgal steng du yid ba'in nor bu bkal ba'i rta de ni phyis su sangs rgyas chos lugs pas bsnan pa zhig yin/ de'i go don ni/ rta mchog de rin chen bdun gyi gras shig yin tshul sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dpe cha'i nang 'khod yod pa ma zad rta yi sgal steng du nor bu gsum bkal yo/da pa'i dpe ris de'ang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi shod srol dang yongs su mthun pa 'ig yin no/ /4 stag seng khyung 'brug ni lha sgrung nang gsal ba'i srog chags yin pas khyung ni rtsal dang / 'brus ni grags pa/sta ga ni dpa' nyams/ seng ge ni shugs kyi mtshon byed yin zhes 'grel bshad rgyag srol yo/da/ da dung srog chags ba'i po rim ba'in/ sro/ga dang / lung / dbang thang / rlung rta bcas yin pa'i shod srol cig kyang yo/da/1 93
5 bar skabs kyi dus skabs nang rlung dar gyi ri mo'i nang g.yag 'bri srol 'ig byung 'dug kyang de dar khyab tu ma phyin par dus thung nang med par gyur 'dug6 deng char rlung dar nī sangs rgyas chos lugs pas bsod nams dang / bde skyed/ dbang thang sogs mtshon pa'ang rlung rta dar ba'i ched du bsngo smon byed pa 'ig la 'gyur yod kyang thog ma'i 'byung khungs ni bon rang yin no/ /gar klung khral gyi gna' bo'i dur mchod byed stangs/yar klung ni bod mi rigs kyi 'byung khungs dang / rig gnas dang lo rgyus kyi chu 'go yin pa ma zad pur rgyal bod kyi btsan po rim byung gi bzhugs gnas yin la bod kyi btsan po'i bang so'ang mang che ba yar klung khul du yod pas yar klung ge gna' bo'i dur mchod byed srol ni bod kyi 'o rgyus hril po dang 'brel ba ha cang chen po yod/de yang yar klung lo rgyus thog snga phyir dur mchod byed stangs mi 'dra ba bzhi byung ba ste/1 phur bya rbod la gtor ba'i dur mchod dang /1 94
〈 pur sa 'og la sba ba'i dur mchod/〈 pur chu la bshams pa'i dur mchod/4 phur me la bsregs pa'i dur mchod bcas so/ /dang po/ bur bya rgod la gtor ba'i dur mchod/bod rgyatshol thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i dus nas dar bar te/ gnya' khri btsan po dang / mu khri btsan po/ ding khri btsan po/ so khri btsan po/ mer khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po bcas la gnam gyi khri bdun zer ba dang / sku gdung 'ja' ltar yal/ bang so mkha' la btab ces pa sogs ni che bkod byas pa tsam yin pa las don dngos su gnam gyi khri bdun po'i sku gdung ri mtho sa gtsang 'ig tu 'khyer nas bya rgod la longs spyod byed du 'jug pa dang / pur nam mkhar lha yis spyan drangs zhes bon gyi 'dod tshul dang mthun par brjod/ srol rgyun 'dir deng sang yang phung po bya gtor zhes bod kyi sa phyogs gar sar khyab/195
gnyis pa/ bur sa 'og tu sba ba'i dun r+ya chod/bod kyi rgyal rabs brgyad pa gri gum btsan po'i dus dar ba ste/ de yang gri gum btsan po lo ngam gyis bkrongs nas rgyal srid 'phrog sras sha khri dang / nya khri kong po'i yul du bskrad/ dus phyis sras nya khri sa chu srin bye ma lag ring si sa nas yab kyi sku gdung blus shing / ( ru las skyes kyis rabs sna tshogs kyis myang chu skya mo nas gri gum gyi pur btsal zhes kyang zer ) skabs der lo ngam 'khor dang bcas pa da dung brlag med pas dgra bo de dag gis yab kyi sku gdung shes na gnod par dogs te phying ba stag rtse'i khor yug gi sa btsan sa zhig tu yab kyi bang so brtsigs pa de nas bzung pur sa 'og tu sba ba'i srol thog mar byung /de rjes rim byung btsan po mi/ nyung ba 'ig gi bang so rdza ri mtho 'ing btsan pa'i gnas su brtsigs shing / bang so'i dbyibs zlum po yin/ de nas rim ba'in btsan po'i bang so ri la brtsigs pa de thang ngam yul du brtsigs pa'i srol dar/gnam ri srong btsan dus nas pur khang ba'engs pa'i srol dar zhing / pur khang nī rgya che 'ing / thog rtsegs ldan nga 196
ba'ongs pa ste〈bang so'i dkar chag〉la sa srong btsan gyi bang so 'phyong phur bta ba/ phyi dbyibs gru ba'i/ nang du re'u mig dgu bha khang lnga/ dbus su ring tshad khre tse bco brgyad yod pa'i byu ru'i sdong po rgyun bkang gi ma/tshon byed du byas/zur ba'i'i mchod khang rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang /nang skya rdo leb gru ba'i ma kun nas bsgrigs/ phyi skya gyang sa mthug po bslang sa/ bang so 'i sgo mo nub la gta da/ bang so 'i phyir sa smug po dang rdo hrug gi sa bkab nas rde'u 'bur 'ig tu gyu ra/ mu mtha' so so ra zheng tshad gom pa brgya lhag tsam dang mtho tshad la gzhu 'dom ba cu gnyi sa tsam yod/ bang so'i steng du lha khang chung ngu bzhings yod ces gsal ba ltar yin la/ pur sgam gyi rtse mo nges par du nub phyogs su gtad dgos don ni/ nub phyogs bde ba can gī zhing du skye ba'i smon lam 'de bas pa mtshon no/ / srol 'di nyams nas da lta rna thos tsam du gyur/ 'on kyang lho pa bas deng yang pur sa 'og tu sbas kyi yod zer/gsum pa/ pur chu la bshams pa'i dun mchod/pur chu la ba r+sha mas pa'am bskyu ra ba'i ni bod kyi rgyal rabs ba cu drus nga/ za na ma zin lde'i dus nas dar 'ing je 1 97
yang nam zin lde dang / le 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ se snol gnam lde/ lde sno la nam/ lde snol po/ lde rgyal po/ lde sprin btsan bcas la lde brgyad zer 'ing / pha dag gi bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab ces zer don ni pha dus btsan po'i pur rin po che'i gos rgyan sna tshogs kyis yongs su btums pa dang / gser dngul g.yu byur sogs dang mnyam du dngul lam zangs sgam kha sprod r+ya 'i nang du bcug nas chu bor bskyur te/ btsan po'i pur de sa ga'i skyong ba'i lha dang / mtsho nang gi nor bdag klu rnams dgyes pa'i skyes su mchod pas lung par phyugs zog 'phel zhing lo legs yong ba mtshon pa yin zer/ pur chu la bskyur ba'i srol de thog mar byung ba nas dus da lta'i bar ma nub par gnas/bzhi pa/ bur me la bsregs pa'i dur mchod/pur me la bsregs pa'i dur mchod rmi gna' dus su byung bar mngon zhing / dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi 'i byed pa'i chos lugs bod du dar zhing khyab pa'i rjes su mi tshe las 'das rjes phung po mer bsregs pa'i srol de ches cher dar ba dang / srol de la yongs grags su bzhu bsregs zer ba dang / 'ga' res 'e 198
tshig spyad de bzhugs 'bul zhes zer ba deng char ngag gtam la gyur/de yang bla ma dang dpon chen gshegs na bzhugs bsreg gam bzhu 'bul byed pa gas spyir btang gi mi phal pa shi na bzhu bsregs mi bya/ la las rang gi drin can pha ma gshegs na bzhu bsreg byed mkhan yod kyang de ni grangs tshad ha cang nyung nyung yi/na pas/ bzhu bsregs gam bzhugs 'bul ni dur mchod byed stangs nang nas khyad du 'phags pa'am mchos tu gyur ba 'ig yin/ srol 'di'ang dar ba nas bzung da lta bar mi nyams par gnas yod/btsan po gnam gyi khri bdun skabs kyi chos lugs skor/bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther khrag nang btsan po khri bdun gyi skabs rgyal srid sgrung dang lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs zhes yongs grags su 'khod yod pas/ gong gsal btsan po'i bzhugs yul yar klung kho na yin stabs 'dir de dus kyi chos lugs skor ngo sprod mdor bsdus zhu rgyu yin/1 99
bod ljongs lho kha'i yul skor gnas ljongs ngo sprod/—gcig btsan po dang sku bon gyi sgor/btsan po dang sku bon ni 'brel ba ha cang zab pa cog ste/ btsan po ni dbang cha che shos kyi rgyal po yin pa dang /sku bon la brten nas btsan po'i snyan grags bod khams yongs su khyab yod pas sku bon ni bod rgyal gnya' khri'i skabs su thog mar byung ba dang / rim bzhin rgyud 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas su phyin yod pa ni bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther las de'i sras ding khri btsan po ༷ 'ang zhung gi gshen bon kun 'dus theg chen gyi sku bsrungs song / de'i sras mu khri btsan po/ bon po gshen po tshe rgyal gyis sku bsrungs song / de sra/sa sribs khri btsan po/ 'ang zhung gshen po kun ring rgyal pos sku bsrungs song / de'i sras ye shes khri po/ bon po g.yung drung rgyal pos sku bsrungs song / de'i sras gnya' khri po/mon po kun rtogs rgyal pos sku bsrungs song / de'i sras sribs khri po/ bon po 'ang zhung lha 'od kyis snyu bsrungs song /de'i sras sribs po/ bon po 'ang zhung lha 'od kyis sku bsrungs so thes gsal bas btsan po'i ma/tshan 'bod tshul cung mi 'dra ba las don dngos thog gnya' khri phud pa'i gnam 200
gyi khri drug po la zer/ sku bsrungs so ches pa'i don la dpyad na/ sku bon rgyun du btsan po dang mnyam sdod byed dgos pa ma zad/ btsan po'i sku srog kyang sku bon gyi lag tu bzung yo da pa shes thub/ der ma sku bon byung ba ni bod gna' rabs kyi spyi tshogs nang lus kyi ngal rtsol pa dang / bsam pa'i ngal rtsol pa gnyis so sor kha gyes pa'i mtshon rtags yin pa dang / sku bon rmi bsam pa'i ngag rtsol pa ste/ shes pa can du brtsi chog de dus bod kyi mi rnams kyis 'jig rten khams kyi sems can dang / dngos po yod do la lha 'dre zhugs yod par ngos 'dzin byed cing / 'dod tshul de la brten nas lha dang / btsan/ gnyan/ klu bcas tshad mtho ba'i rigs du ma gas ra skrun byas te de dag ni tshe ring zhing nus mthu khyad du 'phags pa/ gnam 'og tu 'gran zla med pa'i dpung mgon la brtsis nas nam yang gzab nan gyis cho ga bkur ste mchod pa rgya cher sgrub na/ da gzod mi'i spyi tshogs la bde 'jags dang bde skyed yong nges yin snyam zhing cho ga gal che de dag sgrub rgyu dang / btsan po'i sku srog dang dbang thang srung skyob/de bzhin btsan po'i dur 'jug bya rgyu bcas ni sku bon gyi las 'gan satso bo yin/201
gnyis/ sgrung dang lde'u'i sko ra/sgrung dang lde'u ni bon gyi gong nas byung 'ing / der sa gnas dang dmangs khrod kyi rang ba'in shugs cher ྅ na yod/'on kyang thog mar sgrung dang lde'u la lha yi chos lugs thes chab srid skyong ba'i gnad dam par brtsis yod pa nī bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther las lha yi chos lugs sgrung dang lde'u byung zhes gsal 'ing /de yang skabs de'i sgrung ni lha sgrung gi khongs su gtogs pa dper na/ ma sangs kyi sgrung zhes pa'i nang ma sa ngas rbi bod rigs kyi mes por gyur ba'i gna' bo'i gdung rgyud gcig yin pa'i lha sgrung bshad yod/ de ba'in lde'u zhes pa de'ang deng sang ltar na blo rig 'gran pa'i rig pa zhig yin na'ang de dus sgrung dang 'dra bar lde'u'i nang don gtso bo rang gi mes po dang / 'byung khams chags tshul/ skye rga na 'chi sogs tshang mar lha 'dre zhugs su bcug nas ngo mtshar spro btags kyis nyan pa po rnams yid ches dang dad mos skye ru bcug nas srid la 'bas 'degs zhu gi yo da pas chab srid sgrung dang lde'u bon gyis bskyangs zhes bsgrags so / /202
lhad med ba za' ba ca'/ yar klung gsol zhib /yar klung gsol 'ib/ yar klung ljags smin/ yar klung rtsam pa/'dzam gling yang rtse'i zas mchoggangs ri'i ljongs kyi sman bzang /nam mkha' g.yu ltar sngo ba'i 'og gi pha yul/sprin pa dung ltar dkar ba'i 'og gi grong tsho/mkha' rlung shel ltar gtsang ba'i khrod kyi 'ing thang /gang sa chu dri med bdud rtsis bskyangs pa'i ljang pa/mtho tshad spyi khre bzhi stong yan gī me tog'dzam bu'i gling la gcig kho na las med pa'i thun min khyad ldan gyi stabs bde'i za sa rigs/dkar mo nas kyi nying khu/ gangs ltar dkar ba'i gso/la 'ib/༈'ji ni cong gi mes po sbar ras zhing gi tsha bo red/'di mi ya ra lha sham chu'i nu zhos gsos pa'i khye'u red/'di mi yar klung 'bru mdzod chen po'i rtags ma red/'ad sa pa'i lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang /203
las la brtson 'ing shes rig ldan pa'i sa mtho'i bu phrug rnams kyis yum bu brla mkhar dang po ta 'a so gas bskrun myong la/ dpa' ngar chen pos rang srung dbyin 'gos dam/ga 'khrug byed myong / da dung 'dzam gling kun la snyan pa 'a brug ltar ldir ba'i/ 'od stong 'bar ba'i gangs ljongs rig gnas kyang gsar gtod byed myong /yar klung gsol 'ib/ yar klung ljags smin/ yar klung rtsam pa/khyed kyis yar klung gsol 'ib ljags bro ( bro ba) 'ig gzigs dang / pho bar bde 'ing zas kyi dwang ga bye ba/ thos par dka' 'ing mdzes nyams thon pa/ lus stobs nyin nas nyin bzhin rgyas te/ khyed sa mtho'i lha g.yag lta bur 'gyur nges yin/khyed kyi yar klung gsol zhib rgyun du mchod dang / don lnga snod drug kun la phan zhing / khyad par du gcin pa mngar skyur gyi nad dang / mchin mkhri sa nad rigs ma lus 'joms pa dang / khyed tshe ring lo brgya thub par gdon mi za/mig sngar tshan rig lag rtsal 'bar gas rab tu che 'ing /slob gso 'phron bsten gyi bstan pa ches cher dar bas/ yar klung gsol zhib la lang tsho'i me tog gsar pa ba'ad de/tshan rig gi las snon 'bras bu g.yur du za ba smin/204
gzigs dang /bltas na dkar zhing mdzes par yar klung gsol zhib/mchod na zhim 'ing bcud ldan yar klung gsol zhib/btsongs na brin zhing gong bzang yar klung gsol zhib/khyed ni lhag bsam mtshon pa'i gangs dkar yin pas/khyed kyis sku mgron rnam pa'i thugs 'dod skong ba'in yod la/khyed ni bkra shis mtshon pa'i mjal dar yin pas/khyed kyis sku mgron rnams phebs bsu zhu ba'in yod/lhad med bza' bca'/ zhol gsar 'bri mar/'dzam gling yang rtse'i steng gi/ rnam shes yod pa'i nor bu 'bri g.yag gi khyu tshogs/ lus stobs glang chen ltar che ba/brjid nyams seng ge ltar dod pa/ grang ngar la mi zhed cing /ngal las la'ang mi skrag gnya' yis 'ing rmod thub la/ sgal par rdog khris 'khur thub/ da dung / gdan 'bol lta bu'i sgal steng du bzhon nas/ lam yod med la mi ltos par/ ri klung kun tu yul skor spro 'cham la bskyod chog tha na khyed kyi lce ba'ang / me la 'bud chog la zhing lud kyang byas chogde ltar/ khyed kyis tshe gang mgo nag mi la 'bas 205
'degs zhus te sku tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs na'ang / sha khrag longs spyod byas chog la/ pags rigs gos su bklubs tshag cing / spu tsid kyis nyal chas kyang btags chog tha ngan rus pas kyang thang bskol chog pa/ rwa nyer mkho'i dngos rdzas bzos chog pa ma zad/ sa mtho'i khyad chos ldan pa'i mdzes rgyan du'ang ngoms chogkhyad par du 'bri bzang gi nu ma las 'bab pa'i mngar zhim gyi 'o ma sos pa/ bzho gyin bzho gyin zhal du mchod chog la/ 'bri bzang gi 'o mas bsrubs pa'i nying bcud zhol gsar 'bri mar snyags bag gsol ja bsrubs ma/ 'im mngar thud kyi rdar tshan/ bcud ldan mar spags snum 'tshir/ser hrog bag rtsa mar khu/ lhad med bza' bca'/ zhol gsar 'bri mar/ lus stobs gso ba'i zas mchog nad rigs 'joms pa'i sman mchog khyad par du/ rlung nad la mchog tu gyur pas/ nyin mo sems bde zhing / mtshan mo gnyid skyid pa/ nga tshos 'bri mar gyi gsol ja 'khyer nas phebs sgug zhu bzhin yod pas/ sku mgron lhan rgyas lho khar phebs dang / gsol ja bsrubs ma mchod par phebs dang / / / /su206
